questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT) is **wrong**?

options.text: In general, the larger angular range of the x-ray tube motion results in more tomographic information and yields better section separation or vertical (z-axis) resolution.
The increase in screening-detected cancers achieved with DBT is mostly due to an increase in the detection of invasive cancers rather than ductal carcinoma in situ.
DBT is associated with a lower recall of asymmetries and focal asymmetries.

In DBT, the resolution of each individual calcification may be compromised depending on the optical density of the calcification, the DBT imaging acquisition, and motion during the longer DBT image acquisition.
None of the above.

questions.reference: Digital Breast Tomosynthesis: Concepts and Clinical Practice. Radiology 2019; 292:1–14；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p84
questions.explanation: 答案 E。A 至 D 皆為正確敘述，故選「以上皆非（即沒有錯誤者）」。(A) X 光管擺動的弧角範圍越大，取得的斷層資訊越多，z 軸（深度向）的切層分離與解析越好；(B) DBT 篩檢多增加的偵測以侵犯性癌為主（尤其侵犯性小葉癌），而非原位癌（DCIS）；(C) DBT 薄層可去除組織重疊，降低不對稱與局部不對稱的召回率；(D) 個別鈣化的解析可能因鈣化的光學密度、DBT 擷取方式，以及較長擷取時間內的移動而受影響。四項均無誤，答案為 E。→ [[breast-tomosynthesis]]

questions.questionText: Which one of the following descriptions about anatomy imaging issues of breast sonography is **not true** ?

options.text: The thin, echogenic skin line is normally less than 2 mm in thickness
Echogenicity is defined relative to fibroglandular tissue
Anterior suspensory ligament is usually visible in subcutaneous zone
Interlobular stroma and glandular elements are usually hyperechoic

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging: Breast E-Book P4；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p86
questions.explanation: 答案 B。乳房超音波的回音性是以「皮下脂肪」為參考基準，而非纖維腺體組織；脂肪呈中灰、較淺灰的纖維腺體為暗，腺體相對脂肪呈中度高回音，故 B 稱「以纖維腺體為基準」為不正確敘述。其餘為正確：(A) 正常的薄高回音皮膚線厚度一般小於 2 mm；(C) 前懸韌帶（Cooper 韌帶）通常可見於皮下區；(D) 小葉間基質與腺體成分多呈高回音。→ [[breast-tissue-echogenicity]]

questions.questionText: To identify an ultrasound non-mass lesion for a mammographic correlation, which of the following mammographic finding is less likely?

options.text: Group or segmental microcalcifications
Focal asymmetry
Developing asymmetry
Spiculated mass
Architectural distortion

questions.reference: Radiographics 2020; 40:326-335.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p165
questions.explanation: 答案 D。超音波上呈「非腫塊（non-mass）」表現的病灶，最常對應的乳攝所見為鈣化、局部或發展性不對稱，以及結構扭曲；毛刺狀腫塊（spiculated mass）本身即為「腫塊（mass）」表現，具三維佔位與外凸邊界，最不可能以 non-mass 呈現，故 D 為最不可能的選項。其餘 (A) 群集／節段性微鈣化、(B) 局部不對稱、(C) 發展性不對稱、(E) 結構扭曲，因缺乏腫塊的外凸邊界或明確佔位，較常在超音波上呈 non-mass 表現。→ [[breast-asymmetry]]

questions.questionText: When axillary adenopathy is seen at screening mammography with no suspicious findings in the breasts. Which of the following is false as according to ACR BI-RADS Atlas® 5th Edition?

options.text: Bilateral axillary sonography should be performed to confirm that the finding is asymmetric/unilateral.
In the absence of a known infectious or inflammatory cause, isolated unilateral axillary adenopathy should receive a suspicious (BI-RADS category 4) assessment.
Bilateral axillary adenopathy should be assessed as benign (BI-RADS category 2) because they are frequently reactive/infectious in origin.

Unilateral axillary adenopathy suggests occult breast carcinoma or, much less commonly, lymphoma, metastatic melanoma, ovarian cancer, or other metastatic cancer. Consequently, a careful search of the ipsilateral breast images is warranted.

questions.reference: ACR BI-RADS Atlas® 5th Edition, Frequently asked question section；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p85
questions.explanation: 答案 C。雙側腋下淋巴腫大的分類須視臨床情境而定，並非一律給良性（BI-RADS 2）：若有已知的反應性／感染性病因（如結節病、系統性紅斑狼瘡、乾癬、HIV）才評為 BI-RADS 2，但若無已知原因、尤其為新出現者，可能是淋巴瘤／白血病的表現，應給可疑（BI-RADS 4）並建議超音波導引 FNA 或粗針切片，故 C 稱「一律評為良性」為錯誤（false）敘述。其餘正確：(A) 可做雙側腋下超音波確認為不對稱／單側；(B) 在無已知感染或發炎病因下，孤立單側腋下淋巴腫大應給可疑（BI-RADS 4）；(D) 單側腋下淋巴腫大提示隱匿性乳癌，較少為淋巴瘤、轉移性黑色素瘤、卵巢癌或其他轉移癌，故須仔細檢查同側乳房影像。→ [[axillary-adenopathy-mammography]]

questions.questionText: Which one of the following managements about probably benign (BIRADS 3) lesions is **not true** ?

options.text: It is usually deﬁned as speciﬁc lesion types with ≤2% risk of malignancy
In breast sonography, BIRADS 3 can be used directly on screening
Biopsy is recommended for circumscribed solid mass with increased diameter ≥30% in 6 months or other suspicious ﬁndings
Speciﬁc lesion can be considered BIRADS 3 on baseline mammograpm after work-up.

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging: Breast E-Book P219；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p87
questions.explanation: 答案 C。可能良性（BI-RADS 3）的邊界清晰實質腫塊，若在 6 個月短期追蹤內最長徑增加達 20% 以上（或出現其他可疑特徵）即應改為切片，C 誤植為「≥30%」，故為不正確敘述（切片門檻的成長幅度是 20%，非 30%）。其餘正確：(A) BI-RADS 3 定義為惡性風險 ≤2% 的特定病灶類型；(B) 超音波篩檢見典型可能良性病灶可直接下 BI-RADS 3（乳房攝影篩檢則須先完成診斷性 work-up）；(D) 特定病灶於基線乳房攝影完成 work-up 後可歸為 category 3。→ [[bi-rads-categories]]

questions.questionText: 關於ACR BI-RADS categories, 以下何者為**非**？

options.text: Abnormality之hierarchy,其嚴重程度排序由低🡪高為1236045
Category 4A指惡性可能程度為>2%但≦10%
Category 4B指惡性可能程度為>25%但≦50%
到目前的版本為止(2013版)，breast MRI的category 4並未建議一定 要再細分為4A,4B,4C。

questions.reference: ACR BI-RADS® atlas, 2013, Mammography page149,175; MRI page 141.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p348
questions.explanation: 答案 C。BI-RADS 4B 代表中度惡性可能，惡性率區間為 10–49%，C 誤述為「>25% 但 ≤50%」，故為錯誤選項。其餘正確：(A) 多發病灶時取最高類別，嚴重度由低到高的階層為 1、2、3、6、0、4、5；(B) 4A 為低度惡性可能，區間 2–9%（即 >2% 但 ≤10%）；(D) 至 2013 版為止，乳房 MRI 的 category 4 並未建議一定要再細分為 4A／4B／4C。（補充：4C 為 50–94%。）→ [[bi-rads-categories]]

questions.questionText: About the BRCA-associated breast cancers, which is **not** correct?

options.text: BRCA1 is tumor suppressor genes located on chromosomes 17
BRCA2 is tumor suppressor genes located on chromosomes 14
Lifetime risk of carriers of BRCA1 gene is about 55%–65%
Lifetime risk of carriers of BRCA2 gene is about 45%

questions.reference: BRCA-associated Cancers: Role of Imaging in Screening, Diagnosis, and Management; RadioGraphics 2017; 37:1005–1023；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p3
questions.explanation: 答案 B。BRCA2 位於第 13 對染色體，而非第 14 對，故 B 為不正確敘述（記憶口訣：BRCA1→17、BRCA2→13）。其餘正確：(A) BRCA1 為位於第 17 對染色體的大型腫瘤抑制基因；(C) BRCA1 帶原者至 70 歲的終生乳癌風險約 55–65%；(D) BRCA2 帶原者約 45%；相較之下一般族群平均終生風險約 12.3%。→ [[breast-cancer-genetics]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is **wrong**?

options.text: The main indications of breast MRI are staging of known cancer, screening for breast cancer in women at increased risk, and evaluation of response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
Lesion detection on breast MRI is primarily performed by using the postcontrast images.
Using MRI to assess tumor size for invasive lobular carcinomas is less accurate than ultrasonography.
The depiction of DCIS components related to invasive cancers on breast MR is much better than that with mammography.

questions.reference: Breast MRI: State of the Art. Radiology 2019; 292:520–536；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p83
questions.explanation: 答案 C。恰好相反：MRI 是評估浸潤性小葉癌範圍最準確的模態（敏感度 >95%，多以線狀／節段的 non-mass enhancement 呈現），對真實範圍、多發與雙側的評估都優於乳房攝影與超音波，並可降低再切除率；超音波反而常低估 ILC 範圍（約 18–53%），故 C 稱「MRI 不如超音波準確」為錯誤敘述。其餘正確：(A) 乳房 MRI 主要適應症為已知癌症分期、高風險族群篩檢與新輔助化療反應評估；(B) 病灶偵測主要依賴打顯影劑後的影像；(D) MRI 對侵犯癌旁 DCIS 成分的顯示優於乳房攝影。→ [[invasive-lobular-carcinoma]]

questions.questionText: Regarding the type of errors in false negative breast MRI, which of the following statements is **incorrect**?

options.text: Perceptual errors are the most common type of diagnostic radiology, reported for 60-80% of radiologists’ errors.
Perceptual error occurs when an abnormality is identified only retrospectively and was not detected prospectively.
Cognitive errors occur when an abnormality is identified prospectively but its significance is incorrectly interpreted.
Common causes of cognitive errors include subtle findings, satisfaction of search, workplace distraction, radiologist fatigue, poor lesion conspicuity.
Lack of medical knowledge, radiologist bias, incorrect clinical information may cause the cognitive errors.

questions.reference: Radiographics 2021; 41(3):1-20.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p164
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問 false-negative breast MRI 錯誤類型何者「錯誤」。（A）對：知覺性錯誤（perceptual error）是放射診斷最常見的錯誤，約占放射科醫師錯誤的 60%–80%。（B）對：知覺性錯誤指異常僅在回溯（retrospective）時才被看見、當下（prospective）未偵測到，即「漏看」。（C）對：認知性錯誤（cognitive error）指異常當下已被看見，但對其臨床意義判讀錯誤。（D）錯：subtle findings、satisfaction of search、工作環境干擾、醫師疲勞、病灶顯著度不佳等，屬於造成「知覺性錯誤」的原因，而非認知性錯誤，本選項張冠李戴故為不正確者。（E）對：醫學知識不足、醫師偏誤、錯誤的臨床資訊等才是認知性錯誤的常見成因。→ [[radiology-diagnostic-error-types]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 2: Causes of False-Negative Breast MRI Results**

| Type of Error | Causes |
|---|---|
| Technical error | Patient motion；Lack of intravenous contrast material administration (including unrecognized contrast extravasation)；Incomplete or inadequate visualization of findings on images (including that due to poor patient positioning or secondary to a finding being located at the edge of or partially excluded from the field of view)；Artifacts (including those from metal or hematoma) |
| Perceptual error | Failure to detect owing to blind spots or poor search patterns；Poor lesion conspicuity (including poor conspicuity secondary to a complex background parenchymal pattern, obscuration or reduced visualization due to background parenchymal enhancement [BPE], or small lesion size)；Subtle or atypical appearance of cancer；Satisfaction of search；Reader fatigue, distractions, or interruptions |
| Cognitive error | Stable or slowly growing lesion；Lesions with seemingly benign features (including benign shape, morphology, or T2 hyperintensity)；Attributing a suspicious finding as secondary to postsurgical change；Incorrect or misleading clinical information；Lack of knowledge (including recognizing that not all cancer subtypes may be visualized at MRI)；Radiologist bias |

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about breast MRI is true?

options.text: Rapid initial upslope in the ﬁrst 2 minutes with plateau or washout on delayed phase are more likely to be benign.
Diﬀuse enhancement is often believed to be a malignant pattern.
DCIS generally enhances more rapidly than invasive cancers.
Lesions<5mm is called a focus/ foci.

questions.reference: Primer 6th ed, p511；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p180
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問何者「正確」。（A）錯：初期 2 分鐘內快速上升、延遲期呈 plateau 或 washout，屬「惡性」型態而非良性（plateau 約 64%、washout 約 87% 為惡性）。（B）錯：瀰漫性（diffuse）強化多為良性/生理性背景強化，並非惡性型態。（C）錯：DCIS 動力學常不具鑑別力，尤其 low-grade，多無 washout、初期強化偏慢，並非比侵犯癌強化更快。（D）對：BI-RADS lexicon 中 <5mm 的 enhancing dot 稱為 focus/foci，太小而無法評估內部特徵。（原匯入答案 A，醫師 2026-07-11 裁決更正為 D：A 敘述錯誤、D 符合 BI-RADS lexicon，正解為 D，不再更動。）

questions.questionText: According to the ACR BI-RADS Atlas® 5th Edition, which description of the Kinetic Curve Assessment is **not** true?

options.text: In initial phase, slow is deﬁned as an increase in signal intensity of less than 50% within the ﬁrst 2 minutes
In initial phase, fast is an increase of more than 100%
During the delayed phase, persistent is deﬁned as signal intensity that does not change over time after the initial rise
During the delayed phase, washout is deﬁned as a decrease of more than 10% from the highest signal intensity during the initial rise. Washout curves are speciﬁcally denoted “suspicious.”

questions.reference: ACR BI-RADS Atlas® 5th Edition；10.2214/AJR.15.15957；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p2
questions.explanation: 答案 C。本題問 ACR BI-RADS 第 5 版動態曲線（kinetic curve）描述何者「錯誤」。（A）對：初期相（前 2 分鐘）signal intensity 上升 <50% 定義為 slow。（B）對：初期相上升 >100% 定義為 fast（50–100% 為 medium）。（C）錯：延遲期 persistent（type I）的定義是初始上升後訊號「持續緩慢增加（>10%）」，而非「不隨時間變化」；「不隨時間變化」較接近 plateau（type II）。（D）對：延遲期 washout（type III）定義為自初始上升的最高訊號下降 >10%，屬可疑（suspicious）型態。

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about breast sarcoidosis of the breast is **incorrect**?

options.text: Ultrasound shows an irregular, hypoechoic mass
Enlarged axillary or intramammary lymph nodes are rare.
Mammograms shows ill-defined, lobular, solid masses with equal densities.
MRI shows irregularly shaped masses with spiculations and heterogeneous internal enhancement.

questions.explanation: 答案 B。本題問乳房類肉瘤病（breast sarcoidosis）敘述何者「錯誤」。（A）對：超音波典型為不規則、低回音腫塊。（B）錯：腋下或乳內淋巴結腫大其實是乳房類肉瘤病「最常見」的影像所見（乳房攝影上尤然），並非罕見，故為不正確者。（C）對：乳房攝影可呈邊界不清、分葉狀、等密度的實質腫塊。（D）對：MRI 呈不規則毛刺狀腫塊伴內部不均勻強化。

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about diabetic mastopathy of the breast is **incorrect**?

options.text: Diabetic mastopathy is an uncommon benign breast disease, characterized by lymphocytic mastitis and stromal fibrosis.
It typically occurs in patients with long-standing type 1 diabetes.
Ultrasound showed a hypoechoic soft lesion.
MRI shows an ill-defined mass with contrast enhancement.

questions.reference: Breast J. 2019 Nov;25(6):1251-1253.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p345
questions.explanation: 答案 C。本題問糖尿病乳腺病變（diabetic mastopathy）敘述何者「錯誤」。（A）對：為少見的良性乳房疾病，病理特徵為淋巴球性乳腺炎（lymphocytic mastitis）合併間質纖維化（stromal fibrosis）。（B）大致對：典型見於長期胰島素依賴型糖尿病；嚴格而言 type 2 打胰島素者亦可發生，但仍屬經典關聯敘述。（C）錯：超音波典型為不規則低回音腫塊伴「顯著後方聲影」，反映病灶質地「堅硬（hard）」而非「柔軟（soft）」，故「hypoechoic soft lesion」為不正確描述。（D）對：MRI 多呈邊界不清的腫塊伴對比強化，且顯影表現多變。

questions.questionText: 下列關於Breast implant associated complication之相關敘述，何者為**非**?

options.text: Early complication 包括Peri-implant fluid collection or hematoma及 Infection.
Capsular contracture 通常由臨床表現即可診斷.
Extra-capsular rupture於影像上可見植入物散落於breast parenchyma或 axillary lymph node處.
Extra-capsular rupture於影像上可見典型linguine sign、stepladder sign、 keyhole sign.

questions.reference: Raj, S. D., Karimova, E. J., Fishman, M. D., Fein-Zachary, V., Phillips, J., Dialani, V., & Slanetz, P. J. (2017). Imaging of breast implant–associated complications and pathologic conditions: breast imaging. Radiographics, 37(5), 1603-1604. Yang, N., & Muradali, D. (2011). The augmented breast: a pictorial review of the abnormal and unusual. American Journal of Roentgenology, 196(4), W451-W460. (D)應為Intra-capsular rupture；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p181
questions.explanation: 這些sign是intracapsular。

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about triangulation on mammogram is true?

options.text: Regarding lesion found only on MLO view, lesions in medial breast will move up on ML.
Regarding lesion found on MLO view, lesions in outer breast will move up on ML.
Regarding lesion found on CC view, lesions in superior breast will move discordant to the direction which the top breast is rolled.
For axillary tail lesions, exaggerated CC medial view would help.

questions.reference: 2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p179
questions.explanation: 答案 A。本題問乳房攝影三角定位（triangulation）何者「正確」，口訣「muffins rise, lead sinks」——由 MLO 換到 ML（true lateral）時，內側（medial）病灶上移、外側（lateral）病灶下移。（A）對：只見於 MLO 的病灶，若位於內側乳房，在 ML 上會「上移」（medial muffins rise）。（B）錯：外側（outer）病灶在 ML 上應「下移」（lateral lead sinks），並非上移。（C）錯：rolled CC view 中，上部病灶的移動方向與乳房上部被 roll 的方向「一致（concordant）」，而非相反。（D）錯：腋尾（axillary tail）病灶應以 exaggerated CC lateral（XCCL）而非 medial view 來顯示。→ [[mammography-positioning]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about malignant phyllodes tumor is **incorrect**?

options.text: Phyllodes tumors are a rare fibroepithelial neoplasm of the breast.
Definitive diagnosis requires surgical excision.
Breast ultrasound (US) demonstrated a large heterogeneous hypoechoic mass.
Metastatic spread is primarily lymphatic spread with nodal involvement

questions.reference: Breast J. 2020 Oct;26(10):2038-2041.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p343
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問惡性葉狀腫瘤（malignant phyllodes tumor）敘述何者「錯誤」。（A）對：葉狀腫瘤為罕見的乳房纖維上皮性腫瘤。（B）對：確診需靠手術切除後的完整組織評估（細針或粗針切片常無法可靠區分良惡）。（C）對：超音波典型呈大而不均質的低回音腫塊，可見內部囊狀裂隙。（D）錯：惡性葉狀腫瘤遠端轉移少見（<20%），一旦發生主要以「血行途徑」轉移至肺、肋膜、骨骼，淋巴轉移罕見，故不需腋窩淋巴結分期手術，本選項「以淋巴轉移為主」為不正確者。

questions.questionText: 有關Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm of the Pancreas (IPMN),以下 敘述, 何者**不是**favor malignancy 的 sign ?

options.text: Main pancreatic duct involvement
Marked dilatation of the main pancreatic duct > 15 mm
Calcified intraluminal contents
Normal caliber of the CBD
Large mural nodule > 3 mm

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2005; 25:1456；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p321
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問哪一項「不是」偏惡性（favor malignancy）徵象。IPMN 的高危／worrisome 徵象多與主胰管受累及壁結節有關：A 主胰管受累（main duct 型惡性率高）、B 主胰管明顯擴張（>15 mm）、E 大型壁結節（enhancing mural nodule）皆偏惡性；C 管腔內鈣化內容物依題目所引 RadioGraphics 2005;25:1456 亦與惡性相關。D 膽總管口徑正常代表無阻塞性黃疸，屬正常表現、並非偏惡性徵象，故為正解。→ [[pancreatic-ipmn]]

questions.questionText: 請問 hemochromatosis 主要影響那些器官?

options.text: heart
bone
lung
genitalia

imageOcr.markdown:
**HEMOCHROMATOSIS**
= excess iron deposition in tissues (hemosiderosis) resulting in tissue injury

**Primary / Idiopathic Hemochromatosis**
= autosomal recessive genetic disorder (abnormal iron-loading gene on short arm of chromosome 6) in thalassemia, sideroblastic anemia
- Defect: increased absorption + parenchymal accumulation of dietary iron
- Organs: liver, pancreas, heart (parenchymal iron overload)
- Homozygous frequency: 1÷200; M÷F = 1÷1
- Age: >30 years (M), usually after menopause (F); females protected by menstruation

questions.questionText: LIRADS v2018**不**適用在下列何種病人?

options.text: Cirrhosis
Chronic hepatitis C viral infection without cirrhosis
Current or prior HCC.
Recipient post adult liver transplantation with chronic hepatitis B viral infection

questions.reference: LIRADS v2018；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p143
questions.explanation: 答案 B。LI-RADS v2018 僅適用於 HCC 高危族群：肝硬化、慢性 B 型肝炎、或現有／曾有 HCC 者（含成人肝移植候選人與術後受贈者）。B 單純慢性 C 型肝炎而「無」肝硬化不在適用範圍，為正解（不適用）；A 肝硬化、C 現有或曾有 HCC、D 肝移植後合併慢性 B 肝皆屬適用族群。（註：部分機構如台大將無肝硬化之慢性 C 肝亦納入，惟原版 LI-RADS 不含。）→ [[hcc-imaging-diagnosis]]

questions.questionText: 有關The Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) 以下敘述何者 有**誤**?

options.text: 只用在liver cirrhosis background 與HBV infection 的病人
.所謂典型的 HCC features, 包括 non-rim arterial phase hyperenhancement
所謂典型的 HCC features, 包括 rim arterial phase hyperenhancement
所謂典型的 HCC features, 包括 non-peripheral washout
所謂典型的 HCC features, 包括 capsule

questions.reference: LI-RADS v2018 Core, American College of Radiology；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p317
questions.explanation: 答案 C。LI-RADS 典型 HCC 之動脈期高強化須為 non-rim（非環狀）；C 所述 rim arterial phase hyperenhancement 為環狀強化，偏向非 HCC 惡性（LR-M，如膽管癌），故為錯誤敘述、本題正解。B non-rim APHE、D non-peripheral washout、E capsule 皆為 HCC 主要特徵而正確；A 適用於肝硬化與 HBV 高危族群（敘述略簡但方向正確）。→ [[hcc-imaging-diagnosis]]

questions.explanation: 答案 E。Threshold growth（閾值生長）定義為 ≤6 個月內直徑增加 ≥50%（若前次影像間隔 >6 個月則須增 ≥100%；或 24 個月內新出現 ≥10 mm 之病灶），E 誤植為「≤12 個月」故錯誤、為正解。A 適用族群（肝硬化、慢性 B 肝、肝癌病史）、B LR-5＝definite HCC 不需切片、C 須具 non-rim APHE、D 另三主要徵象（enhancing capsule、nonperipheral washout、threshold growth）皆正確。→ [[hcc-imaging-diagnosis]]

questions.questionText: A substantial proportion of cases of usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) are due to connective tissue disease (CTD)-associated interstitial lung disease (ILD). Which CT ﬁndings listed below can help differentiate a UIP pattern of CTD-ILD from a UIP pattern of idiopathic pulmonary ﬁbrosis? [[Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis]]

options.text: straight-edge sign
anterior upper lobe sign
exuberant honeycombing sign
all above

questions.reference: CT Features of the Usual Interstitial Pneumonia Pattern: Differentiating Connective Tissue Disease–Associated Interstitial Lung Disease from Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis American Journal of Roentgenology. 2018;210: 307-313；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p357
questions.explanation: 答案 D。straight-edge sign、anterior upper lobe sign、exuberant honeycombing sign 三者都是傾向「結締組織疾病相關 UIP（CTD-ILD）」而非特發性 UIP/IPF 的線索，故 D（以上皆是）正確。anterior upper lobe sign：上肺葉有相當程度的網狀影、牽引性支氣管擴張與蜂窩化，且集中於前側。exuberant honeycombing sign：以周邊及基底為主的纖維化，以「大量誇張的蜂窩化」為主要表現。straight-edge sign：纖維化與正常肺之間呈與側胸壁垂直的平直界面（纖維化侷限於基底、未沿側緣往上延伸）。三個徵象出現皆提示 CTD-ILD，故 A、B、C 單選皆不足，正解為 D。（⚠️ 本題含影像，官方詳解 PDF 第 357 頁，影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。）→ [[ipf]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following tracheal disorder is characterized by nodularity of tracheal wall with sparing of the posterior tracheal wall?

options.text: Relapsing polychondritis
Tracheobronchial papillomatosis
Mournier-Kuhn disease
Tracheobronchopathia osteochondroplastica

questions.reference: Grainger & Allison’s Diagnostic Radiology Essentials 1.4 (53~55)；10.2214/AJR.09.4146；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p12
questions.explanation:
答案 D。題幹問「氣管壁呈結節狀（nodularity）增厚且保留後壁膜（membranous wall）」者為何。氣管後壁無軟骨、由 trachealis 肌構成，「保留後壁」把病灶限縮在軟骨環的前外側；再加上「結節狀」即指向 tracheobronchopathia osteochondroplastica（TBO）——其黏膜下的骨／軟骨結節自軟骨環長出、突入管腔形成結節，並常帶焦點粗鈣化，好發於氣管下 2/3。
(A) relapsing polychondritis 雖也保留後壁膜，但為前外側壁「平滑」的高衰減增厚合併軟骨破壞，非結節狀，且常伴耳鼻軟骨炎等全身線索，故非本題最佳答案。
(B) tracheobronchial papillomatosis 為 HPV 相關的多發 polypoid 軟組織結節、可沿氣道向肺內播散，並無「鈣化結節＋保留後壁」的型態。
(C) Mounier-Kuhn（tracheobronchomegaly）以氣管與主支氣管管腔瀰漫「擴大」為特徵（氣管 >3 cm），屬管徑異常而非管壁結節。
故答案為 (D) TBO。
→ [[tracheal-tumors]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is **true** about NSIP (non-specific interstitial pneumonia)?

options.text: the patients are usually older than patients with UIP
strong association with smoking
ground glass with or without associated distortion of airways is usually the dominant pattern
poorer prognosis than IPF

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging-Chest Part 1（I-2-34~37）；10.1371/journal.pone.0226084；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p11
questions.explanation:
答案 C。本題問關於 NSIP 何者「正確」。NSIP 的招牌影像是下肺／基底為主、對稱的毛玻璃影（GGO）為主要型態，纖維化型（fibrotic NSIP）並可合併網狀影與牽引性支氣管擴張（即氣道結構扭曲），故 (C)「以 GGO 為主、可伴或不伴氣道扭曲」為正確。
(A) 錯誤：NSIP 好發族群相對「較年輕」，UIP 病人年齡通常較大，方向相反。
(B) 錯誤：與抽菸強相關的是 UIP（好發年長男性、吸菸者）；NSIP 反而常見於年輕女性並強烈提示結締組織疾病，與抽菸無明確關聯。
(D) 錯誤：NSIP 預後優於 IPF/UIP，cellular NSIP 對免疫治療反應尤佳、中位存活可達 9 年以上，而非更差。
另 NSIP 相對 UIP 常見 subpleural sparing、honeycombing 罕見，是兩者的鏡像鑑別點。
→ [[nonspecific-interstitial-pneumonia]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about IgG4-related sclerosing mastitis is **incorrect**?

options.text: Microscopic examination showed a nodular lesion consisting of sclerotic stroma surrounded by dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates.
Specimen has increased IgG4-positive plasma cells.
Screening mammography usually shows coarse microcalcifications.
Most patients present with a painless mass with single or multiple lesions

questions.reference: Breast J. 2019 Nov;25(6):1251-1253.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p344
questions.explanation:
答案 C。本題問關於 IgG4 硬化性乳腺炎何者「錯誤」。(C) 稱篩檢乳房攝影常見粗大微鈣化（coarse microcalcifications），此敘述錯誤——IgG4 硬化性乳腺炎在乳房攝影上典型為界限不清的局部不對稱緻密影，一般「無鈣化」，故 (C) 為誤。
(A) 正確：顯微下為結節狀病灶，硬化性（storiform）間質被緻密淋巴漿細胞浸潤包繞、乳腺小葉萎縮，與 IgG4-RD 他處組織學一致。
(B) 正確：檢體可見 IgG4 陽性漿細胞增多（每高倍視野 >10、常呈 periductal 分布），為診斷要件之一。
(D) 正確：臨床多以無痛腫塊表現，可為單發或多發病灶，通常無皮膚變化或腋窩淋巴結腫大。
影像與乳癌重疊、常被歸為 BI-RADS 4/5 而需切片；確診後類固醇治療預後佳。
→ [[igg4-related-disease]]

questions.questionText: Characteristics of Benign tumor of lung in X-ray is ?

options.text: Size > 5 cm diameter
Cavitation
Peripheral location
Concentric dense calciﬁcation

questions.reference: 2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p329
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題問肺良性腫瘤在 X 光上的特徵。最可靠的良性線索是「良性型態的鈣化」，其中同心圓／層狀的緻密鈣化（concentric/laminated dense calcification）對應癒合性肉芽腫，屬明確的良性型態，故選 (D)。
(A) 直徑 >5 cm 的病灶體積愈大惡性機率愈高，偏向惡性而非良性。
(B) 空洞化（cavitation）常見於惡性（如壞死性肺癌）或感染，不是良性腫瘤的特徵。
(C) 周邊位置（peripheral location）對良惡性沒有鑑別特異度，不能據以判定良性。
補充：其他良性鈣化型態尚有中央（central）、瀰漫實心（diffuse/solid）與爆米花（popcorn，hamartoma）；偏心與點狀／不定形鈣化則屬可疑，須當惡性處理。
→ [[pulmonary-calcification]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is **false** about arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy?

options.text: fibrofatty replacement of the myocardium
more frequent in elder patients
regional aneurysms may be seen
regional RV wall motion abnormality, such as akinesia, dyskinesia, or dyssynchrony.

questions.reference: Cardiac MR Findings and Potential Diagnostic Pitfalls in Patients Evaluated for Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy; RadioGraphics 2014; 34:1553–1570；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p20
questions.explanation: 答案 B。ARVC 是一種遺傳性（多為 desmosome 基因突變）心肌病，典型好發於年輕成人與運動員，並非年長者，因此「more frequent in elder patients」是與事實相反的敘述，為本題所選的偽敘述。其餘均為 ARVC 的正確特徵：(A) 右心室心肌被脂肪與纖維組織進行性取代（fibrofatty replacement）是其病理本質；(C) 病灶區可見局部動脈瘤樣膨出（收縮期外凸、舒張期持續鼓起），好發於 triangle of dysplasia（RVOT、RV 心尖、下基底壁）；(D) 局部右心室室壁運動異常，如 akinesia、dyskinesia 或收縮不同步，是 2010 Task Force 影像準則的核心項目。→ [[arrhythmogenic-rv-dysplasia]]

questions.questionText: What is **NOT** criteria of ARVC by cardiac MR or cardiac CT?

options.text: RV EDV/BAS >= 110 ml/m2 for male, >=100 for female
RV EF < 40%
RV wall fatty infiltration
RV dyskinesia or scalloping of RV wall.

questions.reference: (J Am Coll Cardiol Img 2015;8:597–611)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p333
questions.explanation: 答案 C。依 2010 修訂版 Task Force 準則，心臟 MR 診斷 ARVC 必須「局部右心室運動異常」加上「定量指標」兩者並列；RV 心肌脂肪浸潤本身從未列入準則，且正常心肌、陳舊性梗塞與其他心肌病亦可見脂肪訊號，纖維脂肪取代須靠心內膜切片證實，故「RV wall fatty infiltration」不是心臟 MR/CT 的診斷準則，為本題所選。其餘皆為現行準則採用之定量或形態項目：(A) RV 舒張末容積經體表面積校正 ≥110 mL/m²（男）或 ≥100 mL/m²（女）為 major；(B) RVEF ≤40% 為 major；(D) 局部 RV dyskinesia 或室壁 scalloping 屬必備的區域性室壁運動異常。→ [[arvc-diagnostic-criteria]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following is **not** a characteristic of a vulnerable plaque on coronary computed tomography angiography?

options.text: Positive remodeling.
Spotty calciﬁcation.
Napkin ring sign.
High attenuation.

questions.reference: JACC: Cardiovascular Imaging 2016;9:1099-1113；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p364
questions.explanation: 答案 D。冠狀動脈 CT 上易損（高風險）斑塊的指標是「低密度」而非高密度——富含脂質的壞死核心呈 low-attenuation plaque（多 <30 HU），因此「high attenuation」與易損斑塊特徵相反，為本題所選的非特徵。其餘三者皆為公認的高風險斑塊徵象（一般需符合至少兩項）：(A) positive remodeling，斑塊處管壁向外代償擴張、管腔反而保留；(B) spotty calcification，直徑 <3 mm 的點狀鈣化；(C) napkin-ring sign，中央低密度核心外圍環繞一圈較高密度的「餐巾環」。→ [[ccta]]

imageOcr.markdown:
Positive remodeling: outer vessel diameter with a threshold of 1.1 was used.

Low HU plaque was defined as the mean CT number within these 3 regions of interest <30 HU.

The napkin-ring sign was defined as a ring-like peripheral higher attenuation.

Spotty calcium was defined as calcified plaque with a diameter <3 mm in any direction.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is **false** about anomalous origin of coronary artery?

options.text: The ALCAPA syndrome (anomalous origin of the left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery) is among the differential diagnoses for massive cardiomegaly in the newborn
Artery courses downward (hammock sign) below the crista supraventricularis in interarterial course
Prepulmonic coronary arteries are particularly common in tetralogy of Fallot (D)Transseptal course does not have an oblong or slitlike orifice

questions.reference: Identifying, Characterizing, and Classifying Congenital Anomalies of the Coronary Arteries; RadioGraphics 2012; 32:453–468；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p18
questions.explanation: 答案 B。hammock sign（冠狀動脈向下走行、位於室上嵴 crista supraventricularis 下方、肺動脈瓣下 RVOT 層面）屬於 transseptal（subpulmonic）變異，而非 interarterial course，因此「in interarterial course」是張冠李戴的錯誤敘述，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(A) ALCAPA（左冠狀動脈起源自肺動脈，Bland-White-Garland）因整個冠狀系統擴大扭曲，是新生兒期巨大心臟的鑑別診斷之一；(C) 橫越右心室流出道的 prepulmonic 冠狀動脈好發於法洛四聯症，術前須標明以免傷及跨越 RVOT 之血管；(D) transseptal 為良性走行，不具裂縫狀（slit-like）或橢圓形開口——裂縫狀開口是惡性 interarterial/intramural 走行的高風險形態。→ [[acaos]]

| --- | --- |
| Artery is surrounded by septal myocardium | Artery is surrounded by epicardial fat |
| Artery courses downward (hammock sign), below the crista supraventricularis | Artery does not have a downward course |
| Artery does not have an oblong or slitlike orifice | Artery may have an oblong or slitlike orifice |

It is characterized by severe atherosclerotic stenosis or occlusion from suprarenal aorta to iliac arteries
Many patients remain asymptomatic due to the development of robust collateral networks
It is a type D lesion according to the Trans Atlantic Inter Society Consensus II (TASC II) and surgery is recommended as the treatment of choice

questions.reference: 1. Abdom Radiol (2017) 42:2346–2357 DOI: 10.1007/s00261-017-1137-0 2. Journal of Vascular Surgery Volume 45, Issue 1, Supplement , S5-S67, Janjuary DOI:10.1016/j.jvs.2006.12.037；10.1007/s00261-017-1137-0；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p88
questions.explanation: 答案 B。主動脈髂動脈阻塞病（Leriche syndrome）侵犯的是「腎動脈以下（infrarenal）」的腹主動脈及/或髂動脈，並非從腎上（suprarenal）主動脈開始，因此 B 的「from suprarenal aorta」為錯誤敘述，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(A) 本病又稱 Leriche syndrome，典型三聯為跛行、股動脈搏動消失與陽痿；(C) 因側枝循環發達（如腰動脈-髂動脈側枝），不少病人可長期無明顯症狀；(D) 依 TASC II 分類，瀰漫性的腎下主動脈髂動脈阻塞屬 type D 病灶，傳統上以外科繞道手術為首選治療。→ [[pad-peripheral-arterial]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table F1. TASC classification of aorto-iliac lesions**

| Type | Lesions |
|---|---|
| Type A lesions | Unilateral or bilateral stenoses of CIA；Unilateral or bilateral single short (≤3 cm) stenosis of EIA |
| Type B lesions | Short (≤3 cm) stenosis of infrarenal aorta；Unilateral CIA occlusion；Single or multiple stenosis totaling 3–10 cm involving the EIA not extending into the CFA；Unilateral EIA occlusion not involving the origins of internal iliac or CFA |
| Type C lesions | Bilateral CIA occlusions；Bilateral EIA stenoses 3–10 cm long not extending into the CFA；Unilateral EIA stenosis extending into the CFA；Unilateral EIA occlusion that involves the origins of internal iliac and/or CFA；Heavily calcified unilateral EIA occlusion with or without involvement of origins of internal iliac and/or CFA |
| Type D lesions | Infra-renal aortoiliac occlusion；Diffuse disease involving the aorta and both iliac arteries requiring treatment；Diffuse multiple stenoses involving the unilateral CIA, EIA and CFA；Unilateral occlusions of both CIA and EIA；Bilateral occlusions of EIA；Iliac stenoses in patients with AAA requiring treatment and not amenable to endograft placement or other lesions requiring open aortic or iliac surgery |

CIA = common iliac artery；EIA = external iliac artery；CFA = common femoral artery；AAA = abdominal aortic aneurysm。

**Recommendation 36 — Treatment of aortoiliac lesions**
- TASC A and D lesions: Endovascular therapy is the treatment of choice for type A lesions and surgery is the treatment of choice for type D lesions [C].
- TASC B and C lesions: Endovascular treatment is the preferred treatment for type B lesions and surgery is the preferred treatment for good-risk patients with type C lesions. The patient's co-morbidities, fully informed patient preference and the local operator's long-term success rates must be considered when making treatment recommendations for type B and type C lesions [C].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is **not** correct about the native T1 value in T1 mapping of cardiovascular magnetic resonance?

options.text: The native T1 value in myocarditis is increased.
The native T1 value in cardiac amyloidosis is increased
The native T1 value in Fabry’s disease is decreased.
The native T1 value in siderotic cardiomyopathy is increased.

questions.reference: Journal of Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance 2017;19:75；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p363
questions.explanation: 答案 D。native T1 值上升代表組織含水量增加或間質空間擴大，下降則見於細胞內脂質或鐵沉積。鐵過載型（siderotic）心肌病因鐵的順磁性效應會使 native T1「下降」而非上升，因此 D 為錯誤敘述，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(A) 心肌炎的心肌水腫使 native T1 上升；(B) 心臟類澱粉沉積造成細胞外間質擴張，native T1 上升；(C) Anderson-Fabry 病因醣鞘脂在細胞內堆積（脂質過載），native T1 下降，且常在左心室肥厚出現前即已降低。→ [[myocardial-t1-mapping]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 5 Typical alterations of T1, T2, T2\* relaxation times and ECV according to pathology.（further details see Captur et al. [194]）**

| Measure | Decrease | Mild increase | Moderate or severe increase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Native T1 | Anderson-Fabry, iron overload, fat, hemorrhage (athlete's heart) | diffuse fibrosis, scar, subacute inflammation | amyloid, acute inflammation, acute ischemia, necrosis |
| ECV | athlete's heart | diffuse fibrosis | amyloid, necrosis, scar |
| T2 | iron, hemorrhage | subacute inflammation | acute inflammation, acute ischemia, necrosis |
| T2\* | iron, hemorrhage, stress-induced ischemia | — | — |

questions.questionText: About Congenitally Corrected Transposition of the Great Arteries (CCTGA), which of the following is **not** appropriate?

options.text: there is leftward looping of the primitive heart tube instead of the usual D-loop
connection of the aorta to the RV and the PA to the LV
Deoxygenated blood enters the LA and through the mitral valve flows into the discordant LV and then to the PA
The oxygenated pulmonary venous blood returns to the left atrium, and through the tricuspid valve flows into the discordant RV and into the aorta

questions.reference: Multimodality Imaging of Transposition of the Great Arteries; RadioGraphics 2021; 41:338–360；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p7
questions.explanation: 答案 C。CCTGA（L-TGA）為房室不一致加上心室大動脈不一致的「雙重不一致」，兩處錯接互相抵銷而達生理矯正。全身回流的去氧血是進入「右心房」，再經二尖瓣流入不一致的形態學左心室、送往肺動脈；C 卻寫成去氧血「進入左心房（LA）」，房室腔搞錯，為本題所選的錯誤敘述。其餘皆正確：(A) 原始心管為左旋（L-looping）而非一般的 D-loop；(B) 主動脈接形態學右心室、肺動脈接形態學左心室；(D) 含氧的肺靜脈血回左心房，經三尖瓣流入不一致的形態學右心室，再送入主動脈。→ [[d-tga]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is **false** about Takayasu disease?

options.text: stenosis or coarctation are not common
granulomatous large vessel vasculitis that predominantly aﬀects the aorta and its major branches
aneurysm may occur
typically occurs in young woman

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging-Chest Part 2（II-2-44~47）；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p17
questions.explanation: 答案 A。本題問「何者為錯」，A 稱狹窄或縮窄（stenosis／coarctation）不常見，恰恰相反——高安氏動脈炎為節段性肉芽腫發炎，纖維化區會造成血管狹窄與閉塞，狹窄其實是最常見的結構後果，故 A 為錯誤敘述（正解）。B 正確：屬肉芽腫性大血管炎，主要侵犯主動脈及其主要分支（亦可及肺動脈）。C 正確：破壞區可退化形成動脈瘤。D 正確：典型好發於 40 歲以下的年輕（尤其亞洲）女性，女男比約 8–9:1。→ [[takayasu-arteritis]]

questions.questionText: Pericardial calcification is caused by all **except**?

options.text: Radiotherapy to the mediastinum
Methysergide therapy
Anticoagulant therapy
Benign pericarditis
Dermatomyositis

questions.reference: 2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p328
questions.explanation: 答案 E。心包鈣化來自心包發炎或積血後的鈣沉積，凡能造成心包炎或心包積血的病因都可能導致鈣化。皮肌炎（dermatomyositis）的鈣化以皮下與肌肉軟組織的 calcinosis 為主，並不累及心包，因此 E 是唯一的「except」，為本題所選。其餘皆為公認或有文獻記載的成因：(A) 縱膈放射治療是現代心包鈣化與縮窄性心包炎的常見成因；(C) 抗凝血治療造成心包積血、日後鈣化；(D) 良性（含感染性、尤以結核最厚最典型）心包炎後遺鈣化；(B) methysergide 所致的縮窄性心包炎雖僅屬罕見的案例報告層級，仍歸於「可致」之列。→ [[pericardial-calcification]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about avulsion fractures of the knee is **WRONG** ?

options.text: Stieda fracture - Avulsion injury at medial femoral condyle
Segond fracture - Avulsion injury at lateral tibial plateau
Gerdy tubercle - Avulsion injury at tibial tuberosity
Larsen-Johansson syndrome - Avulsion injury at inferior pole of the patella

questions.reference: 明書名,頁次 https://radiopaedia.org/articles/avulsion-fractures-of-the-kn ee；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p30
questions.explanation: 答案 C。Gerdy 結節位於脛骨前外側，是腸脛束（iliotibial band）的附著點，其撕脫並非發生在脛骨粗隆，故 C 的配對錯誤；脛骨粗隆（tibial tuberosity）才是髕韌帶附著處，該處的牽引性撕脫即 Osgood-Schlatter。其餘配對正確：A Stieda fracture 為內側股骨髁的內側副韌帶撕脫（即 Pellegrini-Stieda）；B Segond fracture 為脛骨外側平台邊緣的外側關節囊韌帶／前外側韌帶（ALL）撕脫，常伴前十字韌帶斷裂；D Sinding-Larsen-Johansson 為髕骨下極的牽引性撕脫。→ [[avulsion-fracture-attachments]]

questions.questionText: About Osteoarthritis (**OA**), which of the following is **not** appropriate?

options.text: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a progressive degenerative disease that is the most frequent cause of pain in facet joints
OA cannot be found in adults under 30 years of age
OA can be found in almost all elderly people after age 60 years
The prevalence and degree of OA being higher at the L4-L5 level, followed by L3-L4 and L5-S1

questions.reference: Differential Diagnosis of Facet Joint Disorders; RadioGraphics 2021; 41:543–558；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p4
questions.explanation: 答案 B。約 50% 的 30 歲以下成人其實已可見某種程度的 facet 退化性關節病，故「30 歲以下找不到 OA」的敘述錯誤。其餘正確：A facet OA 為進行性退化疾病，是小面關節疼痛最常見的原因；C facet 退化隨年齡增加，約 95% 的 60 歲以上長者皆有某種程度退化，可謂幾乎人人都有；D 盛行率與嚴重度以 L4–L5 節段最高，其次為 L3–L4、L5–S1。→ [[facet-joint-osteoarthritis]]

questions.questionText: About **gout**, which of the following is **not** appropriate?

options.text: Gout is a metabolic disease that results from monosodium urate crystal deposits in the synovium and juxta-articular tissues
The peak incidence occurs at 30–50 years of age
Gouty lesions mainly involve axial skeleton such as laminae, pedicles, vertebral bodies, ligaments, facet joints, intervertebral disks, and epidural spaces
CT is helpful in depicting bone erosions caused by tophi, which are present in 50% of cases of tophaceous gout, as well as soft-tissue involvement

questions.reference: Differential Diagnosis of Facet Joint Disorders; RadioGraphics 2021; 41:543–558；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p5
questions.explanation: 答案 C。痛風病灶主要侵犯周邊關節（以第一蹠趾關節 podagra 最典型，其次手足小關節、踝、腕），呈不對稱多關節分布；中軸骨（椎板、椎弓根、椎體、韌帶、facet、椎間盤、硬膜外腔）雖「可能」受侵，但並非主要部位，故稱「主要侵犯中軸骨」為錯。其餘正確：A 痛風為單鈉尿酸鹽（MSU）結晶沉積於滑膜與關節旁組織所致的代謝性關節病；B 發病高峰約 30–50 歲；D CT 對痛風石造成的骨糜爛與軟組織侵犯顯示佳，骨糜爛見於約半數（50%）慢性痛風石病例。→ [[gout-imaging]]

questions.questionText: About Calcium Pyrophosphate Deposition Disease (**CPPD**), which of the following is **not** appropriate?

options.text: also known as pseudogout
represents an inflammatory response to the deposition of calcium pyrophosphate crystals in hyaline cartilage, fibrocartilage, and periarticular structures
occurs more frequently in the spine, where it most commonly involves the cervical region
In the spine, crystals can be found most commonly in the ligamentum flavum, posterior longitudinal ligaments, and atlanto-occipital ligaments and less frequently can affect the intervertebral disks

questions.reference: Differential Diagnosis of Facet Joint Disorders; RadioGraphics 2021; 41:543–558；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p6
questions.explanation: 答案 C。CPPD 造成的軟骨鈣化好發於大關節（膝、髖、腕、恥骨聯合），脊椎受侵犯相對罕見；因此「較常發生於脊椎」的敘述錯誤——正確應為大關節優先、脊椎為少見的例外（例外時才多在頸椎）。其餘正確：A CPPD 又稱假性痛風（pseudogout）；B 其本質為對焦磷酸鈣結晶沉積於透明軟骨、纖維軟骨與關節周圍結構的發炎反應；D 一旦侵犯脊椎，結晶最常見於黃韌帶、後縱韌帶與寰枕韌帶，較少影響椎間盤。→ [[cppd-chondrocalcinosis]]

questions.questionText: Regarding the MRI protocol for evaluation of diabetic pedal disease, which of the following statements is **TRUE**?

options.text: The head coil is recommended for imaging both feet at once.
Field of view should always be large to include the lower calf.
No fat suppression is needed for T2-weighted imaging.
A STIR sequence can be useful to provide more homogeneous fat suppression.
IV gadolinium contrast material provides no benefit.

questions.reference: American Journal of Roentgenology. 2008;190: S18-S22. 10.2214/AJR.07.7023；10.2214/AJR.07.7023；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p339
questions.explanation: 答案 D。STIR 為非選擇性、依脂肪短 T1 反轉來抑制訊號的序列，對磁場不均（足部小骨眾多、易有磁化率變化）相對不敏感，故能提供比頻率選擇性（frequency-selective）更均勻的脂肪抑制，適合糖尿病足評估，D 為真。其餘為錯：A 用 head coil 同時掃兩足看似有效率，實則影像品質不佳，每隻腳應分開成像；B FOV 不應一律放大，過大的 FOV 會使足部小骨受體積平均效應影響而判讀受限，僅在臨床懷疑感染向近端擴散時才納入小腿；C T2 加權須使用脂肪抑制，否則骨髓與皮下脂肪的高訊號會掩蓋細微水腫；E 靜脈注射釓對比劑有助於辨識膿瘍、竇道與壞死區，並鑑別蜂窩組織炎、感染性關節炎與腱鞘炎。→ [[msk-mri-fat-suppression-magic-angle]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements about fractures around the ankle is TRUE?

options.text: **Pilon fractures** are usually due to external rotation injuries.
Extension of a **talar neck** fracture through the talar dome articular surface is associated with a high rate of posttraumatic arthritis.
The risk of **talar dome** avascular necrosis after a talar neck fracture is high if the fracture extends through the anterior process.
Fractures of the **sustentaculum tali** are usually due to avulsion by the deltoid ligament.
The blood supply to the talar dome enters at the anterior process.

questions.reference: American Journal of Roentgenology. 2008;190: S18-S22. 10.2214/AJR.07.7023；10.2214/AJR.07.7023；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p340
questions.explanation: 答案 B。距骨頸骨折若延伸穿過距骨頂（talar dome）關節面，會造成關節面不平整，日後創傷後關節炎發生率高，B 為正確敘述。其餘為錯：A pilon 骨折多為軸向負荷機轉（如高處墜落），而非外旋損傷；C 距骨缺血性壞死（AVN）風險與距下關節或踝關節的半脫位／脫位相關，與是否侵犯 anterior process 無關；D sustentaculum tali 骨折多源於軸向負荷造成的垂直剪力，而非三角韌帶（deltoid ligament）撕脫；E 距骨頂的血供來自脛前動脈分支，於距骨頸（talar neck）進入，而非 anterior process。→ [[talus-anatomy]]

questions.questionText: What are the typical MRI characteristics of neoplastic marrow involvement?

options.text: Isointense to muscle on T1, lack of signal dropout on out-of-phase imaging.
Hyperintense to muscle on T1, lack of signal dropout on out-of-phase imaging.
Isointense to muscle on T1, signal dropout on out-of-phase imaging.
Hyperintense to muscle on T1, signal dropout on out-of-phase imaging.
Hypointense to muscle on T2, lack of signal dropout on out-of-phase imaging..

questions.reference: American Journal of Roentgenology. 2009;193: S5-S9. 10.2214/AJR.07.7088；10.2214/AJR.07.7088；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p342
questions.explanation: 答案 A。腫瘤浸潤會取代正常骨髓脂肪，故在 T1 呈與肌肉等訊號（或更低），在流體敏感序列高於肌肉；因病灶內缺乏殘存脂肪，反相位（out-of-phase／opposed-phase）影像不會出現訊號下降，A 正確。相對地，正常紅髓 T1 高於肌肉、且反相位會掉訊號。故其餘為錯：B、D 稱 T1 高於肌肉，與「脂肪被取代」的取代性病變矛盾（較像正常紅髓）；C、D 稱反相位有訊號下降，屬正常紅髓（含微觀脂肪）的表現；E 稱 T2 低於肌肉，與腫瘤在流體敏感序列呈高訊號相反。→ [[bone-marrow]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a radiographic feature of melorheostosis?

options.text: Typically involve the metaphysis.
Dripping candle wax sign.
Limb length discrepancy.
Associated with osteopoikilosis.

questions.reference: Dahnert Radiology Review Manual 7th ed., p. 122；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p254
questions.explanation: 答案 A。Melorheostosis 好發於四肢長骨（下肢多於上肢），沿骨皮質呈「流蠟樣」流動、依硬節（sclerotome）分布並可跨關節，並非以幹骺端（metaphysis）為好發部位，故 A 不是其影像特徵（本題要選「非」特徵）。其餘皆為真正特徵：B dripping candle wax（流蠟）徵象為其招牌；C 可造成肢體變形、攣縮與肢體長度差異；D 可與 osteopoikilosis 併存（同屬硬化性骨發育不良、共同 LEMD3 突變）。→ [[sclerosing-bone-dysplasias]]

questions.questionText: Which is **incorrect** concerning Osgood-Schlatter Disease?

options.text: Osteochondrosis of the tibial tuberosity
More commonly found in adult than adolescents
Fragmental on of the tibial tuberosity becomes apparent after 3 or 4 weeks after injury.
Patient present with pain, so tissue swelling and tenderness in the anterior knee

questions.reference: p80 Musculoskeletal imaging Case Review Series. Second Edition Joseph S Yu；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p59
questions.explanation: 答案 B。Osgood-Schlatter disease 是活躍青少年的脛骨粗隆牽引性骨骺炎，好發男性 10–15 歲、女性 8–12 歲，並非成人較常見，故 B 敘述不正確。其餘正確：A 其本質為脛骨粗隆的骨軟骨病（osteochondrosis）；C 脛骨粗隆骨化中心的碎裂化通常在受傷後約 3–4 週才顯現；D 病人典型以前膝疼痛、局部軟組織腫脹與壓痛表現。→ [[osgood-schlatter-disease]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following description regarding pineal germinoma is **FALSE**?

options.text: Most common pineal tumor.
More common in males than in females.
May present with Parinaud syndrome.
None of the above.

questions.reference: Dahner Radiology Review Manual 7th ed., p. 324；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p256
questions.explanation:
from Radiology review manual

⚠️ 本題含影像（官方詳解 PDF 第 256 頁），影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。

imageOcr.markdown:
**PINEAL GERMINOMA**
= DYSGERMINOMA = PINEALOMA = ATYPICAL TERATOMA (former inaccurate names)
◊ "pinealoma" = misnomer referring to any pineal mass
= malignant primitive germ cell neoplasm
- Incidence: most common pineal tumor (>50% of all pineal tumors, 66% of pineal germ cell tumors)
- Histo: identical to testicular seminoma + ovarian dysgerminoma, NO capsule facilitates invasion
- Age: 10–25 years; M÷F = 10÷1 to 33÷1
- May be associated with: ectopic pinealoma = secondary focus in inferior portion of 3rd ventricle
- precocious puberty frequent in children <10 years of age

- **Parinaud syndrome** = paralysis of upward gaze (compression of mesencephalic tectum)
- Location of germinomas: pineal gland (80%), suprasellar region (20%), basal ganglia, thalamus
- √ displacement of calcified pineal gland
- √ hydrocephalus (compression of aqueduct of Sylvius)
- √ well-defined lesion restricted to pineal gland
- √ may infiltrate quadrigeminal plate / thalamus

questions.questionText: Which level does the left recurrent laryngeal nerve exit from the vagus nerve?

options.text: Skull base
Carotid bulb
Thyroid cartilage
Aortic arch

questions.reference: Radiographics 2012; 32: 721-740；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p288
questions.explanation: 答案 D。左喉返神經（RLN）是在左迷走神經行經主動脈弓前外側時分出的，分支後繞行主動脈弓下方（位於動脈韌帶後方、經主肺動脈窗），再沿左氣管食道溝上行入喉，故其自迷走神經分出的高度在「主動脈弓」。A 顱底、B 頸動脈球、C 甲狀軟骨皆非左 RLN 分出之處；而右側 RLN 才是在較高處繞右鎖骨下動脈折返，與左側不同。→ [[posterior-mediastinum-nerves]]

questions.questionText: Warthin tumor of salivary gland is associated with all of the following choices **EXCEPT**?

options.text: The most common benign neoplasms of major salivary glands.
The relationship between smoking and development of Warthin tumors has been proved.
At US, Warthin tumors are oval, hypoechoic, well-defined tumors and often contain multiple anechoic areas.
Warthin tumors may also appear in the form of a simple cyst simple cyst at US and thus require differentiation from other cystic neoplasms.
10-60% of cases, tumors may occur bilaterally or multifocally.

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging Ultrasound, 1st edition, Section 11, P76-79；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p404
questions.explanation: 答案 A。本題問 Warthin tumor「除何者以外」皆相關，A 稱它是主要唾液腺最常見的良性腫瘤為錯——最常見的良性唾液腺腫瘤是多形性腺瘤（pleomorphic adenoma／mixed tumor），Warthin 居次，故 A 不適用於 Warthin。B 正確：Warthin 與吸菸有明確相關。C 正確：超音波下典型為卵圓形、低回音、邊界清楚，且常含多個無回音區。D 正確：也可呈單純囊腫樣，需與其他囊性腫瘤鑑別。E 正確：約 10–60% 可雙側或多發，為 Warthin 的特色。→ [[salivary-gland-ultrasound]]

questions.questionText: Mixed tumor of salivary gland is associated with all of the following choices **EXCEPT**?

options.text: The most common benign neoplasms of major salivary glands.
Also named pleomorphic adenoma.
Mixed tumors are usually solitary and unilateral.
Mixed tumors occur most often in the submandibular gland.
At US, pleomorphic adenomas are hypoechoic, well-defined, lobulated tumors with posterior acoustic enhancement and may contain calcifications.

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging Ultrasound, 1st edition, Section 11, P58-61; P72-75；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p405
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問混合瘤（pleomorphic adenoma）「除何者以外」皆相關，D 稱它最常發生於下頜下腺為錯——多形性腺瘤絕大多數發生於腮腺（約 84%，且多在淺葉），下頜下腺僅約 8%、小唾液腺約 6.5%。A 正確：為主要唾液腺最常見的良性腫瘤。B 正確：即又名 pleomorphic adenoma。C 正確：通常為單發、單側。E 正確：超音波下呈低回音、邊界清楚、分葉狀、具後方聲增強，並可含鈣化。→ [[salivary-gland-ultrasound]]

questions.questionText: Regarding moyamoya syndrome, which of the following causes is not an established etiology?

options.text: Neuroﬁbromatosis type I
Down syndrome
Kasabach-Merritt syndrome
Bacterial meningitis

questions.reference: 1. McCartyJL,LeungLY,PetersonRB,SittonCW,SarrajA,RiascosRF,BrinjikjiW. IschemicInfarctioninYoungAdults:AReviewforRadiologists.Radiographics.2019 Oct;39(6):1629-1648. doi: 10.1148/rg.2019190033. PMID: 31589580. 2.DouZ,ChenH,ChengH,LiuG.Moyamoyasyndromeafterbacterialmeningitis. Pediatr Investig. 2018 Jul 16;2(2):134-136. doi: 10.1002/ped4.12048. PMID: 32851248; PMCID: PMC7331372.；10.1148/rg.2019190033.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p396
questions.explanation: 答案 C。本題問何者「非」moyamoya syndrome 的確立病因，C 的 Kasabach-Merritt 症候群為正解——它是快速增長的血管腫瘤所致的血小板減少、微血管病性溶血與消耗性凝血病，與 moyamoya 型的進行性內頸動脈末端狹窄／基底側支增生無關。A 神經纖維瘤病第一型（屬 phakomatoses）與 B 唐氏症皆為公認的相對常見相關病因；D 細菌性腦膜炎後續發 moyamoya 雖較罕見，但有病例報告支持，屬已知病因之一，故非答案。→ [[moyamoya]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 1. Moyamoya syndrome-associated diseases and conditions**

| 分組 | 疾病 |
|---|---|
| Relatively common moyamoya syndrome | Neurofibromatosis type 1；Down syndrome；Thyroid disease；Cranial irradiation；Sickle cell anemia |
| Extremely rare moyamoya syndrome | Systemic lupus erythematosus；Turner syndrome；Noonan syndrome；Alagille syndrome |

**Table 1. CT Radiation Dose Parameters**

| Dose Parameter | Definition | Effects on Radiation Dose | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tube potential or voltage | X-ray beam energy | Proportional to square of tube voltage change | kV |
| Product of tube current and time | Photon fluence; number of photons in defined exposure time | Directly proportional to radiation dose | mAs |
| Pitch | Ratio of table feed per gantry rotation to nominal width of beam collimation | Inversely proportional to radiation dose | - |
| CTDIw | Average radiation dose in scan volume measured in standard CT phantoms; 1/3 CTDI center + 2/3 CTDI periphery | Directly proportional to radiation dose in unit volume, influenced by pitch factor | mGy |
| CTDIvol | CTDIw/pitch | Directly proportional to radiation dose in unit volume, irrespective of pitch factor | mGy |
| Dose-length product | CTDIvol x scan length (cm) | Directly proportional to total scanned radiation dose | mGy·cm |
| Effective dose | Overall risk-related radiation exposure; Σ W_T (tissue weighting factor) x H_T (tissue equivalent dose) | Directly proportional to total scanned radiation dose and overall risk of irradiated tissue | mSv |

Note — CTDIvol = volume CT dose index, CTDIw = weighted CT dose index

questions.questionText: Which one of the following descriptions about lactate in [[MRS]] is **wrong**?

options.text: Lactate is a marker of anaerobic metabolism.
Double peak at 1.3 ppm on spectra obtained with a short echo time (35 msec),
Inversion below the baseline on spectra obtained with intermediate echo times (135–144 msec)
Lactate peak is overlaid with GABA peak

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2014; 34:1047–1061  (1058-1059 頁)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p302
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問「何者錯誤」，D 稱 lactate peak 與 GABA peak 重疊為錯——lactate 峰（1.3 ppm）實際是與相鄰的 lipid 峰（約 0.9–1.3 ppm）重疊，可利用 intermediate TE（135–144 ms）使 lactate doublet 反轉至基線下、而 lipid 不反轉，藉此區分二者。A 正確：lactate 為無氧代謝的標記。B 正確：於 1.3 ppm 呈雙峰（doublet，源自 J-coupling），短 TE 時可見。C 正確：intermediate TE 時 lactate 反轉至基線下方。→ [[mr-spectroscopy-brain]]

questions.questionText: Which is **not** one of signs of vocal cord paralysis at CT?

options.text: Ipsilateral piriform sinus dilatation
Medial rotation and thickening of the aryepiglottic fold
Lateral displacement of ipsilateral arytenoids cartilage
Ipsilateral laryngeal ventricle dilatation

questions.reference: Radiographics 2012; 32: 721-740；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p287
questions.explanation: 答案 C。本題問何者「不是」聲帶麻痺（VCP）的 CT 徵象，C 稱同側杓狀軟骨向外側（lateral）移位為錯——聲帶麻痺時因後環杓肌（主要外展肌）失能，杓狀軟骨反而被固定並向「前內側（anteromedial）」半脫位、後段聲帶邊緣內移，方向與 C 相反。A、B、D 皆為軸位 CT 上最敏感的正確徵象：A 同側梨狀窩擴張、B 杓會厭皺襞內旋並增厚、D 同側喉室擴張（皆因患側喉部鬆弛而充氣擴張）。→ [[larynx-hypopharynx-subsite-anatomy]]

questions.questionText: Fat appears ________ on T1 weighted SE images, and fluids appear ________ on T2 weighted images.

options.text: bright; bright
bright; dark
dark; bight
dark; dark

questions.reference: Huda, Walter, and Richard M. Slone. Review of radiologic physics, 4th ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins, 2003: 206, 223, 234.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p43
questions.explanation: 答案 A（bright；bright）。脂肪的縱向磁化回復快（短 T1），在 T1 加權影像上呈高訊號（亮）；水／體液具長 T2，橫向磁化衰減慢，在 T2 加權影像上呈高訊號（亮）。因此脂肪於 T1WI、體液於 T2WI 皆為 bright。其餘選項（bright；dark、dark；bright、dark；dark）皆與此物理原理不符。→ [[mri-tissue-signal-t1-t2-basics]]

questions.questionText: According to cIMPACT (the Consortium to Inform Molecular and Practical Approaches to CNS Tumor Taxonomy) proposed (2020) changes to diffuse glioma classification, which one is **wrong**?

options.text: All glioblastoma will be IDHwt
All glioblastoma will be IDHmt
All diffuse astrocytoma will be IDHmt,
All diffuse astrocytoma will be graded based on histological and molecular phenotype to grades 2 through 4

questions.reference: Assoc Prof Frank Gaillard and Dr Mendel Castle et al. cIMPACT recommendations for the classification of diffuse gliomas 2020.  Retrieved from https://radiopaedia.org/；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p173
questions.explanation: 答案 B。本題問「何者錯誤」，B 稱所有膠質母細胞瘤都會是 IDH-mutant 為錯——依 cIMPACT-NOW 與 2021 WHO CNS 分類，glioblastoma 一詞已專指 IDH-wildtype，並維持 grade 4；帶 IDH 突變者不再稱 GBM，改歸為 astrocytoma。故 A（所有 GBM 皆 IDH-wildtype）正確，與 B 恰相反；C（所有 diffuse astrocytoma 皆 IDH-mutant）正確；D（diffuse astrocytoma 依組織學與分子表型分為 grade 2 至 4）正確。→ [[gbm]]

questions.questionText: According to cIMPACT (the Consortium to Inform Molecular and Practical Approaches to CNS Tumor Taxonomy) proposed (2020) changes to IDHwt diffuse gliomas, which molecular phenotype is not included in the expanded diagnostic criteria for IDHwt glioblastoma ?

options.text: Microvascular proliferation or necrosis
TERT promoter mutation
EGFR gene amplification
whole chromosome 7 gain AND whole chromosome 10 loss (+7/-10)
All the above are included

questions.reference: Assoc Prof Frank Gaillard and Dr Mendel Castle et al. cIMPACT recommendations for the classification of diffuse gliomas 2020.  Retrieved from https://radiopaedia.org/；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p175
questions.explanation: 答案 E。本題問哪一個分子表型「不」屬於 IDH-wildtype glioblastoma 的擴充診斷準則，正解是 E（以上皆屬於）——依 2021 WHO／cIMPACT-NOW update 3，在成人、瀰漫性星狀細胞瘤且 IDH-wildtype 的前提下，除了 A（壞死或微血管增生，屬原有組織學標準）之外，另納入三項分子標準：B（TERT promoter mutation）、C（EGFR 基因擴增）、D（第 7 對染色體整體獲得＋第 10 對整體缺失，+7/−10）。只要具備任一項，即可將組織學看似低度的 IDHwt astrocytoma 升級診斷為 glioblastoma（grade 4）。因此四者皆為納入項目，答案為 E。→ [[gbm]]

questions.questionText: According to cIMPACT (the Consortium to Inform Molecular and Practical Approaches to CNS Tumor Taxonomy) proposed (2020) changes to IDHmt diffuse gliomas, which one is **wrong**?

options.text: The new recommendations to the classification system involve the removal of IDHmt glioblastoma and the institution of IDHmt astrocytoma grading up to WHO grade 4.
IDHmt astrocytoma will be graded based on histology and the presence or absence of a novel genetic parameter, CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion (note the use of Arabic numerals, another proposed change)
All (2016) IDHmt glioblastoma (defined by microvascular proliferation or necrosis) will become (2020) IDHmt astrocytoma WHO grade 4.
Previous (2016) diffuse or anaplastic astrocytoma that harbor a CDKN2A/B mutation will become (2020) IDHmt Astrocytoma WHO grade 4.
All the above are correct.

questions.reference: Assoc Prof Frank Gaillard and Dr Mendel Castle et al. cIMPACT recommendations for the classification of diffuse gliomas 2020.  Retrieved from https://radiopaedia.org/；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p174
questions.explanation: 答案 E。cIMPACT-NOW（2020）／WHO CNS5 對 IDH-mutant 瀰漫性膠質瘤的四項敘述皆成立，故「全部正確」為正解。(A) 正確：第五版廢除「IDH-mutant glioblastoma」一詞，glioblastoma 僅保留給 IDH-wildtype，IDH-mutant 星細胞瘤改採型內分級並可至 grade 4。(B) 正確：IDH-mutant astrocytoma 依組織學加上 CDKN2A/B 純合缺失此一新分子參數分級，並改以阿拉伯數字書寫。(C) 正確：凡 2016 版以微血管增生或壞死定義之 IDH-mutant glioblastoma，一律重新歸為 IDH-mutant astrocytoma WHO grade 4。(D) 正確：舊 diffuse／anaplastic astrocytoma 若帶 CDKN2A/B 純合缺失即升為 grade 4（即使無微血管增生或壞死）。→ [[who-cns-tumor-grading]]

questions.questionText: Which description about hypothalamic hamartoma is **WRONG**?

options.text: The lesion can cause gelastic seizures
The lesion usually shows strong enhancement
Precocious puberty is a possible symptom
On T2WI images, the lesion is usually iso- to hyper-intense to the cerebral cortex

questions.reference: Kerrigan JF, Parsons A, Tsang C, Simeone K, Coons S, Wu J. Hypothalamic hamartoma: Neuropathology and epileptogenesis. Epilepsia. 2017;58 Suppl 2:22-31. doi:10.1111/epi.13752；10.1111/epi.13752；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p171
questions.explanation: 答案 B。下視丘錯構瘤本質是非腫瘤性的先天灰質異位，注射對比劑後「不強化」，故「通常呈強烈強化（B）」為錯誤敘述——此不強化特性正是與其他會強化的下視丘／漏斗腫塊（生殖細胞瘤、顱咽管瘤、星細胞瘤、LCH）鑑別的關鍵。(A) 正確：可引起 gelastic seizure（大笑性癲癇），多見於大而無柄（sessile）的病灶。(C) 正確：中樞性性早熟為可能症狀，多見於小而有柄（pedunculated）的病灶。(D) 正確：T2WI 上病灶對大腦皮質呈等至高訊號，膠質細胞比例越高訊號越高。→ [[hypothalamic-hamartoma]]

questions.questionText: When considering a pineal region mass, which characteristic favors Non-germ cell neoplasms?

options.text: radiosensitive; significantly decreased in size after CT scans
male
calcification with exploded appearance
another tumor in suprasellar region

questions.reference: Yousem, D. M., & Nadgir, R. (2017). Neuroradiology: The requisites.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p386
questions.explanation:
Exploded calcification會偏向pineoblastoma之類的，非germinoma.

⚠️ 本題含影像（官方詳解 PDF 第 386 頁），影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。

questions.questionText: Which description about orbital cavernous venous malformation is **wrong**?

options.text: Most common adult orbital mass lesion with characteristic feature as patchy dynamic enhancement.
MR appearance showing septations on T2WI is more specific than CT in distinguishing from other orbital masses
Macroscopic calcifications or phleboliths are typical.
Slow, progressive enlargement over years. On average 10-15% volume growth per year. Faster growth during pregnancy.

questions.reference: Fundamentals of Diagnostic Radiology, 3rd Edition p.265；10.1007/s13244-015-0443-8；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p52
questions.explanation: 答案 C（此題問「錯誤」敘述）。C 為錯誤：巨觀鈣化或靜脈石（phlebolith）在眼眶海綿狀靜脈畸形僅「偶爾」出現、於鑑別診斷的角色有限（sclerosing 亞型較可能見鈣化），並非典型徵象，故此敘述錯。A 正確：為成人最常見的眼眶腫塊，動態增強呈特徵性的斑塊狀漸進填充（patchy progressive fill-in）。B 正確：MRI 在 T2 上顯示內部分隔（septation）於與其他眼眶腫塊鑑別上比 CT 更具特異性。D 正確：病灶多年緩慢漸進性長大，平均每年約增 10–15% 體積，懷孕期成長加速。→ [[orbital-cavernous-venous-malformation]]

questions.questionText: About toxic and metabolic brain disorders, which following statement is **false**?

options.text: Common sites involved in Wernicke encephalopathy include the regions surrounding the third ventricle, the tectal plate and the periaqueductal gray matter, and the putamina.
In nearly all cases of metronidazole-induced brain toxicity, MR images show bilateral symmetric lesions in the cerebellum.

The characteristic imaging finding of chronic hepatic encephalopathy is bilateral and symmetric T1 hyperintensity involving the globi pallidi and substantiae nigrae, most likely due to magnesium accumulation.
The globus pallidus is sensitive to hypoxia, its bilateral symmetric necrotic involvement is the hallmark of carbon monoxide poisoning.
Extrapontine osmotic demyelination syndrome commonly involve the basal ganglia, thalami, and hemispheric white matter, often symmetrically.

questions.reference: de Oliveira AM, Paulino MV, Vieira APF, et al. Imaging Patterns of Toxic and Metabolic Brain Disorders. Radiographics. 2019;39:1672-1695.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p51
questions.explanation: 答案 C。慢性肝性腦病的雙側對稱蒼白球與黑質 T1 高訊號是「錳（manganese）」沉積所致，非選項所述的「鎂（magnesium）」，故 C 敘述錯誤。(A) 正確：Wernicke 腦病好發於第三腦室周圍、頂蓋板與導水管周圍灰質及殼核。(B) 正確：metronidazole 腦毒性幾乎都呈雙側對稱小腦（齒狀核）病灶。(D) 正確：蒼白球對缺氧敏感，其雙側對稱壞死是一氧化碳中毒的標誌。(E) 正確：腦橋外滲透壓性脫髓鞘常對稱侵犯基底核、視丘與大腦半球白質。→ [[toxic-metabolic-brain-imaging]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following is **not** a classical radiological sign of normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH)?

options.text: Evans’ index > 0.3
Acute callosal angle
Cingulate sulcus sign
“Knife-blade” configuration of gyri

questions.reference: Neurographics, Volume 7, Number 6, 1 November 2017, pp. 416-436(21).；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p54
questions.explanation: 答案 D。「刀刃狀腦回（knife-blade gyri）」是額顳葉萎縮（額顳葉失智／Pick 病）嚴重局部萎縮的表現，並非 NPH 徵象；NPH 反而在高凸面呈現腦溝腦回擁擠，故 D 為「非」NPH 的典型放射徵象。(A) 正確：Evans index > 0.3（腦室擴大）。(B) 正確：callosal angle 變銳（acute，冠狀面 <90°）。(C) 正確：cingulate sulcus sign（後段腦溝較前段窄）。三者皆為 NPH 經典徵象，另可見 DESH 與 Sylvian fissure 擴大。→ [[normal-pressure-hydrocephalus]]

questions.questionText: 所謂 Weigert-Meyer law,以下敘述, 何者為**非** ?

options.text: Embryologically, duplication occurs when two separate ureteric buds arise from a single Mullerian duct (mesonephric duct). With duplex kidney and complete ureteral duplication, the upper renal and lower renal moieties are drained by separate ureters, each having its own ureteral orifice in the bladder.
upper renal moiety ureter has ectopic insertion medial and inferior to the lower renal moiety ureter, and frequently ends in a ureterocele
lower renal moiety ureter has orthotopic insertion lateral and superior to the upper renal moiety ureter, and vesicoureteral reflux can occur
The ectopic insertion often has a ureterocele which obstructs its own collecting system

questions.reference: Sheth S, Fishman EK. Multi-detector row CT of the kidneys and urinary tract: techniques and applications in the diagnosis of benign diseases. Radiographics. 24 (2): e20.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p304
questions.explanation:
答案 A。本題問 Weigert-Meyer 法則的敘述何者「為非」。A 錯在胚胎來源：集尿系統重複的正確機轉是單一 Wolffian duct（中腎管／mesonephric duct）長出兩個 ureteric bud，各自引流上、下極；A 卻寫成「單一 Müllerian duct」，然而 mesonephric duct 即 Wolffian duct，並非 Müllerian duct（後者為苗勒氏管、發育為女性生殖道），故敘述錯誤。B 正確：上極輸尿管開口偏內下、屬異位（ectopic），常終止於 ureterocele。C 正確：下極輸尿管開口偏外上、屬正位（orthotopic），因膀胱壁內段短而易發生 VUR。D 正確：異位開口常合併 ureterocele，並阻塞其自身引流的（上極）集尿系統。
→ [[ureteral-duplication]]

questions.questionText: A well performed pediatric voiding cystourethrography allows visualization of disease and detection of most common pathologic conditions with very low radiation exposure. Which of the following description is **incorrect**?

options.text: In boys, the external sphincter is the most common site of resistance to catheter advancement.
A ureterocele or bladder tumor may only be seen during early filling and may become obscured as more contrast material enters the bladder.
Approximately 20% of reflux will be missed if voiding does not occur.
All grades of reflux (international reflux system) can be outgrown in both infant and pediatric patients except for grade V, which requires surgery.

questions.reference: Fernback, SK et al. Pediatric Voiding Cystourethrography: A Pictorial Guide. Radiographics 2000;20(1):155-168.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p282
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題問何者敘述「錯誤」。D 過於絕對而錯：各級 VUR 皆可能自行緩解（outgrown），只是低級別緩解更頻繁、所需時間更短；即使 grade V 也非「一律需手術」——嬰兒的 grade V 已被證實可自行縮小、消退，故不能說「除 grade V 外皆可 outgrown、grade V 一律開刀」。A 正確：男嬰在導管推進時最常於外括約肌處遇到阻力。B 正確：ureterocele 或膀胱腫瘤僅在早期充盈時可見，對比劑充填增多後易被遮蔽。C 正確：若未涵蓋排尿期影像，約 20% 的逆流會被漏診。

questions.questionText: Which of the following US artifacts is reduced by using **tissue harmonic imaging**?

options.text: **Grating lobe** artifact
**Reverberation** artifact
**Acoustic shadowing**
All of the above

questions.reference: Clinical Significance of US Artifacts. Radiographics 2017; 37. p.1411 (Table 2)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p399
questions.explanation:
答案 D。（此為答案卷標記，本題屬爭議題。）
組織諧波成像（THI）利用超音波在組織內非線性傳播所生的諧波成像，因諧波於淺層/體壁能量低、需累積至較深處才建立，故能壓抑近場雜訊，減少 (A) grating lobe 與 (B) reverberation 等偽影，同時提升訊噪比與側向解析度。
然而 (C) acoustic shadowing（聲影）反而會被 THI 與高頻探頭強化，並非被減少；因此嚴格而言「以上皆是」並不成立，官方詳解實際判為 A、B 兩項。
判讀重點：THI 抑制的是散射/旁瓣類偽影，對聲影則是加強。
→ [[tissue-harmonic-imaging]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 1: US Artifacts due to Beam and Resolution Characteristics**

| Type of Artifact | Physics Mechanism | Alteration of Artifacts | Clinical Relevance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beam width | Poor lateral resolution | Can be reduced by dynamic receive focusing, multiple-transmit FZs, increasing frequency, FZ placement, local speed of sound selection | Lateral blurring of point targets, aberrant echoes from adjacent highly echogenic objects |
| Section thickness | Poor elevational resolution | Can be reduced by positioning the area of interest in FZ with a standoff pad or by using 1.5D/2D transducer arrays | Mimics debris in anechoic structures, aberrant internal echoes in small cysts and vessels |
| Axial resolution | Axial resolution | Better with increasing frequency | Choose a higher frequency for better axial resolution |
| Speckle noise | Acoustic interference causing granular appearance | Can be reduced by SRI, SCI, THI | Degrades spatial and contrast resolution but also gives tissues their characteristic image texture |
| Secondary lobe (Side lobes, Grating lobes) | Echoes transmitted outside primary beam are reflected back to transducer | Can be reduced by THI, decreasing gain, changing AOI, using multiple windows, advanced transducer design | Mimics debris in anechoic structures |

Note — AOI = angle of insonation, FZ = focal zone, 1.5D = 1.5-dimensional, SCI = spatial compound imaging, SRI = speckle reduction imaging, THI = tissue harmonic imaging, 2D = two-dimensional.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following descriptions about artifacts of ultrasonography is **not** true?

options.text: Differential attenuation of sound causes **shadowing** and **posterior enhancement**.
Large, smooth interfaces that reﬂect a large amount of sound can produce **mirror image** artifacts.
**Reverberation** artifacts cause spurious echoes, usually in the near ﬁeld.
**Ring-down** artifacts cannot be produced by metal.

questions.reference: Ultrasound: The Requisites E-Book P19-27；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p37
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題要選「錯誤」敘述。
(D)「金屬無法產生 ring-down 偽影」為錯——ring-down 源自聲束打到被困住的氣泡/氣體使其共振、向探頭連續發射回音，而金屬同樣能造成類似的 ring-down 樣偽影，故此敘述不成立。
其餘皆正確：(A) 組織對聲波的衰減差異，會在高衰減結構後方造成聲影、在低衰減結構（如囊腫）後方造成後方增強；(B) 大而平滑的強反射界面可把結構鏡射到對側等距處，形成 mirror image 偽影；(C) reverberation 為聲束在兩平行強反射面間來回反射，多出現在近場、造成假回音。
→ [[ultrasound-artifacts]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following US artifacts **CANNOT** be reduced by using **spatial compound imaging**?

options.text: **Comet tail** artifact
**Ring down** artifact
**Acoustic shadowing**
Increased through transmission

questions.reference: Clinical Significance of US Artifacts. Radiographics 2017; 37. p.1421 (Table 2, Table 3)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p401
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題要選「無法」被空間複合成像（SCI）減少的偽影。
SCI 以陣列探頭多角度掃描同一組織再平均，對角度或散射相關的偽影較有效：(A) comet-tail、(B) ring-down 與 (C) acoustic shadowing 皆屬與入射角度或散射有關者，較能被多角度平均削弱。
(D) increased through transmission（即後方增強）本質是聲束穿過低衰減結構後、深部回音相對增強的「真實」訊號，反映組織成分、與入射角度無關，故在（尤其大器官）情境下最不受 SCI 角度平均影響，官方取為正解。
⚠️ 惟需知 Tier-1 文獻指出 SCI 對 enhancement 與 shadowing 偽影「亦可能」減少，故本題答案僅在特定情境成立，屬弱題。
→ [[ultrasound-artifacts]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 3: US Artifacts due to Attenuation Characteristics**

| Type of Artifact | Physics Mechanism | Alteration of Artifacts | Clinical Relevance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Increased through transmission | Increased intensity of echoes distal to a low-attenuating structure | May be increased by using THI | Differentiation of cystic from solid structures |
| Acoustic shadowing (Clean / Partial / Dirty) | Reduction in echo strength distal to a highly attenuating or reflective object | Increases with increased frequency and THI; decreases with inappropriate FZ placement, excessive beam width, and SCI | Detection of stones, calcification, and air |

Note.—FZ = focal zone, SCI = spatial compound imaging.

**Table 2: US Artifacts due to Location (Path or Speed) Characteristics**

| Type of Artifact | Physics Mechanism | Alteration of Artifacts | Clinical Relevance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reverberation | Reflections between highly reflective interfaces in parallel | Can be reduced by using THI, decreasing gain, changing AOI, and using multiple windows | Usually unwanted, mimicking debris within cystic structures; may be useful, as in abnormal air |
| Comet tail | Reverberations from closely spaced highly reflective interfaces | May be more visible using THI and less visible by using SCI | Adenomyomatosis, colloid nodules, calcifications, foreign bodies, surgical clips, IUDs |
| Ring down | Resonant vibrations within air bubbles | May be reduced by using SCI | Abnormal air (abscesses, pneumoperitoneum, PVG, emphysematous infections, pneumobilia, normal air [bowel loops, appendix], B-lines) |
| Mirror image | Reflections off a strong specular reflector produce a mirror image of an object | May be reduced by decreasing gain, changing AOI, using multiple imaging windows | Mimics disease, such as pseudothickened bowel wall and consolidated lung |
| Multipath | Small off-axis reflections on path to or from primary reflector | May be altered by varying AOI or imaging window | General image degradation |
| Refraction (Misregistration, Ghosting, Edge shadowing) | Refraction at oblique interfaces causes altered location of objects, duplication of underlying structures, and/or shadowing at edges | May be reduced by varying AOI or imaging window | False position of lesions during biopsy, can mimic duplication of structures (gestational sac, spinal cord, aorta), cyst characterization by using edge shadowing |
| Speed of sound (Boundary distortion, Misregistration of targets, Errors in size, Phase aberration) | A constant speed of sound is used to calculate depth in soft tissues, but there actually is variability among different tissues | Modern US units allow manual speed of sound correction | Inaccurate locations and measurements of structures in axial dimension, loss of lateral resolution, bayonet artifact |
| Range ambiguity | Echoes deep to imaging range are depicted within range on the next pulse | May be reduced by reducing PRF, reducing the number of FZs, increasing the image depth | Mimics debris in large fluid-filled structures |

Note — AOI = angle of insonation, FZ = focal zone, IUD = intrauterine device, PRF = pulse repetition frequency, PVG = portal venous gas, SCI = spatial compound imaging.

options.text: 當eGFR< 30 mL/min/1.73 m2時, 注射對比劑當時或之前應開始停用 metformin, 檢查後48小時如腎功能穩定方可重新使用。
注射含釓對比劑劑量在一般範圍時 (0.1-0.3 mmol/kg) ，不需暫停使用 metformin。

questions.reference: 中華民國放射線醫學會對比劑手冊；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p14
questions.explanation:
答案 D。正常腎功能者靜脈注射含碘對比劑後，血中半衰期約為 2 小時、約 24 小時可完全排出，並非 6 小時，故 D 為錯誤敘述。
(A) 依現行規範，eGFR<30 mL/min/1.73m² 或急性腎衰竭者，於注射對比劑當時或之前即應停用 metformin，檢查後 48 小時確認腎功能穩定才恢復使用，正確。
(B) 一般劑量（0.1–0.3 mmol/kg）之含釓對比劑不增加腎臟碘負荷，無須暫停 metformin，正確。
(C) 碘對比劑本身不會直接誘發乳酸中毒，風險在於一旦施打後發生對比劑腎病變、腎功能惡化使 metformin 蓄積，才可能導致乳酸中毒，正確。

imageOcr.markdown:
A8.1 Metformin 副作用

Metformin 最嚴重的副作用是乳酸中毒，通常發生在合併嚴重共病的狀態，最常見的是心血管疾病及腎臟病。Metformin 引起乳酸中毒發生機率估計約為每十萬人年少於 10 例（0-0.084 例／每千人年），但在報告案例中致死率可高達 30-50% [54,55]。施打含碘對比劑本身並不會造成使用 Metformin 病患發生乳酸中毒，但當施打對比劑後發生對比劑腎病變時，有導致乳酸中毒的風險。

A8.4 使用 Metformin 受檢者於血管內注射含釓對比劑之規範

注射含釓對比劑劑量在一般範圍時 (0.1-0.3 mmol/kg)，不須暫停使用 metformin [58, 59]。

questions.questionText: 在臨床上使用含釓（Gd）的磁振造影對比劑，其最主要目的為何?

options.text: 縮短 T1弛緩時間 (shortening T1 relaxation time)
增長 T1弛緩時間 (prolong T1 relaxation time)
縮短 T2弛緩時間 (shortening T2 relaxation time)
增長 T2弛緩時間 (prolong T2 relaxation time

questions.reference: Pretorius ES, MBA JASMD. Radiology Secrets Plus. Mosby. ISBN:0323067948.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p314
questions.explanation:
答案 A。釓為順磁性金屬，臨床使用含釓對比劑的主要目的是縮短鄰近質子的 T1 弛緩時間，使組織在 T1 加權影像上訊號增強（變亮），故 A 正確。
(B) 增長 T1 方向恰好相反，錯誤。
釓雖然同時也會縮短 T2（高濃度時 T2 訊號下降較明顯），但這並非臨床給藥的主要目的，故 (C) 縮短 T2、(D) 增長 T2 均非最佳答案。
→ [[gadolinium-contrast]]

questions.questionText: About Gadolinium deposition in the brain, which of the following statements is false?

options.text: Gadolinium can deposit in the dentate nucleus, globus pallidus, pons and thalamus, through CSF in intact blood-brain barrier patients.
Exposure to gadolinium-based contrast agents (GBCAs) may result in gadolinium deposition in human brain and bone tissue in those patients with normal renal function.
Repeated GBCAs administration results in gadolinium deposition which affects cognitive function and causes cerebellar syndrome.
The administration of linear GBCAs was associated with significant high gadolinium concentration in the brain compared to macrocyclic GBCA administration.

questions.reference: Radiographics. Jan-Feb 2020;40(1):153-162；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p360
questions.explanation:
答案 C。目前並無動物或人體研究證實神經組織的釓沉積會造成認知功能損害或小腦症候群等臨床、行為或生物學上的不良變化，其臨床意義仍未明，故宣稱「重複注射會影響認知功能並造成小腦症候群」的 C 為錯誤敘述。
(A) 釓可穿過完整的血腦障壁、沉積於齒狀核、蒼白球、腦橋與視丘（推測經腦脊髓液/glymphatic 途徑），正確。
(B) 即使腎功能正常者，暴露於含釓對比劑後仍可能在腦部與骨骼組織產生沉積，正確。
(D) 線狀製劑去螯合較多，腦內釓濃度顯著高於環狀製劑，正確。
→ [[gadolinium-contrast]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**

- The risk of NSF after GBCA exposure depends on which agent is used, with most cases reported after use of nonionic linear agents.
- Administration of higher than standard doses (>0.1 mmol/kg) of GBCAs has been associated with development of NSF.
- The dramatic reduction of new cases of NSF over the last decade may have occurred because of more routine screening for kidney disease, less use of the GBCAs that have been associated with the most cases of NSF (particularly in patients with renal dysfunction), and less use of the high-dose GBCA-enhanced examinations that were sometimes used in MR angiography.
- To our knowledge, there have been no studies in animals or humans demonstrating clinical, behavioral, or biologic changes associated with neuronal gadolinium deposition.
- Neuronal GBCA deposition has been reported after administration of linear and macrocyclic agents. However, less retention is seen after use of macrocyclic agents.

questions.reference: 次 Mathur, M., Jones, J. R., & Weinreb, J. C. (2020). Gadolinium Deposition and Nephrogenic Systemic Fibrosis: A Radiologist’s Primer. RadioGraphics, 40(1), 153–162. https://doi.org/10.1148/rg.2020190110；10.1148/rg.2020190110；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p35
questions.explanation:
答案 D。NSF 病例雖與所用釓製劑種類高度相關，但通報最多的是「非離子性線狀（nonionic linear）」製劑（如 Omniscan/gadodiamide、OptiMARK/gadoversetamide），而非「離子性線狀（ionic linear）」，故 D 敘述錯誤。
(A) NSF 與腎功能不全密切相關，殘餘腎功能越差、發生 NSF 的風險越高，正確。
(B) 使用高於標準劑量（>0.1 mmol/kg）之釓製劑與 NSF 發生相關，正確。
(C) 線狀與環狀製劑皆曾報告神經組織釓沉積，但環狀製劑滯留量較少，正確。

questions.questionText: 針對Gadolinium-based MR contrast agents 造成腎因性纖維化的風險，下列 何者**錯誤**？

options.text: 化學結構為cyclic的風險較 linear高
non-ionic linear結構對比劑的風險較ionic linear結構高
慢性腎臟病 (Stage 4 or Stage 5) 尚未透析治療為受檢者的風險因子
急性腎衰竭為受檢者的風險因子

questions.reference: 中華民國放射線醫學會對比劑手冊；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p13
questions.explanation:
答案 A。含釓對比劑造成腎因性全身纖維化的風險，化學結構為「線狀（linear）」者高於「環狀（cyclic/macrocyclic）」，因環狀結構把釓離子鎖得較牢、不易去螯合游離；故 A 將方向寫反，為錯誤敘述。
(B) 在線狀製劑中，非離子性者去螯合更多，風險高於離子性線狀，正確。
(C) 尚未接受透析的第 4、5 期慢性腎臟病（eGFR<30）為受檢者的風險因子，正確。
(D) 急性腎損傷/腎衰竭亦為受檢者的風險因子，正確。
→ [[nephrogenic-systemic-fibrosis]]

imageOcr.markdown:
目前相關重要研究結果摘要如下 [80, 82, 83]：

1. 不同對比劑造成風險不同。
2. 對比劑化學結構為線狀者風險較環狀者高。
3. 非離子性線狀結構對比劑風險較離子性線狀結構高。

受檢者之風險因子為：

1. 因任何原因接受透析治療
2. Stage 4, stage 5 的慢性腎臟病 (Chronic Kidney disease, CKD) 尚未透析治療
3. eGFR 30-40 mL/min/1.73m² 尚未透析治療 *
4. 急性腎臟傷害 (acute kidney insufficiency, AKI) **

questions.questionText: 當喝入含有約1000 cc dilute鋇劑,當腸道的顯影劑時, 以下敘述何者**錯誤**?

options.text: 在CT 下, 以high density 表現
在 MRI T1-weighted study 下, 腸道是hypointense
在 MRI T2-weighted study 下, 腸道是hypointense
在 超音波下, 與水的效果相當
在 有腸道破漏的疑慮時, 不要使用

questions.reference: ACR Manual on Contrast Media, 2021 p. 62-67；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p311
questions.explanation:
答案 C。約 1000 cc 的稀釋鋇劑屬「水性（water-based）」腸道對比劑，行為近似 biphasic（雙相）製劑——同時延長 T1 與 T2 值，使腸腔在 T1WI 呈低訊號、T2WI 呈高訊號；故 C 所稱「T2 加權下腸道為 hypointense」方向錯誤，實際應為 hyperintense（高訊號）。
(A) 稀釋鋇劑於 CT 下仍呈高密度，正確。
(B) T1WI 下腸腔為低訊號（hypointense），正確。
(D) 稀釋後含水量高，超音波下效果與水相當，正確。
(E) 疑有腸道穿孔/破漏時不應使用鋇劑（外漏入腹腔會引發嚴重腹膜炎），應改用水溶性含碘對比劑，正確。
→ [[mri-bowel-contrast]]

questions.questionText: What is the clinical routine iodine load for use of 120 kVp CTA of aorta

options.text: 50 mgI/kg
100 mgI/kg
200 mgI/kg
400 mgI/kg

questions.reference: Clinical Radiology Volume 75, Issue 10, October 2020, Pages 797.e9-797.e19；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p316
questions.explanation:
答案 D。傳統（conventional）主動脈 CTA 以 120 kVp 掃描時，臨床常規碘負荷量約為 400 mgI/kg，故選 D。
為降低輻射劑量與碘用量所發展的「double-low」CTA（DLCTA）採低管電壓（70–80 kVp）搭配 high-pitch 與迭代重建：降低管電壓使光子能量趨近碘的 k-edge（33.2 keV），碘的衰減值上升，因而可將碘負荷約減半至 200 mgI/kg；但該 200 mgI/kg 對應的是 70 kVp 低劑量協定，並非題幹所問的 120 kVp 常規協定。
故 (C) 200、(A) 50、(B) 100 mgI/kg 對於 120 kVp 常規協定皆偏低不符。
（本題答案鍵原標 C，經醫師裁決 2026-07-11 更正為 D。）
→ [[iodinated-contrast-media]]

questions.questionText: X-rays produced following a photoelectric interaction in tissue are best characterized as:

options.text: Characteristic x-rays
Compton scatter
Coherent scatter
Bremsstrahlung photons

questions.reference: Huda, Walter, and Richard M. Slone. Review of radiologic physics, 4th ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins, 2003: 9, 14.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p44
questions.explanation:
答案 A。光電效應（photoelectric interaction）中，入射光子被原子內層（K 殼）電子完全吸收並將其擊出、留下電洞，外層電子躍遷填補時釋放出能量等於兩殼層結合能差的光子，即「特性輻射（characteristic x-rays）」，故 A 正確。
(B) 康普頓散射是光子與外層電子非彈性碰撞後偏向的散射光子，(C) 同調（coherent/Rayleigh）散射是無能量轉移的彈性散射，兩者皆非內層電洞躍遷的產物。
(D) 制動輻射（Bremsstrahlung）是電子受原子核庫倫場減速所放出的連續輻射，屬 X 光在球管內「產生」的機制，而非組織內光電交互作用的產物，皆非答案。
→ [[characteristic-xray-physics]]

imageOcr.markdown:
| | Coherent Scatter | Photoelectric | Compton Scatter |
|---|---|---|---|
| Products | X-Ray photon (=energy) | Electron; Characteristic X-Ray (low energy) | Electron; Scattered Photon (low energy) |
| Outcome | Direction change of x-ray | X-Ray stops and deposits energy locally | Some energy deposited, scattered x-ray in different direction |
| Energy Summary | Less than 10 keV | Dominant Below ~30 keV (1/E) | Dominant Above ~30 keV (1/E) |
| Z Dependence | Z | Z^3 | Independent of Z |
| Impact on X-Ray Image | No Significant | Primary Contrast | Background Haze |
| Impact on Patient Dose | No Significant | Electrons, characteristic x-rays Deposit Dose | Electrons Deposit Dose |
| Impact on Staff Dose | No Significant | Not sign, except for interventions if in beam | Dominant Source of stray dose |

questions.questionText: In diagnostic radiology, As Low As Reasonably Achievable (ALARA) may be taken to mean ensuring:

options.text: Patient doses low
Unnecessary radiation is eliminated
Costs are minimized
Examinations are cost effective

questions.reference: Huda, Walter, and Richard M. Slone. Review of radiologic physics, 4th ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins, 2003: 80, 85.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p41
questions.explanation:
答案 B。ALARA（合理抑低）的核心意涵是「消除一切不必要的輻射、並在兼顧經濟與社會因素下把殘餘風險降到合理可行的最低」，故 B（Unnecessary radiation is eliminated）最貼切。
(A) 僅「使病人劑量低」不夠全面，因 ALARA 同時涵蓋工作人員、一般大眾以及輻射源本身的屏蔽，非只針對病人。
(C) 成本最小化、(D) 檢查具成本效益，都把 ALARA 誤解為經濟目標——經濟只是被納入權衡的因素之一，並非原則本身的目的，故皆非。
→ [[alara-principle]]

questions.questionText: Which iodinated contrast media is the non-ionic dimer?

options.text: Iopromide.
Iohexol.
Iothalamate meglumine.
Iodixanol.
Iopamidol.

questions.reference: 中華民國放射線醫學會對比劑手冊；標準放射藥理學
questions.explanation:
答案 D。Iodixanol（Visipaque）是唯一常用的「非離子性雙體（non-ionic dimer）」含碘對比劑；因一個分子攜帶兩個苯環（兩份碘）卻只算一顆溶質顆粒，滲透壓最低、接近血漿（等滲），故選 D。
(A) Iopromide、(B) Iohexol、(E) Iopamidol 皆為非離子性單體（低滲透壓）；(C) Iothalamate meglumine 為離子性單體（高滲透壓），均非雙體，故皆非。
→ [[iodinated-contrast-media]]

questions.questionText: Which space(s) would iodinated contrast media distribute after intravenous injection in a patient with normal renal function? (1) Vascular space (2) Extracellular space (3) Intracellular space
questions.reference: 中華民國放射線醫學會對比劑手冊；標準放射藥理學
questions.explanation:
答案 B（1+2）。含碘對比劑分子量低（<200 Da），靜脈注射後於血管內間隙與細胞外（間質）間隙之間自由交換分布，但不會進入細胞內，最終經腎絲球過濾排出；故分布於血管內（1）與細胞外（2）兩個間隙，選 B。
凡納入 (3) 細胞內間隙的 C（1+2+3）、D（1+3）、E（2+3）皆錯，僅含 (1) 的 A 不完整。
→ [[iodinated-contrast-media]]

questions.questionText: Which space(s) would iodinated contrast media distribute in the normal brain during angiography? (1) Vascular space (2) Extracellular space (3) Intracellular space
questions.reference: 中華民國放射線醫學會對比劑手冊；標準放射藥理學
questions.explanation:
答案 A（僅 1）。正常腦部的血腦障壁（BBB）完整，腦微血管內皮對含碘對比劑不通透，故腦血管攝影時對比劑僅停留於血管內間隙，不會滲入腦的細胞外或細胞內間隙，因此僅選 (1)，答案 A。
凡納入 (2) 細胞外或 (3) 細胞內間隙的 B、C、D、E 皆錯。（對照 2021-086：同一對比劑在一般組織可分布至細胞外間隙，但在正常腦部因 BBB 阻隔而僅限血管內。）
→ [[iodinated-contrast-media]]

questions.questionText: About Imaging Findings of Fetal Liver Tumor, which of the following is not appropriate?

options.text: Focal nodular hyperplasia : Hyper-echoic lesion without vascularity at Doppler US
Hemangioma : Hypoechoic cystic lesion with or without punctate calcifications; vascularity at Doppler US
Hemangioendothelioma : Dilated intrahepatic vessels, elevated maternal serum α-fetoprotein
Mesenchymal hamartoma : Usually a large multiloculated cystic mass

questions.reference: Fetal Hepatomegaly: Causes and Associations; RadioGraphics 2020; 40:589–604；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p8
questions.explanation:
答案 A。本題問胎兒肝腫瘤影像描述何者「不恰當」。A 錯在回音特性：胎兒 focal nodular hyperplasia 應為 hypoechoic（低回音）病灶、都卜勒無明顯血流，而非題目所寫的 hyper-echoic。B 正確：hemangioma 為低回音囊性病灶、可含點狀鈣化、都卜勒可見血流。C 正確：hemangioendothelioma 表現為擴張的肝內血管，母體血清 α-fetoprotein 可升高。D 正確：mesenchymal hamartoma 典型為大型多房囊性腫塊。
→ [[pediatric-liver-tumors]]
questions.author: 楊良友

questions.questionText: About typical Imaging Findings of Fetal Liver Tumor, which of the following is not appropriate?

options.text: Arterial venous malformations or fistulas : Multiple enlarged intrahepatic vessels
Intrahepatic meconium pseudocysts: Related to perforation, multiple intrahepatic complex cysts
Malignant Hepatoblastoma: Solid, spoke-wheel, vascular multilobular mass with or without calcifications
Metastatic neuroblastoma : Homogeneous hypoechoic nodule with or without vascularity

questions.reference: Fetal Hepatomegaly: Causes and Associations; RadioGraphics 2020; 40:589–604；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p9
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題問胎兒肝腫瘤典型影像何者「不恰當」。D 錯在回音型態：胎兒肝的轉移性 neuroblastoma 應為 heterogeneous hyperechoic（不均質高回音）結節、可有或無血流，而非題目所寫的 homogeneous hypoechoic。A 正確：動靜脈畸形／瘻管表現為多條擴張的肝內血管。B 正確：肝內胎便假囊腫與（腸）穿孔相關、呈多發複雜囊腫。C 正確：hepatoblastoma 為實質性、輻輪狀（spoke-wheel）、富血管的多分葉腫塊，可含或不含鈣化。
→ [[pediatric-liver-tumors]]
