questions.questionText: Which of the following collapsed site refers to Luftsichel sign?

options.text: RUL
LUL
RLL
LLL

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging-Chest Part 4（IV-1-3）；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p10
questions.explanation:
答案 B。Luftsichel（德語「空氣鐮刀」）指左上葉（LUL）塌陷時的正面胸片徵象：LUL 向前塌陷後，左下葉的上節段（superior segment）代償性過度充氣，向上疝入主動脈弓與塌陷上葉之間，於主動脈旁形成新月狀透亮影，故答案為 (B) LUL。
(A) RUL 塌陷在側位片呈三角形緻密影、可伴 Golden S sign，不會形成此主動脈旁透亮。
(C) RLL 與 (D) LLL 塌陷均向後內下方塌陷，正面片呈後縱隔／後心影三角形增密，也不產生主動脈旁新月透亮。
故唯有左上葉塌陷對應 Luftsichel sign。
→ [[lobar-atelectasis]]
questions.author: 何上芸

questions.questionText: 含碘對比劑之急性全身性不良反應風險因子，何者為非?

options.text: 曾有含碘對比劑中度至重度急性反應
氣喘，尤其是不穩定性
對海鮮/ 乳類過敏或對碘酒過敏
過度焦慮

questions.reference: 中華民國放射線醫學會對比劑手冊；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p16
questions.explanation:
答案 C。含碘對比劑急性全身性不良反應的受檢者風險因子，包括曾對含碘對比劑發生中至重度急性反應、需治療的氣喘（尤其不穩定性）與過度焦慮（Lalli effect），故 A、B、D 皆為真正的風險因子。
而「對海鮮/乳類過敏或對碘酒過敏」與含碘對比劑的類過敏反應並無因果關係，是常見迷思，並非風險因子，故本題問「何者為非」選 C。
→ [[contrast-adverse-reactions]]
questions.author: 黃元俊

imageOcr.markdown:
**A4.2.2 急性全身性不良反應之風險因子 [10, 20]**

雖然有風險因子之受檢者發生不良反應的風險較高，但對比劑之不良反應仍是不可預測。

風險因子分類：

| 受檢者風險因子 ᵃ | 對比劑風險因子 ᵇ |
|---|---|
| 因使用含碘對比劑發生過中度或重度急性反應；需治療的氣喘；需治療特異反應性體質（多重過敏）；嚴重心臟疾病 ᶜ；過度焦慮 ᵈ | 離子性高張對比劑 |

questions.questionText: which kind of hepatic lesion has enhancement in hepatobiliary phase after Primovist contrast injection?

options.text: Focal nodular hyperplasia
Hepatic adenoma
Liver metastasis
Hepatic cyst

questions.reference: https://radiopaedia.org/articles/gadoxetate-disodium?lang=us Topic: Gadoxetate disodium；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p21
questions.explanation: 答案 A。Gadoxetate（Primovist／Eovist）為肝細胞特異性對比劑，肝膽期（約注射後 20 分鐘）由具功能的肝細胞攝取。A 之 FNH 含正常肝細胞與功能性膽管，肝膽期呈等／高訊號（攝取對比劑），為正解；B 肝腺瘤缺功能性膽管、排出受阻，肝膽期多呈低訊號；C 肝轉移不含肝細胞、不攝取對比劑；D 肝囊腫無強化。故僅 FNH 於肝膽期呈強化。→ [[fnh]]

questions.questionText: According to LI-RADS Version 2018 Ancillary Features at MR, which feature is Not favoring benignity?

options.text: Non-enhancing “capsule”
Marked T2 hyperintensity
Hepatobiliary phase isointensity
Undistorted vessel

questions.reference: LI-RADS Version 2018 Ancillary Features at MRI RadioGraphics 2018; 38: 1973-2001；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p22
questions.explanation: 答案 A。LI-RADS v2018 之 ancillary features 分「偏惡性（可升級，上限僅至 LR-4）」與「偏良性（可降級）」兩類。A non-enhancing「capsule」屬偏惡性（favoring malignancy／偏 HCC），並非偏良性，故為正解；B marked T2 hyperintensity、C hepatobiliary phase isointensity、D undistorted vessel 皆屬偏良性之輔助特徵。→ [[li-rads-ancillary-benignity]]

Mosaic architecture
Fat in mass, more than adjacent liver
All of above

**LI-RADS Ancillary features（輔助特徵）**

**Ancillary features favoring malignancy in general**
- US visibility as discrete nodule
- Subthreshold growth
- Corona enhancement
- Fat sparing in solid mass
- Restricted diffusion
- Mild-moderate T2 hyperintensity
- Iron sparing in solid mass
- Transitional phase hypointensity
- Hepatobiliary phase (HBP) hypointensity

**Ancillary features favoring HCC in particular**
- Nonenhancing "capsule"
- Mosaic architecture
- Nodule-in-nodule architecture

- Size reduction
- Parallels blood pool enhancement

- Iron in mass, more than in liver
- Marked T2 hyperintensity
- HBP isointensity

questions.reference: Wolske, K. M., Ponnatapura, J., Kolokythas, O., Burke, L. M. B., Tappouni, R., & Lalwani, N. (2019). Chronic Pancreatitis or Pancreatic Tumor? A Problem-solving Approach. RadioGraphics, 39(7), 1965–1982. https://doi.org/10.1148/rg.2019190011；10.1148/rg.2019190011；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p24
questions.explanation: 答案 D。胰管平滑穿越腫塊而無突然阻斷即 duct-penetrating sign，反而支持發炎性腫塊（腫塊型胰臟炎／自體免疫胰臟炎）而非 PDAC，故 D 敘述方向錯誤、為正解——PDAC 典型為胰管突然截斷併上游擴張。A double duct sign（膽總管與主胰管同時擴張）偏向惡性、B 慢性胰臟炎鈣化之周邊移位可提示新生惡性、C 軟組織包覆鄰近血管高度提示 PDAC 之腺外蔓延，皆為正確敘述。→ [[autoimmune-pancreatitis]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**

- Smooth narrowing of the pancreatic duct that traverses a pancreatic mass without abrupt obstruction strongly favors the diagnosis of an inflammatory mass.
- Pancreatic parenchymal calcifications are commonly seen in chronic pancreatitis, and peripheral displacement of calcifications can indicate a new underlying malignancy that may otherwise be imaging occult or poorly visualized because of gland heterogeneity from chronic pancreatitis.
- In the absence of the pathognomonic capsulelike rim, visualization of multiple pancreatic or biliary strictures rather than a solitary stricture and absence of substantial dilatation of the side branches or upstream pancreatic duct may be helpful clues that a focal mass in the pancreas represents focal AIP. Similar to other benign focal inflammatory lesions in the pancreas, AIP often shows the duct-penetrating sign, which further supports a benign diagnosis. Extrapancreatic autoimmune disease may be present.
- Displacement rather than encasement of the common bile duct and/or the gastroduodenal artery is highly suggestive of the diagnosis of PDP rather than PDAC.
- Dilatation of both the common bile duct and the main pancreatic duct, or the double duct sign, is highly suggestive of an underlying neoplasm. Although uncommon, inflammatory disease can produce this finding, which mimics malignancy.

questions.questionText: Which of the followings about renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is wrong?

options.text: Clear cell RCC is associated with Von-Hippel-Lindau syndrome
Chromophobe RCC is associated with Birt Hogg Dube syndrome
Papillary RCC is more often associated with lymphangitic spread and peritoneal carcinomatosis
Medullary RCC is an uncommon low-grade neoplasm with imaging appearance of a multilobulated enhanced mass

questions.reference: Radiopedia；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p26
questions.explanation: 答案 D。Renal medullary carcinoma 罕見但屬高度侵襲性腫瘤（好發具鐮刀型血球特徵者），並非「低惡性度、呈多分葉強化腫塊」，故 D 敘述錯誤、為正解。A clear cell RCC 與 Von-Hippel-Lindau 症候群相關、B chromophobe RCC 與 Birt-Hogg-Dubé 症候群相關、C papillary RCC 較常見淋巴管播散與腹膜癌病，皆為正確敘述。→ [[renal-cell-carcinoma]]

questions.questionText: Which of the followings about angiomyolipoma (AML) is wrong?

options.text: 80% of patients with tuberous sclerosis have AML
AML less than 4cm is unlikely to bleed
AML should be considered when renal mass with well enhanced components and calcifications are demonstrated on CT
AML may appear as hypovascular mass on angiography

questions.reference: Radiopedia；10.1186/s12882-021-02253-w；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p28
questions.explanation: 答案 C。AML 罕見鈣化，故「腎腫塊有明顯強化成分＋鈣化」時反而應警覺 RCC（鈣化亦見於脂肪肉瘤），以此推論 AML 並不恰當，C 為錯誤敘述、本題正解。A 結節性硬化症病人約 70–80% 有 AML（原述 80% 可接受）、B AML <4 cm 較不易出血（出血風險與 ≥4 cm 相關）、D 非典型／少脂 AML 於血管攝影可呈乏血管表現，皆屬可接受敘述。→ [[renal-angiomyolipoma]]

questions.questionText: 請選出typical prostate cancer 之MRI findings?

options.text: T2 hypointensity, ADC dark signal, type III enhancement
T2 hyperintensity, ADC dark signal, type III enhancement
T2 hypointensity, ADC dark signal, type I enhancement
T2 hyperintensity, ADC dark signal, type II enhancement

questions.reference: Radiopedia；10.2214/AJR.12.8510；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p29
questions.explanation: 答案 A。攝護腺癌於周邊帶正常高 T2 訊號中呈低訊號（T2 hypointensity），因細胞密度高致擴散受限、ADC map 呈明顯低訊號（ADC dark），DCE 動態曲線呈初期快速上升後下降之 type III（wash-out）曲線，最可疑為癌，故 A 正確、為正解。B、D 之 T2 hyperintensity 與典型癌相反；C 之 type I（持續上升）為良性型曲線，皆不符。→ [[prostate-mri]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about the skeletal manifestations of congenital syphilis is WRONG?

options.text: Celery stalk metaphysis
Metaphyseal lucent bands
Wimberger ring sign
Metaphyseal serration ("sawtooth metaphysis")

questions.reference: 次 Rasool MN, Govender S. The skeletal manifestations of congenital syphilis. A review of 197 cases. J Bone Joint Surg Br. 1989 Nov;71(5):752-5. doi: 10.1302/0301-620X.71B5.2584243. PMID: 2584243.；10.1302/0301-620X.71B5.2584243.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p31
questions.explanation: 答案 C。Wimberger ring sign 是壞血病（scurvy）的表現，指骨骺骨化中心周緣的環狀鈣化，並非先天梅毒的骨骼變化，故對「先天梅毒」而言 C 為錯誤選項。須注意先天梅毒的是名稱相近的 Wimberger sign（corner sign）＝近端脛骨內側幹骺端對稱性去礦化與骨破壞，兩者易混淆。其餘皆為先天梅毒（STORCH 感染）的幹骺端表現：A celery stalk（縱行線狀硬化）幹骺端、B 幹骺端透亮帶（metaphyseal lucent bands）、D 幹骺端鋸齒狀鋸切（sawtooth metaphyseal serration）。→ [[scurvy-skeletal]]
questions.difficulty:
難
●
A : Celery stalk metaphysis ( seen with congenital rubella,
cytomegalovirus, toxoplasma, or syphilis infection) appearance of the
metaphyses in a number of longitudinally aligned linear bands of
sclerosis.
●
C : Symmetric localized demineralization and osseous destruction of
the medial portion of the proximal tibial metaphysis (Wimberger sign
/ Wimberger corner sign)
●
Wimberger ring sign, often simply just called Wimberger ring, refers
to a circular calcification surrounding the osteoporotic epiphyseal
center of ossification in scurvy. It must not be confused with
Wimberger sign, pathognomonic for congenital syphilis.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about the Dandy-Walker spectrum is WRONG?

options.text: Classic Dandy-Walker Malformation has cystic dilatation of the fourth ventricle, high-inserting venous confluence, cerebellar hypoplasia and large posterior fossa
Hypoplastic Rotated Vermis has normal size of posterior fossa and "Keyhole" opening of fourth ventricle
Mega Cisterna Magna has enlarged mega cisterna magna which doesn’t communicate with the fourth ventricle, results in hydrocephalus
Blake Pouch Cyst is caused by lack of fenestration of the Blake pouch, resulting in absence of communication between the fourth ventricle and the subarachnoid space and leading to hydrocephalus

questions.reference: 明書名,頁次 Osborn’s brain - Ch36 Posterior Fossa Malformations；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p32
questions.explanation: 答案 C。Mega cisterna magna（大枕大池）是良性變異，與第四腦室「自由相通」且「不」造成水腦；選項 C 稱其「不相通、導致水腦」為錯誤敘述。(A) 正確：典型 Dandy-Walker malformation 有第四腦室囊狀擴大、竇匯上抬、小腦（蚓部）發育不全與後顱窩擴大。(B) 正確：旋轉發育不全之蚓部型後顱窩大小正常、第四腦室呈鑰匙孔（keyhole）開口。(D) 正確：Blake pouch cyst 因 Blake pouch 開窗失敗，第四腦室與蜘蛛膜下腔不通而導致水腦。→ [[posterior-fossa-malformations]]
questions.difficulty:
普通
Mega Cisterna Magna has enlarged mega cisterna magna freely
communicates with the fourth ventricle, results in consistent absence of
hydrocephalus.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is WRONG?

options.text: Above the hyoid bone, the posterior aspect of the middle layer of the buccopharyngeal fascia continues to the skull base and covers the pharyngeal constrictor muscles. However, above the carotid bifurcation, the contribution of the middle layer to the carotid sheath is inconsistent
The retropharyngeal space extends from the skull base to the thoracocervical junction as the alar fascia attaches to the buccopharyngeal fascia somewhere between the C6 and T4 vertebral levels
If the masticator space is involved, the infection has the potential to extend intracranially through the foramen ovale, along the course of the mandibular nerve
None of above

questions.reference: Kamalian, S., Avery, L., Lev, M. H., Schaefer, P. W., Curtin, H. D., & Kamalian, S. (2019). Nontraumatic Head and Neck Emergencies. RadioGraphics, 39(6), 1808–1823. https://doi.org/10.1148/rg.2019190159；10.1148/rg.2019190159；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p33
questions.explanation:
⚠️ 疑似與 2021-008 為同一題（相似度 0.988），請醫師確認是否合併。
⚠️ 本題含影像（官方詳解 PDF 第 33 頁），影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**

- Above the hyoid bone, the posterior aspect of the middle layer of the deep cervical fascia (or buccopharyngeal fascia) continues to the skull base and covers the pharyngeal constrictor muscles. However, above the carotid bifurcation, the contribution of the middle layer to the carotid sheath is inconsistent; it does not form a well-defined sheath around the internal and external carotid arteries and the internal jugular vein.
- The retropharyngeal space extends from the skull base to the thoracocervical junction as the alar fascia attaches to the buccopharyngeal fascia somewhere between the C6 and T4 vertebral levels.
- If the masticator space is involved, the infection has the potential to extend intracranially through the foramen ovale, along the course of the mandibular nerve (V3 branch of the trigeminal nerve).
- CT allows the radiologist to localize the infection accurately and distinguish a true abscess from retropharyngeal edema. Accurate diagnosis is important to avoid unnecessary and potentially harmful surgery for drainage of a reactive noninfected effusion. A true abscess appears as a rim-enhancing hypoattenuating collection that expands the retropharyngeal space and may contain foci of air.
- The degree of sinonasal mucosal thickening and opacification may be minimal and is not sensitive or specific for diagnosis of invasive fungal sinusitis in at-risk patients. Subtle stranding of the periantral fat can be the first imaging finding of vascular invasion and spread of infection beyond the sinuses.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following descriptions about grey-scale image optimization of ultrasonography is not true?

options.text: Superficial structures should be scanned with high-frequency probes
When the transmitted pulse is stronger, the resulting image is darker
Similar to the power output, the overall gain is usually displayed as a percent of maximum or as a decibels level
The trade-off for multiple level focusing is a decrease in the frame rate

questions.reference: Ultrasound: The Requisites E-Book P10-13；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p36
questions.explanation:
答案 B。本題要選「錯誤」敘述。
(B)「發射脈波越強、影像越暗」為錯——發射功率（output power）決定發射脈波的強度，脈波越強→返回回音越強→影像越亮（而非變暗）；此與接收端增益（gain）僅放大回音的機轉不同。
其餘皆正確：(A) 表淺構造應以高頻探頭掃描以取得較佳解析度；(C) overall gain 與發射功率類似，通常以最大值百分比或分貝（dB）顯示；(D) 多層聚焦可改善側向解析度，但每條掃描線需多次發射，代價是 frame rate 下降。
→ [[ultrasound-physics-basics]]
questions.author: 黃培青

questions.questionText: Which one of the following descriptions about Power and color doppler is not true?

options.text: The main difference between color and power is that color uses amount of signal; power uses frequency
Power and color are equally sensitive to fast flow, but the power is more sensitive to slow flow
An advantage of color Doppler over power Doppler is directional information
Power Doppler is subject to artifacts

questions.reference: General and Vascular Ultrasound: Case Review Series E-Book P6；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p38
questions.explanation:
答案 A。本題要選「錯誤」敘述。
(A) 把兩者說反了——彩色都卜勒（color）以平均頻移（mean frequency shift）編碼，能量都卜勒（power）則以訊號振幅（amount of signal/power）編碼，故「color 用訊號量、power 用頻率」為錯。
其餘皆正確：(B) 兩者對快速血流敏感度相當，但 power 因振幅編碼、不依賴角度，對慢速血流更敏感；(C) 相較 power，color 的優勢在於能提供血流方向資訊；(D) power 都卜勒仍會有偽影（如運動造成的 flash artifact）。
→ [[color-vs-power-doppler]]
questions.author: 黃培青

questions.questionText: Which one of the following descriptions about Ultrasound findings of gallstones is not true?

options.text: Posterior acoustic shadowing is one of the principal ultrasound imaging features of gallstones
The wall-echo-shadow sign may be encountered when the gallstone is small
Gallstones may also demonstrate twinkle artifact on Doppler imaging
They tend to be hypovascular,

questions.reference: General and Vascular Ultrasound: Case Review Series E-Book P14；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p39
questions.explanation:
答案 B。本題要選「錯誤」敘述。
(B)「WES（wall-echo-shadow）徵象出現於結石很小時」為錯——WES 徵象代表膽囊被結石幾乎完全填滿（單顆大結石或多顆小結石填滿收縮的膽囊腔），呈膽囊壁高回音→薄層低回音膽汁→結石表面高回音→其後濃密聲影，並非「結石小」時的表現。
其餘皆正確：(A) 後方聲影為膽結石的主要超音波影像特徵之一；(C) 都卜勒下結石可呈 twinkle artifact，有助偵測小結石；(D) 膽結石本身傾向乏血流。
→ [[cholelithiasis-ultrasound]]
questions.author: 黃培青

questions.questionText: Which one of the followings is not the sonographic feature of liver cirrhosis?

options.text: The ratio of the caudate lobe width to the right lobe width is an indicator of cirrhosis
The nodularity corresponds to the presence of regenerative nodules and fibrosis
Regenerating nodules tend to be isoechoic or hyperechoic with a thin hypoechoic border
In patients with liver cirrhosis, the normal increase in postprandial resistive index is blunted

questions.reference: Diagnostic Ultrasound E-Book P93-95；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p40
questions.explanation:
答案 C。本題要選「非」肝硬化超音波徵象/敘述有誤者。
(C) 錯在「邊界」的描述——再生結節與正常肝結構相近，傾向 isoechoic 或 hypoechoic，且帶一圈薄的「高回音（echogenic）」邊界（對應纖維脂肪結締組織），而非題目所述的低回音（hypoechoic）邊界。
其餘皆為肝硬化徵象：(A) 尾葉相對右葉的寬度比可作為硬化指標（尾葉因獨立靜脈回流而代償肥大）；(B) 表面結節狀對應再生結節與纖維化；(D) 肝硬化病人進食後肝動脈阻力指數（RI）正常應上升的反應被鈍化。
→ [[cirrhosis-ultrasound]]
questions.author: 黃培青

questions.questionText: Which CT image most likely uses the greatest display window width?

options.text: Head (tissue)
Chest (mediastinum)
Chest (lung)
Abdomen (liver)

questions.reference: Huda, Walter, and Richard M. Slone. Review of radiologic physics, 4th ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins, 2003: 153, 158.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p42
questions.explanation:
答案 C。視窗寬度（window width）代表影像所顯示的 CT 值範圍，範圍越大表示涵蓋的衰減差異越廣。肺部同時存在空氣與血管/軟組織，衰減值差異極大，需最寬的視窗（典型 W 約 1500 HU）才能同時呈現，故胸部肺窗使用的 window width 最大，選 C。
相較之下 (A) 頭部軟組織窗（W 約 80）、(B) 縱膈窗（W 約 350）、(D) 肝臟窗（W 約 150）都是用於衰減相近軟組織的窄窗，寬度都遠小於肺窗。
→ [[ct-attenuation-hounsfield-units]]
questions.author: 林妤穎

questions.questionText: While performing interventional radiology procedures, the x-ray tubes ________ the table have low operator doses, and it is recommended that operators stand at the ________ side for lateral projections.

options.text: under; tube
above; tube
under; image receptor
above; image receptor

questions.reference: Huda, Walter, and Richard M. Slone. Review of radiologic physics, 4th ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins, 2003: 139.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p45
questions.explanation:
答案 C（under；image receptor）。散射線主要來自病人的入射側（即 X 光管那一側），因此將 X 光管置於檢查床「下方（under）」，可讓最強的散射從下方散出、減少操作者（尤其頭頸與眼睛）的受曝，故第一格為 under。
側位投影時，操作者應站在「影像接收器（image receptor）側」，避開 X 光管側（該側散射強度大幅增加），故第二格為 image receptor，合為 C。
→ [[fluoroscopy-radiation-safety]]
questions.author: 林妤穎

questions.questionText: Which statement is wrong about the desmoplastic small round cell tumor?

options.text: Predominantly affects the male adolescent
The male to female ratio is 6:1
The tumor typically develops in peritoneal cavity without an apparent primary visceral site of origin
It has a very good prognosis

questions.explanation:
答案 D。DSRCT（促結締組織增生性小圓細胞瘤）為罕見、高度侵襲性的間葉性小圓藍細胞腫瘤，診斷時多已廣泛腹膜播散，預後差，故「預後良好」的敘述錯誤。A 正確：好發於青少年／年輕成年男性。B 正確：男女比約 6:1，男性明顯居多。C 正確：典型發生於腹膜腔而無明顯原發臟器，多佔膀胱後（retrovesical）或直腸子宮（retrouterine）空間。補充：肝為最常見的遠端轉移處。
→ [[desmoplastic-small-round-cell-tumor]]
questions.author: 張志丞

questions.questionText: In the pediatric population, which of the following clinical scenario is indicated for voiding cystourethrography (VCUG)?

options.text: Recurrent urinary tract infection
Congenital anomalies of the genitourinary tract
Neurogenic dysfunction of the urinary bladder
All of the above

questions.reference: 次 American College of Radiology (ACR) and Society for Pediatric Radiology (SPR) guidelines clinical indications for voiding cystourethrography；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p47
questions.explanation:
答案 D。反覆泌尿道感染（A）、先天泌尿生殖道異常（B）與神經性膀胱功能障礙（C）皆為兒童 VCUG 的公認適應症，故正解為「以上皆是」。VCUG 於泌尿道感染的 bottom-up 評估（併腎臟超音波）、先天異常的解剖評估，以及續發性 VUR（如神經性膀胱、輸尿管膨出、後尿道瓣膜）的偵測皆有明確角色，三種情境都適用。
→ [[vesicoureteral-reflux-grading]]
questions.author: 吳宛蘋

imageOcr.markdown:
Clinical indications for VCUG include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Hydronephrosis and/or hydroureter
- Abnormal US (any degree of hydronephrosis, uroepithelial thickening, scarring) after first urinary tract infection (UTI), especially if febrile or non-Escherichia coli (E. coli)
- Recurrent UTI
- Congenital anomalies of the urinary tract
- Dysfunctional voiding, such as neurogenic dysfunction of the bladder
- Urinary incontinence
- Bladder outlet obstruction
- Postoperative evaluation of the urinary tract
- Dysuria/difficulty voiding
- Hematuria
- Trauma

questions.questionText: In the pediatric population, which of the following statements about intussusception is FALSE?

options.text: Idiopathic ileocolic intussusception is the most common type
A pseudokidney sign may be found in ultrasound
Ileocolic intussusception is most often encountered in the left lower quadrant (LLQ) of abdomen
Air and liquid contrast enemas are used for intussusception reduction

questions.reference: 次 Caffey's Pediatric Diagnostic Imaging 13th edition. Chapter 107；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p48
questions.explanation:
答案 C。本題問何者為「錯誤」敘述。C 錯在位置：迴結腸型腸套疊源自迴盲部，腫塊多位於右側（右下腹／右上腹）而非左下腹（LLQ）。A 正確：特發性迴結腸型為兒童腸套疊最常見型態（約 80–90%）。B 正確：超音波縱切面可見假腎徵（pseudokidney sign）。D 正確：空氣或液體對比劑灌腸皆可用於腸套疊的復位。
→ [[pediatric-intussusception-types]]
questions.author: 吳宛蘋

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is wrong about neonatal adrenal hemorrhage?

options.text: It occurs more often on the left side than on the right
Its main differential diagnosis is neuroblastoma
Maternal diabetes mellitus is a predisposing factor
Calcifications may be present

questions.reference: Primer of Diagnostic Imaging, p. 870；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p49
questions.explanation:
答案 A。本題問何者「錯誤」。A 錯在側性：新生兒腎上腺出血好發於右側（R > L，約 75%，個別研究達 85%；雙側僅約 5–10%），並非左側較常見；推測機轉包括右腎上腺靜脈較短且直接注入下腔靜脈、右腺體夾於肝與脊椎之間易受壓，圍產期靜脈壓變化易致出血。B 正確：主要鑑別診斷為 neuroblastoma（出血為無血流、隨時間縮小，neuroblastoma 則有內部血流、可跨中線或轉移）。C 正確：母親糖尿病經由造成巨嬰而為公認誘因。D 正確：血塊隨時間可出現營養不良性鈣化。
→ [[adrenal-imaging]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a typical radiographic feature of achondroplasia?

options.text: Rhizomelic dwarfism
Wide interpedicular distance
Ping-pong paddle pelvis
Small foramen magnum

questions.reference: Primer of Diagnostic Imaging, p. 885；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p50
questions.explanation:
答案 B。本題問何者「非」軟骨發育不全的典型 X 光特徵。B 錯：achondroplasia 的腰椎椎弓根間距是由頭側向尾側漸進「縮小」（L5-S1 最窄，與正常脊椎的漸進增寬相反），構成先天性椎管狹窄，故「寬的椎弓根間距（wide interpedicular distance）」不對。A 正確：近端肢體不成比例縮短（rhizomelic dwarfism，肱骨與股骨最短）。C 正確：香檳杯／乒乓球拍樣骨盆（水平髖臼頂、方形小髂翼）。D 正確：枕骨大孔狹小，嬰兒期可致 cervicomedullary 壓迫。
→ [[achondroplasia]]
questions.author: 吳宛蘋

questions.questionText: Telling from the proton MRS of an adult brain lesion, which of the following diagnosis is less likely?

options.text: Lymphoma
High-grade glioma
Metastasis
Meningioma

questions.reference: Front. Oncol., 04 June 2019  https://doi.org/10.3389/fonc.2019.00440；10.3389/fonc.2019.00440；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p53
questions.explanation: 答案 D。譜線上雖然 Choline > NAA，但仍可測得 NAA（2.02 ppm），代表病灶位於含神經元的腦實質內、屬內軸（intra-axial）腫瘤；腦膜瘤是外軸腫瘤、不含神經元故幾乎測不到 NAA、且常見 alanine（約 1.5 ppm）峰，因此在「仍見 NAA」的譜線上最不可能是腦膜瘤，故選 D。(A) 淋巴瘤、(B) 高惡性度膠質瘤、(C) 轉移皆為內軸腫瘤，可保留部分 NAA 而較可能。→ [[mr-spectroscopy-brain]]
questions.author: 林彥伶

questions.questionText: Which of the following descriptions about temporomandibular joint disorder (TMD) on MRI is wrong?

options.text: The most frequent cause is internal derangement, which is defined as an abnormal relationship of the disk to the condyle
Abnormal disc displacement is considered if the angle between the posterior band and the vertical orientation of the condyle (twelve o’clock position) exceeds 30°
An anteriorly displaced disk has been seen in up to 34% of asymptomatic volunteers
Rupture of superior retrodiskal layer fibers may produce significant disk instability

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2006; 26:765–781；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p55
questions.explanation: 答案 B。閉口位時厚的關節盤後帶應位於髁狀突正上方約 12 點鐘位置，後帶與垂直線的夾角在「10 度以內」屬正常（95 百分位），「超過 10 度」即視為病理性位移；30 度只是 Rammelsberg 等為使判定與臨床症狀更相關而放寬的替代建議，並非「異常」的標準定義，故 B 稱「超過 30 度才算異常」為錯誤敘述。(A) 正確：最常見成因為 internal derangement（關節盤與髁狀突的異常相對關係）。(C) 正確：無症狀志願者中前移位盤可高達約 34%。(D) 正確：上 retrodiskal 層纖維破裂可造成顯著關節盤不穩定。→ [[temporomandibular-joint-disorder-mri]]
questions.author: 葉智華

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 1. Direct and Indirect MR Imaging Signs of TMJ Dysfunction**

| 分類 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| **Direct signs** | |
| Abnormal disk morphologic features | Crumpled / Rounded / Flat / Perforated |
| Abnormal disk displacement in closed-mouth position — Anterior displacement | More frequently observed；Posterior band exceeds 10° (9,18,19) or 30° (20) from vertical |
| — Posterior displacement | Rare；Posterior band exceeds −10° (9,18,19) or −30° (20) from vertical |
| — Lateral or medial displacement | |

| Osteoarthritic changes of the condyle | Flattening / Osteophytes / Erosion / Sclerosis |
| **Indirect signs** | Large amount of joint fluid (joint effusion)；Increased thickness of LPM attachments；Rupture of retrodiskal layers |

Note.—Numbers in parentheses indicate reference numbers.

options.text: Cortical breakthrough
Periostitis
Soft tissue mass
Narrowing transitional zone

questions.questionText: What is not true about Kummell’s disease?

options.text: A vacuum phenomenon in a vertebral cleft
It indicates avascular necrosis
It indicates gas forming infection
It is a double line sign on MRI

questions.reference: p104 Musculoskeletal imaging Case Review Series. Second Edition Joseph S Yu；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p58
questions.explanation: 答案 C。Kümmell disease 是重大外傷後椎體「延遲性」缺血性壞死與塌陷，其椎體內真空裂隙（vacuum cleft）是缺血壞死在低壓下聚積的氮氣，而非產氣菌感染所致；真空裂隙徵象反而「反對」感染，故「代表產氣性感染」的 C 為不正確敘述。其餘為真：A 椎體裂隙內的真空現象為其招牌影像；B 其本質即椎體缺血性壞死（AVN）；D 骨壞死在 MRI 可見 double line sign，與其病生理一致。→ [[kummell-disease]]
questions.author: 林宇旌

questions.questionText: 請問下列何者構造「不」屬於triangular fibrocartilaginous complex (TFCC)的 一部分？

options.text: Disc proper
Dorsal radioulnar ligament
Volar radioulnar ligament
Meniscal homologue
Scapholunate ligament

questions.reference: Quant Imaging Med Surg 2017;7(4):443-460；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p60
questions.explanation: 答案 E。Scapholunate ligament（舟月韌帶）是位於舟骨與月骨之間的腕內在韌帶（intrinsic carpal ligament），與 TFCC 有一段距離，並非 TFCC 的組成，故 E 為「不屬於」者。其餘皆為 TFCC 的組成：A 關節盤本體（disc proper／triangular ligament）、B 背側橈尺韌帶（dorsal radioulnar ligament）、C 掌側橈尺韌帶（volar radioulnar ligament）、D 半月板同源物（ulnomeniscal homologue）。→ [[tfcc-palmer-classification]]
questions.author: 賴盈傑

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is wrong for intramuscular myxoma?

options.text: Low density on CT
Hypointense on T1-weighted images
Extremely hyperintense on T2-weighted images, similar to water
Usually only peripheral enhancement

questions.reference: American Journal of Roentgenology. 2015;204: 374-385；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p61
questions.explanation: 答案 D。肌肉內黏液瘤的黏液基質內富含血管，注射對比劑後多呈瀰漫性（約 57%）或厚周邊及間隔型（約 43%）的輕至中度異質強化，並非「僅周邊強化」，故 D 敘述錯誤。其餘正確：A CT 上呈邊界清楚的低密度病灶；B T1 呈低訊號；C T2 呈明顯高訊號、近似水的訊號。→ [[intramuscular-myxoma]]
questions.author: 傅真如

questions.questionText: According to AJCC 8th ed., if a renal pelvic cancer invades through the kidney into the perinephric fat, what is the T stage?

options.text: T1
T2
T3a
T3b
T4

questions.reference: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual 8th ed.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p62
questions.explanation: ⚠️ 本題含影像（官方詳解 PDF 第 62 頁），影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。
questions.author: 沈鼎文

imageOcr.markdown:
**T**
- **Ta:** noninvasive papillary tumor
- **Tis:** in situ (noninvasive flat)
- **T1:** through lamina propria into sub-epithelial connective tissues
- **T2:** into muscularis propria
- **T3:** invasion into peripelvic fat or renal parenchyma
- **T4:** direct invasion into adjacent structures or beyond renal capsule

**N**

Nodal staging is the same for TCC of any part of the urinary tract.
- **N0:** no nodal involvement
- **N1:** single node involved <2 cm
- **N2:** single node 2-5 cm or multiple nodes all <5 cm
- **N3:** one or more nodes >5 cm

**M**
- **M0:** no metastases
- **M1:** metastases identified

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about metastatic ovarian tumor is wrong?

options.text: About 50% of ovarian malignancy are metastatic lesions
Imaging findings in metastatic lesions are nonspecific, consisting of predominantly solid components or a mixture of cystic and solid areas
The colon and stomach are the most common primary tumor sites in ovarian metastasis, followed by the breast, lung, and contralateral ovary
Krukenberg tumors are metastatic tumors to the ovary that contain mucin-secreting “signet ring” cells and usually originate in the gastrointestinal tract
None of the above

questions.reference: CT and MR Imaging of Ovarian Tumors with Emphasis on Differential Diagnosis. RadioGraphics 2002; 22:1305–1325；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p63
questions.explanation: 答案 A。轉移性（secondary）腫瘤僅約佔所有卵巢腫瘤的 5–10%（而在「轉移至卵巢」的腫瘤中 Krukenberg 型可佔多達約 50%），並非「50% 的卵巢惡性腫瘤為轉移」，故 A 敘述錯誤、為正解。B 影像多屬非特異性、以實質為主或囊實混合、C 最常見原發部位為大腸與胃，其次乳房、肺、對側卵巢、D Krukenberg 腫瘤含分泌黏液之印戒細胞、多源自胃腸道，皆為正確敘述。→ [[krukenberg-tumor]]
questions.author: 黃彥綾

questions.questionText: With regard to endometrial carcinoma staging, which of the following is true?

options.text: Bladder bullous edema represents stage IV disease
Myometrial invasion represents stage IB disease
Invasion of cervical stroma correspond to an IB stage
Must include evaluation of the upper abdomen in grade 3 endometrioid and non-endometrioid tumors

questions.reference: AJCC cancer staging manual, 8th edition.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p64
questions.explanation: 答案 D。Grade 3 內膜樣及非內膜樣（高惡性度）腫瘤較易發生腹膜與上腹部轉移，分期評估須納入上腹部影像，故 D 正確、為正解。A 錯：真正膀胱黏膜侵犯才屬 stage IVA，單純 bullous edema（膀胱黏膜水腫）不足以證明侵犯；B 錯：肌層侵犯（<50%）屬 IA，≥50% 深層侵犯才是 IB；C 錯：子宮頸間質侵犯屬 stage II，而非 IB。→ [[endometrial-cancer-mri]]
questions.author: 黃彥綾

questions.questionText: 以下關於腎臟腫瘤的敘述，何者錯誤？

options.text: At MR imaging, a recognized feature in 60% of clear cell renal carcinomas is the presence of intralesional microscopic fat
Papillary RCCs usually demonstrate low T2 signal intensity and are hypovascular with progressive enhancement after contrast material administration
At MR imaging, oncocytomas may show a central stellate scar and spoke-wheel enhancement, and these are pathognomonic features, as no other tumors have similar characteristics
At MR imaging, lipid-poor AMLs are homogeneous and show low signal intensity on T2-weighted images due to the presence of abundant smooth muscle and high signal intensity on T1-weighted images

questions.reference: Differentiation of Solid Renal Tumors with Multiparametric MR Imaging. RadioGraphics 2017; 37:2026–2042；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p66
questions.explanation: 答案 C。oncocytoma 的中央星狀疤痕與 spoke-wheel（輪輻狀）強化雖為典型表現，但並非 pathognomonic：chromophobe RCC 約 30–40% 亦可見中央星狀疤痕與輪輻狀強化，部分 clear cell RCC 也有類似表現，故無法單憑此二徵象確診 oncocytoma，此敘述錯誤。A（clear cell RCC 約 60% 含微量胞內脂肪、反相位訊號掉落）正確；B（papillary RCC 常呈 T2 低訊號、乏血管、漸進性強化）正確；D（lipid-poor AML 因平滑肌豐富呈 T2 低訊號、T1 高訊號且均質）正確。→ [[renal-oncocytoma]]
questions.author: 張鈞弼

questions.questionText: 以下關於攝護腺腫瘤的敘述，何者錯誤？

options.text: At MR imaging, prostatic cystadenomas appear as multilocular T2-hyperintense cystic lesions with surrounding isointense soft tissue

MR spectroscopic imaging of prostatic sarcomas demonstrates a markedly decreased choline-to-citrate ratio, a finding that helps to differentiate sarcoma from benign mimics, such as unusually large BPH nodules

Most prostatic sarcomas appear as well-circumscribed masses that are homogeneously hypointense on T1-weighted MR images and heterogeneous on T2-weighted MR images and enhance avidly after contrast material administration
At MR imaging, prostatic paragangliomas often appear as mildly T2-hyperintense lobulated masses, with avid enhancement after contrast material administration

questions.reference: Beyond Prostate Adenocarcinoma: Expanding the Differential Diagnosis in Prostate Pathologic Conditions. RadioGraphics 2016; 36:1055–1075；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p67
questions.explanation: 答案 B。攝護腺肉瘤的 MR 頻譜應呈明顯「升高」而非降低的 choline-to-citrate ratio：腫瘤細胞 choline 上升，而正常與 BPH 上皮才是產 citrate 的細胞，故肉瘤 choline-to-citrate 比值明顯升高，可藉此與異常增大的 BPH 結節鑑別，題目寫「降低」故為錯誤。A（cystadenoma 呈多房 T2 高訊號囊性病灶＋周邊等訊號軟組織）正確；C（多數肉瘤界清、T1 均質低訊號、T2 異質、明顯強化）正確；D（paraganglioma 呈輕度 T2 高訊號分葉狀腫塊、明顯強化）正確。→ [[prostate-secondary-involvement]]
questions.author: 張鈞弼

questions.questionText: 請問下列何者構造「不」是Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm (IPMN) 的worrisome features or high-risk stigmata？

options.text: Cyst ≥3 cm
Main pancreatic duct ≥10 mm
Obstructive jaundice
Hemorrhage
thickened and enhancing cyst wall

questions.reference: Pancreatology. Sep-Oct 2017;17(5):738-753.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p68
questions.explanation: 答案 D。出血（hemorrhage）並非 Fukuoka／國際共識所列 IPMN 的 worrisome features 或 high-risk stigmata，故為正解。A（囊 ≥3 cm）屬 worrisome feature；B（主胰管 ≥10 mm）屬 high-risk stigmata；C（阻塞性黃疸）屬 high-risk stigmata；E（增厚且強化的囊壁）屬 worrisome feature，皆為共識列名徵象，唯出血不在其中。→ [[pancreatic-ipmn]]
questions.author: 賴盈傑

questions.questionText: Which is not the possible origin of the metastatic liver tumor with calcification?

options.text: Mucinous producing tumor colon, pancreas, stomach, or ovaries
Osteogenic sarcoma
Neuroblastoma
Lung cancer
All the above lesions are possible etiologies

questions.reference: Gastrointestinal Imaging: THE REQUISITES, ed 3, P 172.；10.1378/chest.111.4.1121；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p69
questions.explanation: 答案 E。鈣化性肝轉移的原發灶清單相當廣，A–D 皆為公認可造成鈣化性肝轉移之來源：A 產黏液腫瘤（大腸、胰、胃、卵巢，以黏液性腺癌最常見）、B 骨肉瘤（成骨性腫瘤可直接產生類骨質鈣化）、C 神經母細胞瘤（屬神經內分泌腫瘤群）、D 肺癌皆可鈣化，故「以上皆為可能病因」的 E 為正解。→ [[calcified-liver-metastases]]
questions.author: 陳奎安

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements concerning MR enterography in Crohn’s disease is true:

options.text: Presence of asymmetric mural hyperenhancement is a specific finding
Homogeneous symmetric mural hyperenhancement is a specific finding
Diagnosis of intramural edema can be made when high signal intensity on non–fat-suppressed T2-weighted image are found
Wall thickness should be evaluated and measured in any bowel segment
Stricture is defined as a bowel segment with luminal narrowing and unequivocal dilation (ie, ≥5 cm) of the upstream bowel segment

questions.reference: Small Bowel Crohn Disease at CT and MR Enterography: Imaging Atlas and Glossary of Terms Radiographics Mar-Apr 2020;40(2):354-375；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p70
questions.explanation: 答案 A。沿腸繫膜緣較嚴重的「不對稱」壁強化（asymmetric mural hyperenhancement）為 Crohn 的特異徵象，故 A 正確。B 錯，對稱、均質的壁強化並不特異，可見於多種情況；C 錯，腸壁水腫應於「脂肪抑制」T2 加權像或低／高 b 值 DWI 判讀，而非非脂肪抑制 T2；D 錯，壁厚須在以水或腸道對比劑「充分擴張」的腸段量測，塌陷腸段易高估；E 錯，狹窄定義為管腔狹窄＋上游無疑義擴張，門檻常定為 >3 cm 而非 ≥5 cm。→ [[inflammatory-bowel-disease]]
questions.author: 陳建銘

questions.questionText: Ｗhich statement about acute pancreatitis is not correct ?

options.text: Mild form acute pancreatitis may appear normal on imaging study
CT scan should be performed immediately to establish the diagnosis of acute pancreatitis
Asymptomatic pseudocysts do not warrant intervention regardless of size, location
In stable patients with infected necrosis, drainage should be delayed preferably for more than 4 weeks to allow liquification of the contents and the development of a fibrous wall around the necrosis

questions.reference: Reference 1. Acute pancreatitis. The Lancet 396; 726-734; Nov. 2020 2. Radiographics 2016: 36: 675-687 3. American College of Gastroenterology guideline: management of aucte pancreaitis 2020；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p71
questions.explanation: 答案 B。急性胰臟炎的診斷主要依臨床症狀與血清酵素，CECT／MRI 應保留給診斷不明或臨床未改善者，且症狀 <72 小時的早期 CT 會低估壞死範圍，故「應立即做 CT 以建立診斷」為錯誤。A（輕型胰臟炎影像可正常）正確；C（無症狀 pseudocyst 不論大小、位置皆不需介入）正確；D（穩定病人之感染性壞死宜延後、最好 >4 週待內容物液化與周圍纖維壁形成再引流）正確。→ [[pancreatitis-severity]]
questions.author: 曾振輝

questions.questionText: Another name for the Myenteric plexus is the ___.

options.text: Submucosal plexus
Brachial plexus
Auerbach’s plexus
Lumbar plexus

questions.reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK551559/；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p72
questions.explanation: 答案 C。Myenteric plexus 即 Auerbach plexus，位於肌層固有膜的環肌與縱肌兩層之間，主要調控腸道蠕動，故選 C。A Submucosal plexus（別名 Meissner plexus，位於黏膜下層）為腸神經系統的另一神經叢，並非 myenteric；B Brachial plexus（臂神經叢）與 D Lumbar plexus（腰神經叢）為軀體周邊神經叢，與腸胃道無關。→ [[enteric-nervous-system-plexuses]]
questions.author: 呂嘉偉

questions.questionText: Please arrange the order (from high to low) of osmolarity of iodinated contrast media: 1. Iothalamate meglumine 60 (Conray 60) 2. Iohexol 350 (Omnipaque 350) 3. Iodixanol 320 (Visipaque 320)
questions.reference: 2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p73
questions.explanation:
答案 A（1>2>3）。滲透壓由所含有效溶質顆粒數決定，同碘量下離子性單體最高、非離子性單體次之、非離子性雙體最低。
三者中 Iothalamate meglumine 60（Conray 60）為離子性單體、滲透壓最高（約 1400 mOsm/kg）；Iohexol 350（Omnipaque 350）為非離子性單體、居中（約 844 mOsm/kg）；Iodixanol 320（Visipaque 320）為非離子性雙體、等滲、最低（約 290 mOsm/kg，接近血漿）。
故由高至低為 1>2>3，選 A，其餘排序皆誤。
→ [[iodinated-contrast-media]]
questions.author: 朱崧毓

questions.questionText: Which drug(s) would be the hepatobiliary-specific MR contrast agent? 1. Mangafodipir trisodium (Mn-DPDP) 2. Gadobenate dimeglumine (Gd-BOPTA) 3. Gadoxetic acid (Gd-EOB-DTPA)
questions.reference: 2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p77
questions.explanation:
答案 C（1+2+3）。三種都是肝膽特異性 MR 對比劑：(1) Mangafodipir trisodium（Mn-DPDP）為錳基肝細胞特異劑；(2) Gadobenate dimeglumine（Gd-BOPTA，MultiHance）約 3–5% 經膽道排泄；(3) Gadoxetic acid（Gd-EOB-DTPA，Primovist）約 50% 經膽道排泄。
三者皆由肝細胞經 OATP 攝取後、部分再經 MRP2 排入膽道，可提供肝膽期影像，故全選，答案 C。
→ [[hepatobiliary-mri-contrast]]
questions.author: 朱崧毓

questions.questionText: 以下關於 pleural malignancy的敘述，何者錯誤:

options.text: The most common malignancy of the pleura is metastasis
The malignant pleural mesothelioma is the most common primary malignant neoplasm
The malignant pleural mesothelioma has a strong association with asbestos exposure
In contrast to lung cancer, malignant pleural mesothelioma is more likely to involve the visceral pleura

questions.reference: Lymphatic Pathways of the Thorax: Predictable Patterns of Spread American Journal of Roentgenology. 2021;216: 649-658 https://www.ajronline.org/doi/full/10.2214/AJR.20.23523；10.1148/rg.271065105；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p78
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題問肋膜惡性的敘述何者「錯誤」。(D) 稱間皮瘤相較肺癌更易侵犯臟層肋膜（visceral pleura），此敘述錯誤——惡性間皮瘤主要累及「壁層肋膜（parietal pleura）」多於臟層；而肺癌自肺實質內向外生長，反而先侵犯臟層肋膜，兩者方向恰好相反，故 (D) 為誤。
(A) 正確：肋膜最常見的惡性病灶是轉移，遠多於原發性間皮瘤，常以惡性肋膜積液表現。
(B) 正確：惡性間皮瘤是最常見的原發性肋膜惡性腫瘤。
(C) 正確：惡性間皮瘤與石綿（asbestos）暴露強相關，潛伏期可達數十年。
補充：轉移的原發排序以肺癌第一、乳癌第二；Leung 四徵象（結節狀、環周、壁層 >1 cm、縱膈肋膜受累）有助判別惡性肋膜增厚。
→ [[pleural-metastases]]
questions.author:
陳煥武
Reference: RadioGraphics 1996;16:613–644

questions.questionText: In terms of connective tissue disease associated with interstitial lung disease (CTD-ILD), which one of the followings is not correct?

options.text: NSIP is the most common finding in cases of CTD-ILD
Among CTD-ILD, UIP is most commonly found in cases of rheumatoid arthritis
Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonitis is relatively more commonly found in patients with Sjogren syndrome, it may also be found in cases of rheumatoid arthritis or SLE, but relatively rare
Organizing pneumonia is more commonly found in cases of systemic sclerosis than in those of polymyositis/dermatomyositis

questions.reference: Mayo Clinic Process. Feb 2019:94121:309-325；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p79
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題問 CTD-ILD 的敘述何者「不正確」。(D) 稱 organizing pneumonia（OP）在 systemic sclerosis 比 polymyositis/dermatomyositis 更常見，此敘述錯誤——OP 其實以 PM/DM（尤其 antisynthetase syndrome，常呈 NSIP-OP overlap／fibrosing OP）較常見，而 SSc 以 NSIP 為主、OP 少見，方向相反，故 (D) 不正確。
(A) 正確：NSIP（尤 fibrotic NSIP）是 CTD-ILD 整體最常見的型態。
(B) 正確：在各 CTD 中，UIP 最常見於 rheumatoid arthritis（RA 是唯一以 UIP 為主導、最像 IPF 的 CTD）。
(C) 正確：lymphocytic interstitial pneumonitis（LIP）最具 Sjögren 代表性，亦可見於 RA 或 SLE，但相對少見。
→ [[ctd-ild]]
questions.author: 萬永亮

questions.questionText: Which statement about radiation-induced lung disease is incorrect?

options.text: It is customary to use the radiation therapy first date as a reference point for determining the dates of tissue changes
Radiographically evident changes are uncommon when the total radiation dose delivered is less than 30 Gy
More frequently changes are detected with CT by 4 weeks
Radiographic findings typically appear as heterogeneous opacities or consolidation

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2019; 39:344–366；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p80
questions.explanation:
答案 A。本題問關於放射性肺損傷（RILD）何者「錯誤」。(A) 稱以放療「首日（first date）」作為判定組織變化時序的參考點，此敘述錯誤——慣例是以放療「完成日（completion date）」而非開始日為計時基準，故 (A) 為誤。
(B) 正確：不論放療技術為何，總劑量 <30 Gy 時影像可見變化少見，>40 Gy 時幾乎必然出現。
(C) 正確：CT 比胸片更早、更敏感；急性放射性肺炎最早可於治療後 1 週於 CT 呈現，但更常在 4 週時被偵測到。
(D) 正確：影像典型呈治療野內、不循肺葉／肺節分界的異質性 opacity 或 consolidation，急性期約於放療結束後 3–4 週出現。
→ [[radiation-induced-lung-disease]]
questions.author: 曾淑琦

questions.questionText: 關於急性胸痛的電腦斷層, 何者是最不可能的原因?

options.text: Aortic dissection
Pneumothorax
Pleural effusion
Interstitial lung fibrosis

questions.reference: 2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p81
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題問急性胸痛的 CT 病因中何者「最不可能」。(D) interstitial lung fibrosis（間質性肺病／肺纖維化）屬慢性病程，臨床以漸進性呼吸困難、乾咳、疲倦、杵狀指為主，並非急性胸痛的典型病因，故為最不可能者。
(A) aortic dissection 是急性胸痛的致命病因之一，屬 triple rule-out 三大血管性殺手（另含肺栓塞、急性冠心症）。
(B) pneumothorax（氣胸）為可致急性胸痛的非血管急症，CT 可見胸膜線外無肺紋、深溝徵。
(C) pleural effusion／肋膜炎亦可造成急性胸痛，屬 CT 可見的急性病因。
本題作答邏輯是「急性 vs 慢性病程」而非特定影像徵象，屬低鑑別度題。
→ [[acute-chest-pain-ct]]
questions.author: 劉原彰

questions.questionText: Which statement about COVID-19 on chest imaging is incorrect?

options.text: Chest CT findings reported in more than 70% of RT-PCR test–proven COVID-19 cases included ground-glass opacities, lower lobe involvement, and posterior predilection
Chest imaging is indicated as a screening test for COVID-19 in asymptomatic patients or in patients with mild respiratory symptoms of COVID-19

A negative chest CT examination result certainly does not exclude COVID-19. The proportion of false-positive chest CT examination results is substantial and due to overlapping imaging features with numerous other diseases
CT is not the standard for the diagnosis of COVID-19, but its findings help suggest the diagnosis in the appropriate setting

questions.reference: Chest CT in COVID-19: What the Radiologist Needs to Know Thomas C. Kwee , Robert M. Kwee RadioGraphics Vol. 40, No. 7 https://doi.org/10.1148/rg.2020200159；10.1148/rg.2020200159；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p82
questions.explanation:
答案 B。本題問關於 COVID-19 胸部影像何者「錯誤」。(B) 稱胸部影像可作為無症狀或僅輕微呼吸道症狀者的 COVID-19 篩檢工具，此敘述錯誤——胸部影像「不」建議用於無症狀或輕症者的篩檢，診斷應以 RT-PCR 為主，CT 保留用於評估併發症或鑑別診斷，故 (B) 為誤。
(A) 正確：逾 70% 經 RT-PCR 確診病例的 CT 可見磨玻璃影、下葉侵犯與後側優勢分布（亦含血管擴張、雙側異常）。
(C) 正確：CT 陰性不能排除 COVID-19，且其影像與眾多其他疾病重疊、偽陽性比例不低。
(D) 正確：CT 非 COVID-19 的診斷標準，但在適當臨床情境下其表現有助提示診斷。
→ [[covid19-chest-ct]]
questions.author: 許文麒

questions.questionText: Regarding coronary CTA, which one of the followings is most likely to be wrong?

options.text: For optimal interpretation, once you find different degree of coronary stenosis in 2 different cardiac phases (with optimal image quality), you should prefer the one with more severe stenosis
For optimal assessment, it is better to have at least two phases of coronary images in cases of CAD RADS 3 or 4 lesions
In comparison with the invasive coronary angiography, coronary diameter stenosis at systolic phase is more pronounced than that at diastolic phase

Overestimation of stenosis is more pronounced in calcified lesions. In general, it is not necessary to evaluate CTA (with good image quality) in multiple phases once you find a lesion which is CAD-RADS 1

questions.reference: J Cardiovas Computed Tomogr 2017;11:105-110；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p90
questions.explanation: 答案 A。CT 血管攝影相較侵入性導管攝影（ICA）本就系統性「高估」狹窄，且收縮期高估幅度大於舒張期；若在兩個皆屬良質的期相看到不同狹窄程度時，一律挑「較嚴重」的那一期，只會放大這種系統性高估，因此 A 的作法錯誤，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(B) CAD-RADS 3、4 病灶宜至少取兩個期相綜合判讀；(C) 相較 ICA，收縮期量得的管徑狹窄較舒張期明顯（QCT 收縮期高估約 9.4–11.9%、舒張期約 5.7–8.5%）；(D) 鈣化病灶因 blooming 高估更明顯，而 CAD-RADS 1 的良質影像通常不需多期相評估。→ [[ccta]]
questions.author: 阮昱翔

questions.questionText: Which of the following concerning general technical requirements of cardiac CT is false?

options.text: 64-row CT is superior to 16-row CT in terms of image quality and diagnostic accuracy
Imaging during a single heartbeat is feasible with 320-row volume CT and second-generation dual source CT
Requiring ECG for gating and triggering of acquisitions
Dual-head contrast agent injector for saline flush
None of the above

questions.reference: Cardiac CT. Marc Deway. Springer. ISBN 978-3-642-14021-1；10.1016/j.ejrad.2006.02.009；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p91
questions.explanation: 答案 E。A 到 D 都是正確的心臟 CT 技術要求，因此「以上皆非（None of the above）」反而是唯一錯誤的選項，為本題所選。逐項來看：(A) 64 排 CT 在時間/空間解析度、影像品質與診斷準確度上優於 16 排；(B) 320 排容積 CT 與第二代雙源 CT 可在單一心跳內完成整顆心臟造影；(C) 心臟 CT 需靠心電圖進行 gating（回溯式）或 triggering（前瞻式）以凍結心臟運動；(D) 雙頭高壓注射器可在對比劑後接生理食鹽水沖洗，推進團注、節省對比劑並減少上腔靜脈與右心的條紋偽影。四者皆真，故答案為 E。→ [[ccta]]
questions.author: 阮昱翔

questions.questionText: 關於severe aortic stenosis 的描述, 何者為非?

options.text: 通常發生在70歲以上的老人
Severe aortic stenosis的定義是指心臟舒張期時的主動脈瓣膜開口面積 小於100公厘平方
Severe aortic stenosis的定義是指心臟收縮期時的主動脈瓣膜開口面積 小於100公厘平方
主動脈瓣膜通常伴隨鈣化

questions.reference: https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/CIRCIMAGING.119.009834；10.1161/CIRCIMAGING.119.009834；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p92
questions.explanation: 答案 B。主動脈瓣口面積必須在「收縮期」（瓣膜開啟時）量測，舒張期主動脈瓣是關閉的，量到的會是閉合線而非開口，因此 B 把定義寫成「舒張期」開口面積 <100 mm² 是錯的，為本題所選；同樣數值改成「收縮期」的 C 才正確。其餘：(A) 退化性鈣化性主動脈瓣狹窄好發於 70 歲以上長者；(D) 狹窄的主動脈瓣通常伴隨明顯鈣化。補充：severe AS 一般定義為瓣口面積 <1.0 cm²（<100 mm²）、平均壓力梯度 >40 mmHg 或最大流速 >4 m/s。→ [[aortic-stenosis]]
questions.author: 劉原彰

questions.questionText: Which one of the following options about “Buerger’s disease” is “incorrect”?

options.text: Also known as “thrombangitis obliterans”. Strong association with smoking
Unknown etiology. About 20% of all chronic vascular diseases
Instep claudication with distal ulceration. Symptoms abate on cessation of smoking and return on its resumption
Location at legs (80%) and arms (10-20%). Skip lesions. Absence of generalized arteriosclerosis

questions.reference: Radiology Review Manual 8th Edition page 2057；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p93
questions.explanation: 答案 B。Buerger disease 與大量吸菸高度相關，並非病因不明（unknown etiology），且「約佔所有慢性血管疾病 20%」的比例明顯過高——依 Radiology Review Manual 的歐美數據，其盛行率僅約 0.5–0.6%（亞洲、中東較高），因此 B 為錯誤敘述，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(A) 又稱 thromboangiitis obliterans（血栓閉塞性血管炎），與吸菸強相關；(C) 表現為足弓（instep）跛行合併遠端潰瘍，戒菸後症狀緩解、復抽則復發；(D) 好發下肢（約 80%）與上肢（10–20%），呈跳躍性病灶，且無全身性動脈粥狀硬化背景。→ [[buerger-disease]]
questions.author: 謝任富

questions.questionText: Which of the following ligaments is the strongest ligament in the lateral ligaments of ankle?

options.text: Anterior talofibular ligament
Calcaneofibular ligament
Posterior talofibular ligament
Spring ligament

questions.reference: Magn Reson Imaging Clin N Am 16 (2008) 1–18, page 2；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p94
questions.explanation: 答案 C。踝關節外側副韌帶由前而後為 ATFL、CFL、PTFL，其中後距腓韌帶（PTFL）最強、最厚、也最少受傷，故為「最強者」。A 前距腓韌帶（ATFL）反而最弱、且在內翻扭傷中最常撕裂；B 跟腓韌帶（CFL）強度居中；D Spring ligament（跟舟足底／彈簧韌帶）屬內側／足底支撐結構，並非踝外側韌帶，為干擾選項。→ [[lateral-ankle-ligaments]]
questions.author: 洪猷崇

questions.questionText: Which of the following pulse sequence is useful to document hemosiderine content in giant cell tumor of tendon sheath?

options.text: T2WI with fat saturation
T1WI
Inversion recovery
T2＊gradient echo

questions.reference: Megnetic resonance Imaging orthopaedics and sport medicine 3rd edition volum 2 page 1822；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p95
questions.explanation: 答案 D。含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin）為順磁性物質，在 T2* 梯度回訊序列會造成局部磁場不均而產生 blooming（訊號外溢／流失），因此最能凸顯並記錄含鐵血黃素含量；GCTTS 富含細胞內外含鐵血黃素沉積，是此序列的判讀重點。A T2WI 加脂肪抑制、B T1WI、C inversion recovery 皆缺乏 T2* 的磁敏感效應，對 hemosiderin 的敏感度低、不會產生 blooming，故不適合記錄含鐵血黃素。→ [[giant-cell-tumor-tendon-sheath]]
questions.author: 洪猷崇

questions.questionText: Which of the following components of the ulnar collateral ligament is often intact even when the radial head and coronoid process are both fractured ?

options.text: Anterior bundles
Transverse bundles
Posterior bundles
None of above

questions.reference: Magn Reson Imaging Clin N Am 23 (2015) 427–440 page 433；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p96
questions.explanation: 答案 A。anterior bundle 為 UCL（MCL 複合體）抗外翻的主力，附著於 coronoid 的 sublime tubercle。肘關節骨折-脫位時 coronoid 常為小的 tip 型骨折，位置在 sublime tubercle 遠端，故即使 radial head 與 coronoid 同時骨折，anterior bundle 的附著點常未被波及而保持完整。B transverse（Cooper's）bundle 幾乎不參與肘關節穩定；C posterior bundle 附著於內側鷹嘴，非本題所指；D none of above 錯，因 A 成立。→ [[ulnar-collateral-ligament-injury]]
questions.author: 洪猷崇

imageOcr.markdown:
**Box 2. Elbow instability: teaching points**

1. The most important static soft tissue constraints are the LUCL and the anterior bundle of the UCL.
2. Caution should be exercised when making the diagnosis of partial UCL detachment: remember the striated appearance of the ligament.
3. UCL midsubstance disruptions account for most traumatic injuries.
4. Conventional MR imaging shows sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy that approach 100% for full-thickness UCL tears.
5. The anterior bundle of the UCL is often intact even when the radial head and coronoid process are both fractured.
6. Posttraumatic laxity, disruption, or avulsion of the LUCL is considered to be the main contributing factor in PLRI.
7. The most common injury to the LUCL is soft tissue avulsion at the proximal humeral attachment, often with concomitant injury to the common origin of the RCL.
8. Elbow dislocation is most commonly associated with a torn capsule, but the capsule may be intact if the coronoid process is fractured.
9. An abnormal posterolateral plicae usually reflects incompetence of the UCL.

questions.questionText: Elevated 2-hydroxyglutarate peak (2-HG) resonating at 2.25 ppm can be found in (可複選)

options.text: Diffuse Astrocytoma, IDH-Mutant
Anaplastic Astrocytoma, IDH-Mutant
Diffuse Astrocytoma, IDH-Wild-Type
Glioblastoma, IDH-Wild-Type

questions.reference: Osborn’s Brain 2nd edition P.529；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p97
questions.explanation: 答案 A,B。2-hydroxyglutarate（2-HG）是 IDH 突變腫瘤專屬的代謝物——突變型 IDH 把 α-ketoglutarate 還原成 2-HG 並堆積，於 MRS 上約 2.25 ppm 出現波峰；只要是 IDH-mutant 的星細胞瘤都可測得，故 (A) Diffuse astrocytoma, IDH-mutant 與 (B) Anaplastic astrocytoma, IDH-mutant 皆為正解。(C) Diffuse astrocytoma, IDH-wild-type 與 (D) Glioblastoma, IDH-wild-type 為 IDH-wildtype，不產生 2-HG，故無此峰。本題為複選。→ [[2-hydroxyglutarate-idh-mutant-glioma]]
questions.author: 鄧木火

questions.questionText: Regarding to Fabry disease, which one is wrong

options.text: An X-linked lysosomal storage disorder of glycosphingolipid metabolism
NECT: bilateral, often symmetric calcification in basal ganglia and thalami
Never dolichoectasia
Abnormal accumulation of glycosphingolipids in various tissues

questions.reference: Anne G. Osborn, Gary L. Hedlund, Karen L Salzman: Osborn’s Brain Imaging, pathology and anatomy, 2nd edition.  Elsevier 2018. Page 1012-1014；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p98
questions.explanation: 答案 C。法布瑞氏症典型即會出現基底動脈 dolichoectasia（醣鞘脂堆積導致的血管病變），故「Never dolichoectasia（絕不會擴張迂曲）」為錯誤敘述。(A) 正確：X 性聯之溶酶體儲積症、α-半乳糖苷酶 A 缺乏所致醣鞘脂代謝障礙。(B) 正確：NECT 上可見雙側、常對稱之基底核與視丘鈣化。(D) 正確：醣鞘脂異常堆積於多種組織（血管內皮、腎、心、神經等）。→ [[fabry-disease-pulvinar]]
questions.author: 鄧木火

questions.questionText: Regarding to MS, which is wrong ?

options.text: Peak = 20-40 years
Optic neuritis (50% eventually develop MS)
T2 hyperintense Dawson fingers

questions.reference: Osborn’s Brain 2nd edition P454-461；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p99
questions.explanation: 答案 B。多發性硬化症女性多於男性（F:M 約 2:1），選項 B 寫成「F:M ≈ 1:2」把男女比顛倒，故為錯誤敘述。(A) 正確：發病年齡峰值約 20–40 歲。(C) 正確：視神經炎（optic neuritis）約半數日後發展為 MS。(D) 正確：T2 高訊號的 Dawson fingers（腦室周圍沿深髓靜脈垂直排列的斑塊）為典型徵象。→ [[multiple-sclerosis-imaging]]
questions.author: 鄧木火

questions.questionText: Which description about pulmonary embolism is wrong?

options.text: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is stratified into massive, submassive, and low risk based on the presence of hypotension, right ventricular dysfunction or dilation, or the absence of these, respectively; this stratification is based on increasing mortality risk
Certain imaging features (eg, right ventricle/left ventricle ratio, septal bowing) at CT angiography and echocardiography are associated with worse 30-day outcomes

In patients with massive PE, more aggressive treatment including systemic thrombolysis, catheter-directed therapy, and/or surgical embolectomy is warranted to rapidly restore pulmonary blood flow and prevent death
Oxygen saturation of less than 90% is associated with a greater 30-day mortality risk

questions.reference: Stratification, Imaging, and Management of Acute Massive and Submassive Pulmonary Embolism. https://doi.org/10.1148/radiol.2017151978；10.1148/radiol.2017151978；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p100
questions.explanation:
答案 A。此題問肺栓塞敘述何者「錯誤」。A 稱危險分層（massive→submassive→low risk）是依「遞增（increasing）」死亡風險排列，方向恰好相反：massive（大量）死亡率最高、submassive 次之、low risk 最低，屬「遞減」排列，故 A 為錯誤敘述。B 正確：CTA 與心臟超音波上的右心室/左心室比值（RV/LV ratio）、室間隔向左膨出（septal bowing）等右心負荷徵象與較差的 30 天預後相關。C 正確：massive PE 需更積極的再灌流治療（全身溶栓、導管導向治療、外科取栓）以迅速恢復肺血流、避免死亡。D 正確：血氧飽和度 <90% 與較高的 30 天死亡風險相關。
→ [[acute-pe-ct-severity]]
questions.author: 方詩珺

questions.questionText: What is false about the possible usual interstitial pneumonia pattern according to 2011 an Official ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT Statement: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Evidence-based Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management?

options.text: Honeycombing with or without traction bronchiectasis
Subpleural, basal predominance
Reticular abnormality
Absence of features listed as inconsistent with UIP pattern

questions.reference: 2011 an Official ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT Statement: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Evidence-based Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p101
questions.explanation:
答案 A。依 2011 ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT IPF 指引，「possible UIP pattern」的條件為 subpleural＋basal 為主的分布、網狀影（reticular），且不具與 UIP 不符（inconsistent）的特徵，但關鍵前提是「無 honeycombing」。A 所述「honeycombing 伴或不伴牽引性支氣管擴張」一旦出現蜂窩化，即屬 definite（typical）UIP pattern，而非 possible UIP，故 A 為錯誤選項。B（subpleural、basal 為主）、C（reticular abnormality）、D（缺乏 inconsistent-with-UIP 特徵）皆為 possible UIP 的正確組成條件。附註：2018 指引改為 typical／probable／indeterminate／alternative 四分類，2011 的 possible UIP 對應到之後的 probable UIP。
→ [[ipf]]
questions.author: 方詩珺

questions.questionText: 有關lung cancer的TNM staging，下列何者不屬於T4?

options.text: Tumor measuring >7 cm in greatest dimension
Separate tumor nodule or nodules in a different lobe of the same lung
Directly invades chest wall
Directly invades diaphragm wall

questions.reference: Revisions to the TNM Staging of Lung Cancer: Rationale, Significance, and Clinical Application RadioGraphics 2018; 38:374–391；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p102
questions.explanation:
答案 C。此題問何者「不」屬於 AJCC 8th 肺癌 T4。C 的「直接侵犯胸壁（chest wall）」屬 T3 而非 T4——胸壁、心包、膈神經侵犯以及同肺葉衛星結節皆歸 T3。A（腫瘤 >7 cm）符合 T4 的大小門檻；B（同側「不同肺葉」的另一顆腫瘤結節）屬 T4；D（直接侵犯膈肌 diaphragm）亦為 T4。故不屬 T4 者為 C。對照記憶：同肺葉衛星結節＝T3、同側不同肺葉結節＝T4、對側肺結節則升為 M1a。
→ [[lung-cancer-tnm-staging]]

questions.questionText: Given a patient with anterior pelvic arch fracture and soft tissue abnormalities indicative of a perivesical effusion demonstrated by the radiography. Which of the following procedure should be performed next?

options.text: Insertion of the Foley catheter
Retrograde urethrocystography
Cystoscopy
Pelvic angiography

questions.reference: Aunt Minnie’s Atlas Imaging-Specific Diagnosis (page 375)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p104
questions.author: 林彥懷

questions.questionText: Which of the finding about the acute renal infarction can be seen in the computed tomography?

options.text: Cortical rim sign
Edematous enlargement
Wedged-shaped area of absent enhancement
All of the above

questions.reference: Radiology Review Manual 5th edition (page 953)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p105
questions.explanation: 答案 D。急性腎梗塞於 CT 可見以上三種所見：A cortical rim sign（皮質環徵，包膜下皮質靠側支循環仍持續強化，約梗塞後 6–8 小時出現、見於約半數）、B edematous enlargement（急性期腎臟可正常或水腫性腫大，可伴包膜下積液／腎周條紋）、C wedge-shaped area of absent enhancement（周邊楔形無強化區，base 朝腎包膜、apex 朝腎門），三者皆為典型表現，故選「以上皆是」。→ [[renal-infarction]]
questions.author: 林彥懷

questions.questionText: (???No answer) Which of the description is not related to type I urethral valves?

options.text: It is an urogenital membrane
It may result in the vesicoureteral reflux
It may cause urinary tract infection
It is discovered most commonly in the neonatal period

questions.reference: Radiology Review Manual 5th edition (page 938)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p106
questions.explanation: 答案 D。Type I 後尿道瓣（PUV）嚴重者多於「產前」經超音波（羊水過少＋雙側腎積水）診斷，較輕者於嬰兒／兒童期表現，並非「最常於新生兒期」被發現，故 D 為與 type I 較不相關／不正確之敘述。A（本質為 urogenital／後尿道膜性結構）正確；B（約 50% 合併膀胱輸尿管逆流 VUR）正確；C（膀胱小樑、尿滯留易致泌尿道感染）正確。→ [[urethral-anomalies-congenital]]
questions.author: 林彥懷

questions.questionText: Which description about features of coarctation is incorrect?

options.text: berry aneurysms are a recognized complication
the isthmus of the aorta is the usual site
a lateral chest X-ray may show dilated internal mammary arteries
the post-ductal type presents in infancy

questions.reference: Pediatric Radiology Practical Imaging Evaluation of Infants and Children 2018 p.537；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p107
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題問何者「錯誤」。D 錯：導管後型（postductal／adult 型）多為單純型縮窄，常到較晚期才被發現；於嬰兒期表現者是導管前型（preductal／infantile 型，遠端血流依賴 PDA、常合併其他心內畸形）。A 正確：顱內漿果狀動脈瘤（berry aneurysm）為公認合併症，可致蜘蛛膜下腔出血。B 正確：峽部（左鎖骨下動脈遠端、鄰近 ductus arteriosus）為最常見的縮窄部位。C 正確：側位胸片可見擴張的內乳（internal mammary）動脈側支（並伴下肋緣凹痕／Roesler 徵）。
→ [[aortic-coarctation]]
questions.author: 周定遠

questions.questionText: The following characteristic features of Sturge-Weber syndrome is correct?

options.text: there is a “strawberry” nevus on the face
the lesion is usually bilateral
the intracerebral vascular lesion is usually well shown on arteriography
calcification in the occipital cortex is visible on plain skull films

questions.reference: Pediatric Radiology Practical Imaging Evaluation of Infants and Children 2018 p.154；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p108
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題問何者「正確」。D 正確：Sturge-Weber 的腦回狀／tram-track 皮質下鈣化多位於頂枕（parieto-occipital）區，歷史上可於顱骨平片上顯示。A 錯：臉部為葡萄酒色斑（port-wine nevus／capillary malformation），而非草莓狀血管瘤（strawberry nevus，後者屬嬰兒型血管瘤）。B 錯：病灶約 85% 為單側（與色斑同側），並非通常雙側。C 錯：軟腦膜血管瘤為低流量病灶，動脈攝影常無法清楚顯示（DSA 反而顯示淺層皮質靜脈缺如、深部靜脈引流異常擴大）。
→ [[sturge-weber-syndrome]]
questions.author: 周定遠

questions.questionText: In the followings which one is not a characteristic feature of air-bronchogram?

options.text: Hyaline membrane disease (SDD)
Pulmonary edema
Bronchogenic cyst
Lobar pneumonia

questions.reference: Pediatric Radiology Practical Imaging Evaluation of Infants and Children 2018 p.385；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p109
questions.explanation:
答案 C。本題問何者「非」air bronchogram 的特徵性成因。C 為答案：支氣管源性囊腫（bronchogenic cyst）是充液的先天性囊腫、並非肺泡填充過程，內部沒有通暢的含氣支氣管，故不會產生 air bronchogram。A（透明膜病／SDD）、B（肺水腫）、D（大葉性肺炎）皆因肺泡腔被液體或滲出物取代、而近端支氣管仍通暢，故可見 air bronchogram。air bronchogram 的本質即「肺泡腔內空氣被非空氣物質取代、近端氣道仍通暢」，屬肺實質內病變徵象。
→ [[air-bronchogram]]
questions.author: 周定遠

questions.questionText: Which description about leukemia is wrong?

options.text: Radiological bone changes are more likely to be seen in children than adults
Radiological bone changes can develop before there is a change in the peripheral blood picture
Osteosclerosis is a recognized feature
Myeloid leukemia is commoner in adult than children

questions.reference: Caffy’s Pediatric Diagnostic Imaging 11th ed. p.3005~6；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p110
questions.explanation:
答案 D。⚠️ 本題標準答案為 D，但依概念查證，D 實為「正確」敘述，四個選項皆成立、找不到明確錯誤項，此題疑有瑕疵，建議覆核原卷。逐項說明：A 正確——白血病的骨骼變化在兒童較成人更常見、更廣泛（兒童紅骨髓活躍）。B 正確——骨骼變化可先於周邊血象改變出現（傳統教學）。C 正確——osteosclerosis 為公認表現（骨小樑變粗可呈骨硬化外觀）。D 敘述「骨髓性白血病（myeloid leukemia）成人較兒童常見」——AML 好發 >65 歲、CML 約 64 歲，皆好發成人，故此敘述其實也正確，非可判為錯誤之選項。
→ [[leukemia-skeletal-manifestations]]
questions.author: 周定遠

questions.questionText: Which description of features of Ebstein’s disease is incorrect?

options.text: enlargement of right ventricle
enlargement of right atrium
enlargement of azygos vein
cyanosis

questions.reference: Caffy’s Pediatric Diagnostic Imaging 11th ed. p.1740；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p111
questions.explanation:
答案 A。本題問 Ebstein 異常的特徵何者「錯誤」。A 錯：Ebstein 異常是三尖瓣（尤其中隔葉與後葉）向心尖方向下移，使部分右心室被「心房化」，結果功能性右心室反而變小、右心房則巨大擴張（呈 box-shaped／wall-to-wall heart），故「右心室擴大」不正確——真正擴大的是右心房。B 正確：右心房擴大。C 正確：三尖瓣逆流致體靜脈回流受阻，下腔靜脈與 azygos vein 擴張。D 正確：新生兒期可因 right-to-left shunt 而發紺。
→ [[congenital-heart-disease-chest-xray]]
questions.author: 周定遠

questions.questionText: 有關 pulmonary venous (PV) anatomy 下列何者為非? RSPV: right superior pulmonary vein LSPV: left superior pulmonary vein RIPV: right inferior pulmonary vein LIPV: left inferior pulmonary vein RUL: right upper lobe RML: right middle lobe

options.text: 大部分情況有 有四條 主要PV drained 至 LA
大部分情況RUL 及 RML 的 PV drained 至 RSPV
大部分情況下 四條主要PV 中RSPV 管徑最大
大部分情況下四條主要PV中 RIPV管徑最小

questions.explanation: 答案 D。四條主要肺靜脈中口徑最小者是「左下肺靜脈（LIPV）」（開口徑約 14.8 mm），而非右下肺靜脈（RIPV，約 17.1 mm），因此 D 為錯誤敘述，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(A) 約七成人為兩上兩下共四條主要肺靜脈直接匯入左心房；(B) 右上葉與右中葉的靜脈多引流入右上肺靜脈（RSPV）；(C) 四條中以 RSPV 口徑最大（約 17.6 mm）。整體口徑排序約為 RSPV > RIPV > LSPV > LIPV。→ [[pulmonary-vein-anatomy]]
questions.author: 吳美翰

questions.questionText: 依據 2017 年版ESC/ ACC guideline for percutaneous treatment of aortic stenosis 的 indication是無法開刀且 預期 procedure 後可存活 大於多久?

options.text: 3 months
6 months
12 months
24 months

questions.reference: European Radiology https://doi.org/10.1007/s00330-019-06357-8 /Published online: 5 September 2019 y (2020) 30:2627–2650；10.1007/s00330-019-06357-8；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p113
questions.explanation: 答案 C。依 2017 年 ESC/EACTS（與 ACC/AHA）瓣膜性心臟病指引，對不適合外科手術的嚴重症狀性主動脈瓣狹窄病人，經導管主動脈瓣置換（TAVI）的適應症要求預期術後能改善生活品質且預期存活大於一年（>12 個月），因此答案為 C；3、6、24 個月皆非指引所訂門檻。此門檻的用意在於避免對預期壽命過短、無法從介入獲益的病人施行手術。→ [[tavi]]
questions.author: 吳美翰

questions.questionText: 有關pre procedure CT for Percutaneous aortic valve implantation 下列何者為 非?

options.text: 因為要使影像清楚 scan 前最好使用 b blockeer 及NTG
必須針對 aortic valve, annulus, sinus 及 access artery 評估
因為要評估 aortic valve 所以要有一組 cardiac motion free 的影像最好 用 ECG gating
因為 systolic phase aortic valve 最大, 所以測量 valve 以 systolic phase 為 主

questions.reference: European Radiology https://doi.org/10.1007/s00330-019-06357-8 /Published online: 5 September 2019 y (2020) 30:2627–2650；10.1007/s00330-019-06357-8；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p115
questions.explanation: 答案 A。與冠狀動脈 CTA 常規使用 beta-blocker 降心率、NTG 擴張血管不同，這兩種藥物在嚴重主動脈瓣狹窄病人屬「禁忌」，掃描前不應給予，因此 A 為錯誤敘述，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(B) TAVI 術前 CT 須評估主動脈瓣、瓣環（annulus）、竇部（sinus）與入路動脈；(C) 為取得無心臟運動偽影的影像，需採 ECG gating；(D) 主動脈瓣環在收縮期最大，故瓣環量測以收縮期為主，以免選到過小的人工瓣。→ [[aortic-stenosis]]
questions.author: 吳美翰

questions.questionText: The most frequent origin of right gastric artery is

options.text: Common hepatic artery
Proper hepatic artery
Left hepatic artery
Gastroduodenal artery

questions.reference: J Vasc Interv Radiol 2001; 12:957-963；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p116
questions.explanation: 答案 B。胃右動脈（RGA）最常源自 proper hepatic artery（固有肝動脈，約 43–53%），為肝動脈幹或其遠端分支最常見之非肝分支，故選 B。A common hepatic artery（約 9–20%）、D gastroduodenal artery（約 3–26%）、C left hepatic artery 皆為較少見之起源。→ [[right-gastric-artery-origin]]
questions.author: 曾修山

questions.questionText: 關於hepatic adenoma下列何者為非?

options.text: could occur in young women with contraceptive use
may hemorrhage
may malignant transformation
as a benign lesion, only observation is needed

questions.reference: https://radiologyassistant.nl/abdomen/liver/common-liver-tumors；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p117
questions.explanation: 答案 D。肝細胞腺瘤（HCA）具自發出血／破裂與惡性轉化風險（>5 cm、男性、β-catenin exon 3 型尤甚），一般建議切除並停用口服避孕藥、以影像追蹤，並非「僅需觀察」，故 D 為非。A（好發於服用避孕藥之年輕女性）正確；B（可自發出血）正確；C（可惡性轉化為 HCC，尤男性）正確。→ [[hepatocellular-adenoma]]
questions.author: 曾修山

questions.questionText: 有關Meckel's diverticulum 下列何者為非?

options.text: The most common congenital anomaly of the gastrointestinal tract
It resulted from improper absorption of allantois
Symptomatic Meckel's diverticulum is more common in men than women
Hemorrhage is the most common complication

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2004; 24: 565-587；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p118
questions.explanation: 答案 B。Meckel 憩室源自卵黃管（omphalomesenteric／vitelline duct）近端未退化之殘留，與 allantois（尿囊，退化為 urachus 臍尿管）無關，故「源自 allantois 吸收不良」為非。A（為腸胃道最常見的結構性先天異常）正確；C（症狀性者男性多於女性，約 2:1）正確；D（消化道出血為最常見併發症）正確。→ [[meckel-diverticulum]]
questions.author: 曾修山

questions.questionText: Which is wrong about the“large vestibular aqueduct syndrome”?

options.text: the diameter of vestibular aqueduct > 1.5mm
associated with congenital sensorineural hearing loss
due to enlargement of the endolymphatic duct
usually associated with inner ear anomaly
All of above are right

questions.reference: Enlarged Vestibular Aqueduct and Sensorineural Hearing Loss in Childhood. Arch Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg. 1995;121(1):23-28.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p119
questions.explanation: 答案 E。依本題設定，A–D 皆為正確敘述，故選「全部正確」。(A) 前庭導水管管徑 > 1.5 mm 判為擴大；(B) 與先天性感音性聽力損失相關；(C) 源於內淋巴管（endolymphatic duct）擴大；(D) 常合併其他內耳異常（約 85%，如 Mondini 畸形、耳蝸發育不全）。⚠️ 存疑：選項 A 的 1.5 mm 其實是舊 Valvassori 標準的「midpoint（中段）」正常上限，並非 operculum（外開口）；現行 Cincinnati 標準為 midpoint ≥ 1.0 mm 或 operculum ≥ 2.0 mm。題目將 1.5 mm 籠統標為「vestibular aqueduct 直徑」而未指明測量位置，嚴格而言不夠精確，故「全部正確（E）」有瑕疵之虞，臨床測量請以 Cincinnati 標準為準。→ [[large-vestibular-aqueduct]]
questions.author: 吳德昌

questions.questionText: About X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy, which one is “Wrong” ？

options.text: a peroxisomal disorder due to deficiency of acyl Co-A synthetase
Childhood type ususally starts between 6 and 9 years of age, with behavioral, auditory, visual, and gait abnormalities
typically involving occipital lobes and callosal splenium in bilaterally symmetrical pattern with zonal presentation
Treatment choices include bone marrow transplantation and restriction of long-chain fatty acids (LCFA)

questions.reference: Leukodystrophy in Children: A Pictorial Review of MR Imaging Features. RadioGraphics 2002; 22:461–476；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p120
questions.explanation: 答案 D。X 性聯腎上腺腦白質失養症的飲食治療是限制「極長鏈脂肪酸（VLCFA，如 Lorenzo's oil）」，並可施行骨髓／造血幹細胞移植；選項 D 寫成限制「long-chain fatty acids（LCFA）」不精確，故為錯誤敘述。(A) 正確：屬過氧化體病，源於 acyl-CoA synthetase（VLCFA-CoA synthetase）缺陷。(B) 正確：兒童型多在 6–9 歲起病，出現行為、聽力、視力與步態異常。(C) 正確：典型雙側對稱侵犯枕葉與胼胝體壓部、呈由後向前的區帶進展。→ [[adrenoleukodystrophy]]
questions.author: 吳德昌

questions.questionText: What is the most commonly observed brain MR abnormality pattern (excluding ischemic infarct) in patients with severe coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)?

options.text: non-confluent multifocal white matter hyperintense lesions on FLAIR/diffusion, with variable enhancement, associated with hemorrhagic lesions
extensive and isolated white matter microhemorrhages
extensive and confluent supratentorial white matter FLAIR hyperintensities
unilateral FLAIR and/or diffusion hyperintensities located in mesial temporal lobe

questions.reference: Stephane Kremer et al. Brain MRI Findings in Severe COVID-19: A Retrospective Observational Study. Radiology 2020; 297:E242–E251；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p121
questions.explanation: 答案 D。依 Kremer 等（Radiology 2020）37 例重症 COVID-19 系列，扣除缺血性梗塞後，最常見的實質異常是內側（mesial）顳葉 FLAIR 和／或 擴散高訊號（約 43%），故選 D。(A) 非融合性多灶白質 FLAIR/DWI 病灶、可變強化併出血約 30%，居次；(B) 廣泛而孤立的白質微出血約 24%，再次之；(C) 廣泛融合性幕上白質 FLAIR 高訊號並非該研究描述的主要型態。→ [[covid-19-brain-mri]]
questions.author: 石運儒

questions.questionText: Which one is not the branch of inferolateral trunk ?

options.text: Anastomosis to ophthalmic artery
Artery of the foramen lacerum
Basal tentorial artery
Anastomosis to accessory meningeal artery

questions.reference: Practiacal Neuroangiography 2nd Edition P158；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p122
questions.explanation: 答案 C。下外側幹（inferolateral trunk，ILT，即供應下海綿竇之動脈）自海綿竇段（C4）內頸動脈外下發出，其分支與吻合包括：經上眶裂與眼動脈 recurrent meningeal 支吻合（A 對）、經 foramen rotundum 供 CN V2、經 foramen ovale 與 accessory meningeal artery 吻合（D 對），以及可有 recurrent artery of foramen lacerum 與升咽動脈 carotid branch 吻合（B 對）；而 basal／marginal tentorial artery（Bernasconi–Cassinari）一般源自 meningohypophyseal trunk（MHT），並非 ILT 分支，故 C（basal tentorial artery）為「不是」ILT 分支者。→ [[inferolateral-trunk-branches]]
questions.author: 崔祐堃

questions.questionText: 急性缺血中風病人若符合以下條件，應積極評估EVT治療的可能性(Class I ，Level of Evidence

options.text: ，何者除外? (A)年齡≥ 18歲。
中風前的mRS ≤ 1。
開始進行介入性治療時間離中風症狀發生時間在6小時以內。
和病人中風症狀相符的ICA或MCA M1阻塞，以及腦部斷層影像ASPECTS (Alberta Stroke Program Early CT Score)分數≥ 4。

questions.reference: 台灣腦中風學會急性缺血中風動脈內血栓移除治療指引2019；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p123
questions.explanation: 答案 D。2015 AHA/ASA 積極評估 EVT 的 Class I 準則要求腦部 CT 的 ASPECTS「≥ 6」，選項 D 寫成「≥ 4」故為錯誤（即題目要找的「除外」項）。其餘皆為正確準則：(A) 年齡 ≥ 18 歲；(B) 中風前 mRS ≤ 1；(C) 介入治療（groin puncture）於中風症狀發生 6 小時內開始；且須為與症狀相符的 ICA 或 MCA M1 阻塞。→ [[acute-stroke-management]]
questions.author: 崔祐堃

questions.questionText: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Loss of the normal swallow tail appearance of susceptibility signal pattern in the substantia nigra on axial imaging is perhaps the most promising diagnostic sign for Parkinson disease
Mesial temporal lobe and hippocampi remain relatively normal in size, helping to distinguish Lewy body disease from Alzheimer disease

On T1-weighted images in patients of Wilson disease presenting with neurologic manifestations, these areas show hypointensity. In contrast, patients with severe hepatic dysfunction show areas of T1 hyperintensity, especially in the globus pallidus, similar to that seen in acquired (non-Wilsonian) hepatocerebral degeneration attributed to manganese deposition
All of above

questions.reference: UpToDate；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p124
questions.explanation: 答案 D。A：帕金森氏症於軸位 SWI／T2* 見黑質正常「燕尾（swallow tail）」高訊號消失，是極具前景的診斷徵象（對 PD／路易體失智之診斷準確度可達九成以上），敘述正確；B：路易體失智（DLB）之內側顳葉與海馬相對保留、體積正常，可藉此與典型內側顳葉萎縮的阿茲海默症區分，敘述正確；C：威爾森氏症神經型於 T1WI 多呈低訊號，而嚴重肝功能不良者反於 T1WI（尤以蒼白球）呈高訊號，與後天性（非威爾森型）肝腦退化之錳（manganese）沉積表現相似，敘述正確；三段敘述皆正確，故選 D（All of above）。→ [[hepatic-encephalopathy-manganese-deposition]]
questions.author: 陳泰源

questions.questionText: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Hypertrophic olivary degeneration (HOD) is a unique form of transneuronal degeneration caused by a disruption of the dentato-rubro-olivary pathway, also known as the triangle of Guillain-Mollaret
The triangle of Guillain-Mollaret is involved in fine voluntary motor control and consists of both the inferior olivary nucleus and the red nucleus on one side and the contralateral dentate nucleus
Typical magnetic resonance imaging findings include T2-hyperintensity and enlargement of the inferior olivary nucleus evolving over time to atrophy with residual T2-hyperintensity
Clinically, patients classically present with symptomatic palatal myoclonus
All of above

questions.reference: Imaging Features of Hypertrophic Olivary Degeneration. Journal of the Belgian Society of Radiology. 2016;100(1):71.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p125
questions.explanation: 答案 E。A：肥大性橄欖核退化（HOD）為齒狀核–紅核–橄欖核路徑（即 Guillain–Mollaret 三角）受損後之跨神經元退化，敘述正確；B：此三角由一側之下橄欖核與紅核，加上對側齒狀核組成，與細部隨意動作控制相關，敘述正確；C：典型 MRI 為下橄欖核 T2 高訊號並肥大，隨時間演變為萎縮但殘留 T2 高訊號，敘述正確；D：臨床典型表現為顎肌陣攣（palatal myoclonus），敘述正確；四者皆正確，故選 E（All of above）。→ [[guillain-mollaret-triangle]]
questions.author: 陳泰源

questions.questionText: Which is not significantly associated with good clinical outcomes in endovascular thrombectomy for acute ischemic stroke?

options.text: Using of IV-tPA
Collateral status on CTA
mTICI grade
NIHSS at admission
General anesthesia

questions.reference: 1.Ching-Chung Ko, Hon-Man Liu, Tai-Yuan Chen, Te-Chang Wu, Li-Kai Tsai, Sung-Chun Tang, Yu-Kun Tsui, Jiann-Shing Jeng. Prediction of mTICI 3 recanalization and clinical outcomes in endovascular thrombectomy for acute ischemic stroke: a retrospective study in the Taiwan registry. Neurol Sci. 2021 Jun;42(6):2325-2335.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p126
questions.explanation: 答案 E。取栓後良好臨床預後之顯著相關因子包括 A（橋接靜脈溶栓 IV-tPA 使用）、B（CTA 上的側支循環狀態，為缺血核心進展速率的重要決定因子）、C（mTICI 再灌流分級，達 2b–3 之成功再灌流為最關鍵的程序性預後因子）與 D（入院 NIHSS 之基準中風嚴重度）；至於 E 全身麻醉相較清醒鎮靜對功能預後孰優尚無定論（SIESTA、AnStroke、GOLIATH 等隨機試驗多為中性／非劣），並非良好預後之顯著正向預測因子，題目問「不顯著相關」者，故選 E。→ [[intra-arterial-thrombectomy]]
questions.author: 柯景中

questions.questionText: Which is not associated with recurrence in meningiomas ?

options.text: Falx location
Preoperative tumor volume
African American
Tentorial location
Age

questions.reference: 1. Joshua Materi, David Mampre, Jeff Ehresman, Jordina Rincon-Torroella, Kaisorn L Chaichana. Predictors of recurrence and high growth rate of residual meningiomas after subtotal resection. J Neurosurg. 2020 Jan 3;1-7. doi: 10.3171/2019.10.JNS192466. Online ahead of print.；10.3171/2019.10.JNS192466.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p127
questions.explanation: 答案 E。文獻中與腦膜瘤次全切除後復發及生長速率相關之預測因子包括 A（大腦鐮／falx 位置）、B（術前腫瘤體積大）、C（非裔美國人族群）與 D（天幕／tentorial 位置），這些均與較高復發風險相關；而年齡（E, Age）本身並非獨立的復發風險因子，故為「不相關」者，選 E。→ [[meningioma-recurrence]]
questions.author: 柯景中

questions.questionText: Which statement is “WRONG” about dural AVF (arteriovenous fistula)?

options.text: Most common site: cavernous sinus
Symptoms vary with site, type of shunt
Enlarged cortical draining veins presuming aggressive DAVF
Cognard classification correlates venous drainage patterns with increasingly aggressive neurological clinical course and stratifies the risk of intracerebral hemorrhage

questions.reference: STATdx, Head and Neck, Dural Arteriovenous fistula；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p128
questions.explanation: 答案 A。硬腦膜動靜脈瘻管（DAVF）最常見部位為橫竇–乙狀竇（transverse／sigmoid sinus）而非海綿竇，故 A（most common site: cavernous sinus）敘述錯誤（此為常見誤植陷阱）；B：症狀確實隨瘻管部位與分流型態而異，正確；C：皮質引流靜脈擴大代表血流逆流入皮質靜脈系統，屬侵犯性（aggressive）DAVF 之影像標記，正確；D：Cognard 分級依靜脈引流型態分層，與臨床病程侵犯性及顱內出血風險相關，正確；題目問「錯誤」者，故選 A。→ [[dural-avf]]
questions.author: 林建人

questions.questionText: About the femoral artery pseudoaneurysm (Iatrogenic pseudoaneurysm) (IPA) following percutaneous intervention, the following state was wrong ?

options.text: Incidence <1 % of all interventional procedures
Risk factors including obesity, large sheath size (>6 Fr)
For uncompicated IPA <3cm, obseveration with serial ultrasound every 2 weeks for up to 6 week was the best way
For uncompicated IPA >3cm, open surgical repair was better than ultrasound-guided thrombin injection

questions.reference: UpToDate : Femoral artery pseudoaneurysm following  percutaneous intervention；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p129
questions.explanation: 答案 D。無併發症且較大（>3cm）之醫源性股動脈假性動脈瘤，首選為超音波導引經皮 thrombin 注射（成功率 >90%），開放手術主要保留給有併發症（血流動力不穩、神經／脈搏缺損、擴大血腫、廣泛皮膚軟組織受損、疑感染）或微創失敗者，故 D「>3cm 者開刀優於 thrombin 注射」之敘述錯誤；A（發生率於介入術大致偏低，診斷性介入約 <1%）大致正確、B（風險因子含肥胖與大口徑鞘 >6 Fr）正確、C（無併發症之小假性動脈瘤可序列超音波觀察）為可接受之保守處置，皆非最錯者；題目問「錯誤」者，故選 D。→ [[iatrogenic-femoral-pseudoaneurysm]]
questions.author: 林建人

questions.questionText: 關於pulmonary sequestration何者錯誤

options.text: pulmonary sequestration is a nonfunctioning mass of lung tissue that lacks normal communication with the tracheobronchial tree and that receives its arterial blood supply from the systemic circulation
Feeding vessels include branches from the thoracic aorta (75%), abdominal aorta, intercostal artery or multiple arteries
Intralobular sequestration is located within a normal lobe and lacks its own visceral pleura
Extralobular sequestration is the commoner type of pulmonary sequestration
