questions.questionText: 下列何者不是COVID-19的 CT 典型表現?

options.text: Ground-glass opacities
Vascular enlargement
Unilateral abnormalities and upper lobe involvement
Posterior predilection

questions.reference: Chest CT in COVID-19: What the Radiologist Needs to Know RadioGraphics Volume 40, Issue 7Oct 23 2020 37:777–794；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p131
questions.explanation:
答案 C。此題問何者「不是」COVID-19 的 CT 典型表現。COVID-19 典型 CT 為「雙側」分布、以下葉與後側（posterior／subpleural）為優勢；C 描述的「單側異常且上葉侵犯」與此指紋相反，故非典型。A（磨玻璃影 GGO）為最核心的典型表現；B（血管擴張 vascular enlargement）是常見伴隨徵象；D（後側優勢 posterior predilection）符合典型分布。故非典型者為 C。附註：單側、上葉為主、縱膈淋巴結腫大、肋膜積液、空洞等徵象出現時，反而應提高對其他病因的警覺。
→ [[covid19-chest-ct]]
questions.author: 簡巧弦

questions.questionText: Which of the statement is false?

options.text: In children younger than 5 years, thymus typically appears quadrilateral with convex borders
When the body is exposed to stress, the thymus may grow, a phenomenon known as thymic rebound hyperplasia
Cystic changes can be seen in a variety of thymus tumors
In adults, thymoma is the most frequent primary tumor of the thymus; whereas, in children, lymphoma is the most common primary tumor of the thymus

questions.reference: RadioGraphics Vol. 30, No. 2 Clinical and Radiologic Review of the Normal and Abnormal Thymus: Pearls and Pitfalls；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p132
questions.explanation:
答案 B。此題問何者為「錯誤」敘述。B 稱身體受壓力時胸腺「會長大」，方向錯誤：面對壓力（化療、放療、感染、燒傷、類固醇、手術）時胸腺會「先縮小」，可小至原體積約 40%；待恢復期才反彈長大（rebound hyperplasia），通常 9 個月內回到原大小，甚至可再大達 50%。故 B 敘述錯誤。A 正確：未滿 5 歲幼兒胸腺典型呈四邊形（quadrilateral）且邊緣外凸。C 正確：囊性變化可見於多種胸腺腫瘤（胸腺上皮腫瘤、淋巴瘤、生殖細胞瘤、胸腺癌）。D 正確：成人原發胸腺腫瘤以 thymoma 最常見，孩童則以 lymphoma 最常見。附註：反彈增生呈瀰漫對稱、輪廓平滑、脂肪與淋巴組織細緻混合、血管正常，可與結節狀、含壞死或鈣化的腫瘤鑑別。
→ [[thymic-hyperplasia]]
questions.author: 陳貞慧

questions.questionText: Which specific CT sign is more common in UIP associated with CTD-ILD than in UIP associated with IPF？UIP: usual interstitial pneumoniaCTD-ILD: connective tissue disease- associated interstitial lung diseaseIPF: idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis

options.text: Anterior upper lobe sign
Exuberant honeycombing sign
Straight-edge sign
All of the above

questions.reference: 2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p133
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題問哪個 CT 徵象在 CTD-ILD 相關的 UIP 中比 IPF 相關的 UIP 更常見。anterior upper lobe sign（纖維化集中上葉前段並合併下肺侵犯）、exuberant honeycombing sign（蜂窩化占纖維化區 >70%）、straight-edge sign（纖維化侷限肺基底、冠狀面上下界銳利、不沿肺外側緣上延）三者在 CTD-ILD 都比 IPF 更常出現，屬高特異度但中等敏感度的「反常」徵象（陰性不能排除 CTD），故三者皆對，答案為 D（All of the above）。臨床意義：年輕或女性出現 UIP 樣纖維化並帶這些徵象時，應優先懷疑 CTD 而非 IPF。
→ [[ctd-ild]]
questions.author: 陳貞慧

questions.questionText: Concerning COVID-19 Imaging, which one of the following is not correct?

options.text: Cardiovascular complications such as thromboembolism and myocarditis have been ascribed to COVID-19, sometimes contributing to neurologic and abdominal manifestations
Imaging findings of COVID-19 may overlap/mimic SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, influenza A, or H1N1, drug reactions and connective tissue diseases
The typical appearance of COVID-19 pneumonia on CT is bilateral peripheral GGOs with a lower lung distribution. Sometimes resembling an organizing pneumonia pattern
Indication for routine imaging as a screening test for COVID-19 in asymptomatic individuals. Indication for daily chest radiography in stable intubated patients with COVID-19

questions.reference: Kanne JP, Bai H, Bernheim A et-al. COVID-19 imaging: What we know now and what remains unknown Radiology 2021; 299:E262–E279；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p134
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題問關於 COVID-19 影像何者「不正確」。D 稱「建議對無症狀者常規影像篩檢，並對穩定插管病人每日照胸部 X 光」——這與專家共識相反：共識明確「不」建議以影像作為無症狀者的篩檢工具，也「不」建議對病況穩定的插管病人每日照 CXR；CT 應保留用於功能受損、低血氧或康復後的評估。故 D 不正確。A 正確：COVID-19 可併發血栓栓塞、心肌炎等心血管併發症，甚至牽連神經與腹部表現。B 正確：其影像可與 SARS-CoV、MERS-CoV、流感、H1N1、藥物反應、結締組織病重疊或相似。C 正確：典型 CT 為雙側周邊 GGO、以下肺為主，有時呈機化性肺炎（OP）型態。
→ [[covid19-chest-ct]]
questions.author: 陳佳慧

questions.questionText: Which one is “Wrong” about chest CT in COVID-19?

options.text: Chest CT Abnormalities with High Incidence (>70%), including ground-glass opacities, vascular enlargement, bilateral, lower lobe involvement, and posterior predilection
Chest imaging is indicated as a screening test for COVID-19 in asymptomatic patients or in patients with mild respiratory symptoms of COVID-19
A negative chest CT examination result certainly does not exclude COVID-19

In cases of clinical worsening, chest imaging is advised to assess for COVID-19 progression or secondary cardiopulmonary complications such as ARDS, pulmonary embolism, superimposed pneumonia, or heart failure that can potentially be secondary to COVID-19–induced cardiac injury

questions.reference: Thomas C. Kwee, and Robert M. Kwee,: Chest CT in COVID-19: What the Radiologist Needs to Know. RadioGraphics 2020; 40:1848–1865；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p135
questions.explanation:
答案 B。此題問關於 COVID-19 胸部 CT 何者「錯誤」。B 稱胸部影像「可」作為無症狀者或僅輕微呼吸道症狀者的 COVID-19 篩檢工具——這是錯的：影像「不」建議用於無症狀或輕症（無顯著肺功能異常或損傷）者的篩檢，診斷應靠 RT-PCR。故 B 為錯誤。A 正確：高發現率（>70%）徵象包含 GGO、血管擴張、雙側、下葉侵犯與後側優勢。C 正確：CT 陰性並不能排除 COVID-19。D 正確：病情惡化時可用影像評估病程進展或次發心肺併發症（ARDS、肺栓塞、續發肺炎、心衰竭等，後者可能續發於 COVID 引起的心臟損傷）。
→ [[covid19-chest-ct]]
questions.author: 奇美醫院陳佳慧

questions.questionText: 下列何種影像發現為 COVID-19 的胸部X光 characteristic finding?

options.text: Lobar consolidation
Pleural effusion
Bilateral consolidations in a peripheral and mid to lower lung zone distribution
Pneumothorax

questions.reference: Radiology: Cardiothoracic Imaging 2020; 2(5):e200280；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p136
questions.explanation:
答案 C。此題問何者為 COVID-19 胸部 X 光的 characteristic（特徵性）表現。COVID-19 影像遵循「雙側、周邊、中下肺帶」的分布指紋，故 C（雙側、周邊且中下肺帶分布之實變/毛玻璃）為特徵表現。A（lobar consolidation 大葉性實變）屬非特異（nonspecific）表現，非 COVID 特徵；B（肋膜積液）與 D（氣胸）皆非 COVID 典型或特徵徵象，出現時反而要想其他病因。故特徵表現為 C。判讀分類：符合上述雙側周邊中下肺帶者＝characteristic；其餘任何肺-胸膜異常（含大葉性實變）＝nonspecific；無可辨識異常＝negative。⚠️ 概念檔記載本題原卷答案欄疑為 A、與現值 C 有分歧，建議對照原卷確認題號答案標示。
→ [[covid19-chest-ct]]
questions.author: 郭禹廷

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 2: Chest Radiograph Characterization by Findings**

| Chest Radiograph Characterization | Chest Radiograph Findings |
| --- | --- |
| Characteristic | Bilateral patchy and/or confluent, bandlike ground-glass opacity or consolidation in a peripheral and mid to lower lung zone distribution |
| Nonspecific | Any pleuropulmonary abnormality other than the above |
| Negative | No perceived pleuropulmonary abnormality |

questions.questionText: 有關含碘對比劑的安全事項，下列敘述何者正確?

options.text: 有 hyperthyroidism 的病人若暴露於含碘對比劑，有引起thyrotoxicosis 的風險，corticosteroid premedication 可能有幫助
含碘對比劑的施打對接受 radioactive iodine therapy 或 radioactive iodine scan 的病人可能造成影響，應該建議有適當的 washout period
Intradermal skin testing 可正確預測發生 adverse reactions 所以對 minimize 不良反應是有幫助的
病人經 premedication 後就不可能有 contrast reaction 了

questions.reference: ACR contrast Manual 2020；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p137
questions.explanation:
答案 B。含碘對比劑會與甲狀腺攝碘互相競爭干擾，故對於接受放射碘治療或放射碘掃描的病人，施打含碘對比劑前後應安排適當的等待（washout）期，B 正確。
(A) 甲狀腺風暴/甲亢活動期的病人暴露於含碘對比劑可能加重甲狀腺毒症，原則是「避免使用」，且此情境下類固醇前置用藥幫助不大，故 A 錯。
(C) 皮內測試（intradermal skin testing）無法可靠預測對比劑不良反應，對減少反應並無助益、甚至可能增加風險，故 C 錯。
(D) 前置用藥並不能預防所有反應，用藥後仍可能出現「突破性反應（breakthrough reaction）」，故 D 錯。
→ [[contrast-adverse-reactions]]
questions.author: 郭禹廷

questions.questionText: Characteristics of Benign tumour of lube in X ray is

options.text: Size > 5cm in diameter
Cavitation
Peripheral location
Concentric dense calcification

questions.reference: Radiology multiple choice questions and answers https://engineeringinterviewquestions.com/radiology-objective-questions-and -answers/；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p138
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題問肺部良性腫瘤在 X 光上的特徵。D（concentric dense calcification，同心圓/層狀緻密鈣化）是良性鈣化型態（如肉芽腫），為良性特徵。A（>5 cm 大小）偏向惡性；B（cavitation 空洞化，尤其厚壁不規則者）偏惡性；C（peripheral location 周邊位置）鑑別良惡的效力薄弱，並非良性指標。故良性特徵為 D。附註：良性鈣化型態還包含中央、瀰漫、laminated、popcorn；病灶含脂肪則提示 hamartoma。
→ [[solitary-pulmonary-nodule]]
questions.author: 麥志輝

questions.questionText: 以下何者為是？

options.text: Vaccine-induced lymphadenopathy can present as a diagnostic dilemma for radiologists
Unilateral lymphadenopathy is rarely reported with vaccines as BCG, influenza, and HPV vaccines
Documentation of vaccination status can decrease unnecessary biopsy and alleviate patient anxiety
以上皆是

questions.reference: Radiology:Imaging Cancer https://doi.org/10.1148/rycan.2021210038；10.1148/rycan.2021210038；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p139
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問何者「為是」。（A）對：疫苗引起的淋巴結腫大對放射科醫師而言可能造成診斷上的兩難（易與乳癌腋下轉移混淆）。（B）對：在 COVID 疫苗之前，單側淋巴結腫大僅偶爾見於 BCG、流感、HPV 等疫苗的零星報告，並不常見。（C）對：記錄接種狀態（日期、部位/側別、疫苗別）可減少不必要的切片並緩解病人焦慮。（D）對：故以上皆是。處置上建議記錄接種資訊、依接種時序安排篩檢，並對近期同側接種後偶發的單側腋下淋巴結腫大採較保守的 BI-RADS 分級與追蹤。
questions.author: 黃品齊

questions.questionText: Which sign is specific for usual interstitial pneumonia due to connective tissue disease?

options.text: Straight-edege sign
anterior upper lobe sign
exuberant honey combing sign
All of the above

questions.reference: Straight-edege sign, anterior upper lobe sign, and exuberant honey combing sign are much more common in and highly specific for CTDUIP than IPF UIP. CT Features of the Usual Interstitial Pneumonia Pattern: Differentiating Connective Tissue Disease–Associated Interstitial Lung Disease From Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis American Journal of Roentgenology. 2018;210: 307-313. 10.2214/AJR.17.18384；10.2214/AJR.17.18384；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p140
questions.explanation:
答案 D。CTD 相關的 UIP（相對於 IPF）常帶有幾個反常徵象：straight-edge sign（纖維化侷限肺基底、冠狀面上下界銳利而不沿外側緣往上延伸）、anterior upper lobe sign（纖維化集中上葉前段並合併下肺侵犯）、exuberant honeycombing（蜂窩化佔纖維化區 >70%）。這三個徵象在 CTD-ILD 出現的比例（約 22–25%）明顯高於 IPF（約 6–13%），特異度高但敏感度僅中等，因此三者對「CTD 造成的 UIP」皆具鑑別意義。(A)、(B)、(C) 各自都是正確的特異徵象，故完整答案是「以上皆是」，正解為 (D)。
⚠️ 本題原含影像（官方詳解 PDF 第 140 頁）尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。
→ [[ctd-ild]]

questions.questionText: Which of the description about the graft liver vessels is wrong?

options.text: An elevated peak systolic velocity at hepatic artery anastomosis and tardus-pavus waveform at intra-hepatic artery suggesting hepatic artery stenosis
A focal color aliasing at anastomosis, with >3-fold increase in velocity compared to pre-stenotic segment suggesting portal vein stenosis
A biphasic or triphasic spetral Doppler pattern of hepatic veins suggesting patent venous outflow
A resistence index of less than 0.45 and monophasic pattern of hepatic vein indicative of hepatic vein stenosis

questions.reference: Postoperative Imaging in Liver Transplantation: What Radiologists Should Know1    RadioGraphics 2010; 30:339–351；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p141
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題要選「錯誤」敘述。
(D) 的概念方向雖對（肝靜脈呈 monophasic 且指數 <0.45 提示肝靜脈狹窄），但參數用錯了——正確應為「靜脈搏動指數（venous pulsatility index）<0.45」，而非題目所寫的「resistance index（RI）」；RI 用於評估動脈、不用於肝靜脈，故此敘述有誤。
其餘皆正確：(A) 吻合處收縮期峰值流速升高＋肝內動脈 tardus-parvus 波形提示肝動脈狹窄；(B) 吻合處局部 color aliasing＋流速較狹窄前段增加逾 3 倍提示門靜脈狹窄；(C) 肝靜脈維持 biphasic/triphasic 波形代表流出道通暢。
→ [[liver-transplant-doppler]]
questions.author: 蘇盈盈

questions.questionText: Which of the following descriptions about intra-abdominal solid organ is wrong?

options.text: In T2 weighted-images, normal liver parenchyma shows lower signal intensity than spleen parenchyma
In in-phase and out-of-phase images, normal liver shows similar signal intensity with spleen
In T1 weighted-images, normal pancreatic parenchyma shows hyperintensed signal
In in-phase and out-of-phase images, hepatic lipomatous angiomyolipoma shows no signal drop

questions.reference: 2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p142
questions.explanation: 答案 D。含脂肪的 hepatic angiomyolipoma（尤其 lipomatous 型）在同相／反相或脂肪抑制序列上必定會掉訊號——巨觀脂肪在脂肪抑制序列掉訊號，含脂較少（lipid-poor）者則於反相位（out-of-phase）掉訊號，脂肪與非脂肪界面呈 India-ink artifact，故「lipomatous AML 在 IP/OP 無 signal drop」為錯誤敘述。A 正確：正常肝實質 T2 訊號低於脾（脾 T2 較長、較亮）。B 正確：正常肝與脾皆不含脂肪，同相／反相間訊號相近、彼此接近而無明顯掉訊號。C 正確：正常胰臟因腺泡富含水溶性蛋白，T1WI 呈相對高訊號（腹部實質器官中 T1 最亮）。→ [[microscopic-fat-tumors]]
questions.author: 蘇盈盈

questions.questionText: Regarding splenic hemangioma: Which one is not the common imaging features on MRI?

options.text: Hyperintense on T1-weighted images
Hyperintense on T2-weighted images
Can show nodular centripetal enhancement
Can show uniform enhancement at delayed imaging
Can show homogeneous enhancement

questions.reference: Abbott RM, Levy AD, Aguilera NS, Gorospe L, Thompson WM. From the archives of the AFIP: primary vascular neoplasms of the spleen: radiologic-pathologic correlation. Radiographics. 2004 Jul-Aug;24(4):1137-63. doi: 10.1148/rg.244045006. PMID: 15256634.；10.1148/rg.244045006.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p144
questions.explanation: 答案 A。脾臟血管瘤在 T1WI 多呈等訊號至低訊號（iso-to-hypointense to 脾實質），並非高訊號，故「T1 高訊號」不是其常見特徵、為本題正解。B 正確：T2WI 呈高訊號。C 正確：可呈結節狀向心性（centripetal）強化。D 正確：延遲期呈均勻強化。E 正確：較小的病灶可於即時對比後即呈均質強化並持續至延遲期。→ [[splenic-tumors]]
questions.author: 劉綺霞

questions.questionText: Before considering a patient as a potential liver living donor, which extensive study of the liver must be done?

options.text: Only 4 phase CT scan
Only MR study of liver parenchyma and biliary tree
Only US Doppler
Only laboratory testa
4 phase CT scan and MR study of liver parenchyma and biliary tree

questions.explanation: 答案 E。完整的活體捐肝者術前評估需同時回答肝實質、肝動脈、門靜脈與肝靜脈、膽道樹解剖，並計算移植物與殘肝體積；CT 與 MR 為互補模態——4-phase CT 憑高空間解析度擅長動脈與體積評估，MR／MRCP 擅長肝實質（脂肪定量）與膽道樹，故需 4-phase CT 加上肝實質與膽道的 MR 研究兩者併用。A 只做 4-phase CT、B 只做 MR、C 只做 US Doppler、D 只做抽血，皆無法涵蓋全部項目，不足以完成「extensive study」。註：受贈者術前放射評估則單一模態通常已足夠。→ [[liver-living-donor-imaging]]
questions.author: 劉綺霞

questions.questionText: 下列何者不屬於 Hemoptysis 之 CT findings?

options.text: Ground-glass opacity
Bronchial artery hypertrophy
Filling defects in in bronchial tree
Atelectasis
以上皆可以是 hemoptysis 之 CT findings

questions.reference: Radiographics 2021;41:742-761；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p146
questions.explanation:
答案 E。咳血在 CT 上可從肺實質、氣道與血管三方面表現，題列選項全部都可能出現：(A) ground-glass opacity 反映肺泡內出血（也可呈實變）；(C) filling defects in bronchial tree 是氣道內血塊；(D) atelectasis 為較大氣道被血塊阻塞所致；(B) bronchial artery hypertrophy 則是咳血最常見的血管來源——肥大的支氣管動脈管壁薄而脆、承受體循環壓力，流量可由正常約 1% 增至最高約 30%，易破入氣道而出血。此外還可見亞急性出血的 septal lines、遠端氣道血塊造成的 centrilobular／tree-in-bud 結節。因此四者皆為咳血之 CT 表現，正解為「以上皆可以」(E)。
→ [[bronchial-artery-embolization-hemoptysis]]
questions.author: 吳仁宏

questions.questionText: 關於 Renal cell carcinoma 的 Thermal ablation 治療，下列何者敘述錯誤?

options.text: 術前放置 ureteral stent 可以減少術後 urine extravasation 與 urinoma 的 發生機會
與cryoablation 相比，RFA 比較需要重複消融，以達到腫瘤完全壞死。
就患者舒適度而言，Cryoablation 明顯優於 RFA
一般而言，thermal ablation不適合治療大於5公分的 centrally located RCC
Cryoablation 治療中所形成的冰球範圍等同於腫瘤壞死範圍。

questions.reference: Uptodate: Radiofrequency ablation and cryoablation for renal cell carcinoma. Apr 23, 2020. updated；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p147
questions.explanation: 答案 E。冷凍消融所形成的冰球範圍並不等同於腫瘤壞死範圍——冰球最外緣等溫線僅約 −0.5°C 並非致死溫度，完全細胞死亡約發生在冰球邊緣內側 3 mm 處，故須讓冰球外擴超出腫瘤邊緣至少 5 mm 以確保完整涵蓋，因此「冰球範圍等同壞死範圍」為錯誤敘述、為本題正解。A 正確：術前置放 ureteral stent 可降低近端輸尿管熱傷害導致的 urine extravasation 與 urinoma。B 正確：與 cryoablation 相比，RFA 局部腫瘤進展率較高、較常需重複消融以達完全壞死。C 正確：就患者舒適度而言 cryoablation 明顯優於 RFA。D 正確：大於 5 公分或位於腎門／中央型（近集尿系統）的 RCC 一般不適合熱消融。→ [[tumor-ablation]]
questions.author: 吳仁宏

questions.questionText: Which statement about differentiation of solid renal tumor with MR imaging is correct?

options.text: Clear cell renal cell carcinomas (RCC) typically showed high T2 signal intensity
Papillary RCCs usually demonstrate low T2 signal intensity
Chromophobe RCCs shared overlapping image features as oncocytomas
Classic angiomyolipoma showed India ink artifact on opposed-phase images because of macroscopic fat
All statements are correct

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2017;37:2026–2042；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p148
questions.explanation: 答案 E。四項敘述皆正確、故選以上皆是。A 正確：clear cell RCC 典型呈 T2 高訊號，且常含微觀脂肪而於反相位出現局部或瀰漫的非曲線狀訊號下降。B 正確：papillary RCC 乏血管、典型 T2 低訊號、強化較常見的 clear cell RCC 弱。C 正確：chromophobe RCC 與 oncocytoma 可源自共同前驅細胞，影像特徵重疊（中央疤痕／spoke-wheel 強化並非 oncocytoma 專屬）。D 正確：典型 angiomyolipoma 含巨觀脂肪，脂肪抑制後掉訊號，並於反相位在脂肪與非脂肪界面呈 India ink artifact。→ [[renal-cell-carcinoma]]
questions.author: 黃建銓

questions.questionText: Which statement about Cryoablation for renal tumor is correct?

options.text: “Rapid” cooling results in more “intracellular” ice crystal
“Slow” thawing results in microvascular occlusion and cell hypoxia
Critical temperature threshold for cell death is between −19.4°C and −40°C
An ice ball margin should be at least 5mm larger than the target tumor
All statements are correct

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2010;30:887–90；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p149
questions.explanation: 答案 E。冷凍消融的四項敘述皆正確、故選以上皆是。A 正確：快速冷卻會在細胞內形成較多冰晶，具直接細胞毒性。B 正確：緩慢解凍造成微血管阻塞與細胞缺氧，導致間接缺血傷害。C 正確：細胞死亡具時間與溫度依賴性，臨界致死溫度約介於 −19.4°C 至 −40°C。D 正確：冰球邊界應超出目標腫瘤至少 5 mm，以避免殘餘或未治療的腫瘤。→ [[tumor-ablation]]
questions.author: 黃建銓

questions.questionText: Which of the followings is NOT true while talking about mesenteric venous thrombosis (MVT)？

options.text: The characteristic finding for MVT is the presence of a filling defect within a mesenteric vein. Other nonspecific findings include bowel wall thickening, indistinct bowel margins, ascites, and a thickened mesentery
Recent investigations suggest that nonoperative management results in improved survival and fewer complications compared with surgical intervention
Systemic anticoagulation is the second-line treatment for MVT
Catheter-directed fibrinolysis is usually recommended only in patients with refractory symptoms despite anticoagulation but in whom surgical intervention is not necessary

questions.reference: Circulation. 2015;131:1599-160；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p150
questions.explanation: 答案 C。系統性抗凝（systemic anticoagulation）是腸繫膜靜脈栓塞（MVT）的主要、第一線治療，而非第二線，故 C 敘述錯誤、為本題正解。A 正確：MVT 特徵影像為腸繫膜靜脈內的充盈缺損，其他非特異表現包括腸壁增厚、腸緣模糊、腹水與腸繫膜增厚。B 正確：近期研究顯示非手術治療較手術介入有較佳存活率與較少併發症。D 正確：導管導向溶栓通常僅用於抗凝治療後症狀仍頑固、但尚不需手術介入的病人。→ [[acute-mesenteric-ischemia]]
questions.author: 鄭華銘

questions.questionText: 以下關於原發性高醛固酮症(primary aldosteronism)的診斷何者不正確?

options.text: 血清醛固酮濃度(plasma aldosterone concentration)與血清張力素活 性(plasma renin activity)之比值(ARR)(aldosterone to renin ratio)大於 30 ng/dl per ng/ml/hour
腎上腺靜脈取樣篩檢(adrenal vein sampling)可用於分辨兩種主要的 亞型(subtypes)：醛固酮分泌腺瘤(aldosterone-producing adenoma)(APA)及雙側腎上腺增生(bilateral adrenal hyperplasia)
腎上腺靜脈取樣篩檢適合用於病患已確診為原發性高醛固酮症且 欲接受開刀切除單側腎上腺以治療高血壓之病患
原發性高醛固酮症的典型症狀為: 小於20歲之年輕人高血壓、頑固 性高血壓、及高血壓合併高血鉀

questions.reference: Hypertension. 2014;63:151-160；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p151
questions.explanation: 答案 D。原發性高醛固酮症的典型表現為高血壓合併低血鉀（hypokalemia）——醛固酮促進鉀離子排出，低血鉀常是最早的線索，好發於年輕（<20 歲）高血壓、頑固性高血壓、及高血壓合併低血鉀者，故「高血壓合併高血鉀」為錯誤敘述、為本題正解。A 正確：血漿醛固酮濃度與血漿腎素活性之比值（ARR）大於 30 ng/dl per ng/ml/hr 可作為篩檢（原發者醛固酮升高、腎素低下故 ARR 升高）。B 正確：腎上腺靜脈取樣（AVS）為分型金標準，可分辨醛固酮分泌腺瘤（APA）與雙側腎上腺增生。C 正確：AVS 適用於已生化確診原發性高醛固酮症、且擬接受單側腎上腺切除以治療高血壓的病人，結果左右手術或內科處置。→ [[adrenal-adenoma]]
questions.author: 鄭華銘

questions.questionText: Ovarian torsion is a surgical emergency and challenging to make an accurate diagnosis, especially in pediatric population. Which of the followings is NOT correct?

options.text: Torsion of normal adnexa can occur and is more common in the pediatric population than in adults
The most commonly described finding of ovarian torsion is asymmetrical enlarged ovary
Peripherally located follicles are a specific sign of torsion in adolescents
Color Doppler US evaluation is reliable for confirming or excluding ovarian torsion
Fluid-debris level in the ovary is a specific sign of torsion in perinatal period

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2017; 37:1892-1908.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p152
questions.explanation: 答案 D。卵巢同時接受子宮動脈與卵巢動脈的雙重血流供應，扭轉早期常先影響靜脈與淋巴回流，動脈血流仍可保留；加上未扭轉的兒童卵巢本來就常測不到血流，故彩色都卜勒無論有無血流都無法確診或排除扭轉，D 稱其「可靠」因此為本題要選的「不正確」敘述。其餘為正確敘述：(A) 正常附件的扭轉在兒童比成人常見；(B) 最常見所見為不對稱腫大的卵巢，也是最敏感、最一致的徵象；(C) 水腫基質把濾泡推向周邊，周邊移位濾泡為青少年扭轉的特異表現；(E) 周產期扭轉可見卵巢內液-屑液平面為其特異徵。→ [[adnexal-torsion]]
questions.author: 劉俊彥

questions.questionText: At postpartum uterine imaging, it is challenging to differentiate dehiscence from normal appearance of uterine incision. Which of the followings is not CORRECT?

options.text: CT is better than pelvic MRI in imaging diagnosis
May have free fluid in peritoneal cavity
May have large bladder flap hematoma
May have pleural effusion
May show bowel distention

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2020; 40:2117-2141.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p154
questions.explanation: 答案 A。CT 對子宮切口 dehiscence 的敏感度差、影像徵象非特異；骨盆 MRI 因多切面與軟組織對比可顯示是否有完整漿膜層、進而區分 uterine rupture 與 dehiscence，其診斷率優於顯影 CT，故「CT 優於 pelvic MRI」與事實相反、為錯誤敘述、為本題正解。B、C、D、E 皆為可伴隨並支持 dehiscence 診斷的徵象：腹腔游離液、較大的 bladder flap hematoma（>5 cm 高度可疑）、肋膜積液（pleural effusion）與腸脹（bowel distention）。此鑑別的臨床意義在於 rupture 需手術修補、dehiscence 多可保守。→ [[postpartum-uterine-dehiscence-imaging]]
questions.author: 劉俊彥

questions.questionText: What is the recommended treatment for adult idiopathic scoliosis with a Cobb angle 25°?

options.text: leave alone
observation
bracing
surgery

questions.reference: Scoliosis Imaging: What Radiologists Should Know RadioGraphics 2010; 30:1823–1842；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p155
questions.explanation: 答案 B。成人（骨骼成熟）特發性側彎的觀察門檻放寬至 Cobb <30°，25° 落在此區間，故採規則影像追蹤觀察。C bracing 錯：支架僅用於青少年特發性側彎（20–45°），對成人特發性側彎無角色；D surgery 錯：手術門檻為 Cobb ≥45°；A leave alone 錯：側彎仍須定期影像監測是否惡化，並非置之不理，與「observation（定期追蹤）」語意不同。→ [[scoliosis-cobb-angle-management]]
questions.author: 陳坤煌

questions.questionText: Post-traumatic ulnar avulsion tear (foveal and/or styloid ﬁbers) of TFCC is classified as Palmer classiﬁcation

options.text: Type 1A
Type 1B
Type 1C
Type 1D

questions.reference: Imaging the Triangular Fibrocartilaginous Complex；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p156
questions.explanation: 答案 B。Palmer 分類的 Class 1 為創傷性損傷，其中 1B 即尺側撕脫（ulnar avulsion），涉及 foveal／styloid 附著、可合併或不合併尺骨莖突基部骨折，常伴 DRUJ 不穩，正符合題幹「尺側撕脫（foveal 和／或 styloid 纖維）」。A 1A 為關節盤本體中央穿孔；C 1C 為遠端撕脫（ulnolunate／ulnotriquetral 韌帶自 carpus 撕脫）；D 1D 為橈側撕脫（±sigmoid notch 骨折）。→ [[tfcc-palmer-classification]]
questions.author: 陳坤煌

questions.questionText: About giant cell tumor of tendon sheath, which one is WRONG?

options.text: These benign tumors of synovial origin typically occur in the digits over the dorsal aspect
These tumors arise from the tendon sheath, joint capsule, fascia, or ligaments
These tumors contain multinucleated giant cells and have intra- and extracellular hemosiderin deposition
The low signals on T1WI and T2WI are due to the paramagnetic effect of hemosiderin deposition

questions.reference: Plastic Surgery: Volume 6: Hand and Upper Extremity. 4th Edition © 2018, Elsevier Inc. p. 71-95；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p157
questions.explanation: 答案 A。本題問「何者錯誤」。A 稱 GCTTS 好發於手指背側（dorsal aspect），為錯：GCTTS 雖約 85% 發生於手指，但以掌側（volar／屈側）為主、鄰近遠端指間關節（DIP）與近端指骨，故「背側」描述不正確。B 源自腱鞘、關節囊、筋膜或韌帶，正確；C 含多核巨細胞及細胞內外含鐵血黃素沉積，正確；D 含鐵血黃素的順磁效應致 T1WI、T2WI 皆呈低訊號，正確。→ [[giant-cell-tumor-tendon-sheath]]
questions.author: 謝賜吉

questions.questionText: About temporomandibular joint (TMJ), which one is “WRONG”?

options.text: The normal TMJ disk has an asymmetric biconcave configuration and the anterior band of the disk is usually smaller than the posterior band
Internal derangements of the TMJ occur more often in young women
Anterior displacement of TMJ disc is diagnosed according to sagittal MR images with mouth opening
An erosion of the condyle may be the earliest osseous manifestation of degenerative changes of the TMJ

questions.reference: Musculoskeletal MRI. 3rd Edition. 2020 by Elsevier, Inc. Ch.9, P.186-190.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p158
questions.explanation: 答案 C。本題問「何者錯誤」。C 稱僅憑開口（mouth opening）矢狀 MR 即可診斷關節盤前移位，為錯：前移位須同時取閉口與開口兩種斜矢狀 MR 判定——閉口位判斷盤是否移位、開口位判斷是否回位並排除 stuck disc，單一位置不足以診斷。A 正常盤呈不對稱雙凹、前帶較後帶小（薄），正確；B 內部紊亂好發年輕女性，正確；D 髁突侵蝕可為 TMJ 退化性變化最早的骨性表現，正確。→ [[tmj-internal-derangement]]
questions.author: 謝賜吉

questions.questionText: Which of the following lesions dose not present matrix mineralization?

options.text: Clear cell chondrosarcoma
Giant cell tumor
Echondroma
Osteoid osteoma

questions.reference: Jaffe HL. Tumors and tumorous conditions of the bones and joints. Philadelphia: Lea & Febiger; 1958. pp. 117–141.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p159
questions.explanation: 答案 B。GCT 不產生礦化的腫瘤基質（無 matrix mineralization），此為其定義特徵之一，平片呈地圖狀溶骨、窄移行帶但無硬化緣。A clear cell chondrosarcoma 與 C enchondroma 屬軟骨源腫瘤，可見軟骨型基質鈣化（ring-and-arc／popcorn）；D osteoid osteoma 屬骨母細胞源，可見骨樣基質礦化，三者皆有基質礦化。→ [[giant-cell-tumor]]
questions.author: 林建宏

questions.questionText: Which one of the following tumors does not have matrix mineralization?

options.text: Chondroblastoma
Enchondroma
Clear cell chondrosarcoma
Giant cell tumor

questions.reference: Meyers SP. MRI of bone and soft tissue tumors and tumorlike lesions, differential diagnosis and atlas. Thieme Publishing Group. (2008)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p160
questions.explanation: 答案 D。GCT 無基質礦化、不產生礦化的腫瘤基質。A chondroblastoma、B enchondroma、C clear cell chondrosarcoma 皆屬軟骨源腫瘤，可見軟骨基質鈣化（ring-and-arc／popcorn），故三者皆有基質礦化。→ [[giant-cell-tumor]]
questions.author: 林建宏

questions.questionText: Which one is correct about Three-Column Classification System for tibial plateau fractures?

options.text: Zero-column tibial plateau fractures are pure articular surface depression fractures with no associated cleavage-type fracture
One-column tibial plateau fractures involve only the medial, lateral, or posterior column, with a fracture line disrupting the cortical surface of the column wall
Two-column fractures involve two of the three columns and must have two discrete fracture fragments, each of which has a fracture line extending to the cortical surface of the involved column
Three-column fractures involve all three columns of the tibial plateau, with fracture lines in each column extending to the cortical surface of the respective column wall
All above are correct

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2021; 41:144–155；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p161
questions.explanation: 答案 E。三柱分型（Luo）依術前 CT 將脛骨平台分為內側、外側、後三柱。A 0 柱為純關節面壓陷、無皮質（柱壁）破裂、無劈裂型骨折線，正確；B 1 柱僅單一柱受累、骨折線破壞該柱皮質、以單一分離骨塊為診斷關鍵，正確；C 2 柱受累兩柱、須有兩塊各自延伸至皮質的分離骨塊（後外側骨塊常需後方 dorsal plating），正確；D 3 柱三柱皆受累、每柱骨折線皆達皮質且各有分離骨塊，正確。四項定義皆符合，故選 E。→ [[tibial-plateau-fracture-classification]]
questions.author: 周怡甄

questions.questionText: Which one is correct about avascular necrosis of talus?

options.text: Three extraosseous arterial contributors branch to supply the bone: the posterior tibial artery, the dorsalis pedis artery and the perforating peroneal artery
The Hawkins sign describes subchondral lucency of the talar dome seen in AP view
Talar AVN typically manifests as an increase in talar dome opacity (sclerosis), followed by deformity and, in severe cases, articular collapse and bone fragmentation
All above are correct

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2005; 25:399 – 410；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p163
questions.explanation: 答案 D。A 距骨由三條骨外動脈供血：posterior tibial artery、dorsalis pedis（anterior tibial）與 perforating peroneal artery，正確；B Hawkins sign 為距骨頂軟骨下透亮帶、於 AP／mortise view 可見，是傷後數週因血流灌注才出現的 disuse osteopenia，正確；C 距骨 AVN 典型影像序列為距骨頂 opacity 增加（硬化）→變形→嚴重時關節面塌陷與骨碎裂，正確。三者皆對，故選 D。→ [[talus-anatomy]]
questions.author: 周怡甄

questions.questionText: 關於心臟核磁共振造影(Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance，CMR)所使 用的顯影劑，下列何者錯誤？

options.text: 目前臨床上只有含釓顯影劑(gadolinium-based contrast agents) CMR 顯影所使用。
含釓顯影劑(gadolinium-based contrast agents)在臨床上的安全性很高 ，發生嚴重併發症腎因性全身纖維化(Nephrogenic systemic fibrosis， NSF)的機率約1％。
NSF是一種間質組織發炎反應，造成全身性影響，包括皮膚硬結、 四肢攣縮、多重器官纖維化，以致最終死亡。
發生NSF的風險因子包括腎絲球過濾率小於30毫升/分鐘、急性腎臟 衰竭，以及末期腎臟疾病需血液透析者
在目前尚未有腎絲球過濾率大於或等於30毫升/分鐘之慢性腎臟衰 竭患者發生過NSF的案例

questions.reference: Heart Disease_ Eugene Braunwald (2019年11版) Ch. 17, P302；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p166
questions.explanation: 答案 B。腎因性全身纖維化（NSF）的實際發生率遠低於 1%——在導入腎功能篩檢前（2003–2006 年）約每 10 萬次釓增強 MR 檢查 36.5 例，導入篩檢後（2007–2008 年）更降至約 4 例，換算不到萬分之四，因此把機率說成「約 1%」明顯高估，B 為錯誤敘述，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(A) 臨床 CMR 目前僅使用含釓對比劑；(C) NSF 為間質纖維化過程，可致皮膚硬結、四肢攣縮與多重器官纖維化，甚至死亡；(D) 主要風險因子為 eGFR <30、急性腎損傷及末期腎病透析者；(E) 目前尚無 eGFR ≥30 的慢性腎病人發生 NSF 的案例。→ [[nephrogenic-systemic-fibrosis]]
questions.author: 惲純和醫師

questions.questionText: 關於心臟核磁共振造影(Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance，CMR)的安 全性，下列何者錯誤？

options.text: 接受過機械瓣膜(mechanical valve)置換手術患者，可以安全接受核 磁共振造影檢查。
核磁共振造影對冠狀動脈金屬支架不會造成影響。
接受過關節置換手術的患者應避免核磁共振造影。
幽閉恐懼症(claustrophobic)患者接受核磁共振造影檢查時可考慮給 予口服鎮定劑。
植入式心律去顫器 (Implantable cardioverter-defibrillator)患者在特殊 影像設置條件下，仍可以安全進行核磁共振造影檢查

questions.reference: Heart Disease_ Eugene Braunwald (2019年11版) Ch17, P308；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p167
questions.explanation: 答案 C。關節置換等骨科植入物並非 MRI 禁忌，頂多產生局部金屬（磁化率）偽影，可安全接受掃描，因此「應避免核磁共振造影」是錯誤觀念，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(A) 絕大多數機械與生物人工瓣膜在 1.5T（多數亦含 3T）為 MR-safe/conditional；(B) 冠狀動脈金屬支架為非/弱鐵磁材質，不會因 MRI 移位或受損；(D) 幽閉恐懼病人可考慮給予口服鎮定劑協助完成檢查；(E) MR-conditional 的植入式心律去顫器在符合廠商設定與院內標準化流程下，於特定影像條件仍可安全掃描。→ [[cardiac-mri-safety]]
questions.author: 惲純和醫師

questions.questionText: 關於心肌灌注顯影(Myocardial Perfusion Imaging，MPI)之應用，心臟核 磁共振造影(Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance，CMR)與單光子電腦斷 層掃描(Single-photon Emission Tomography ，SPECT)之比較，何者為 誤？

options.text: 相較於SPECT，CMR MPI可以避免產生游離輻射(Ionizing Radiation) 。
SPECT 和CMR均可能造成衰減假影(Attenuation Artifact)。
CMR 可提供較SPECT高三到四倍的影像解析度。
針對偵測冠狀動脈疾病(Multivessel Coronary Artery Disease)的準確 度，CMR 較SPECT為高
SPECT和CMR皆可用以評估心肌存活性(Myocardial Viability)。

questions.reference: Heart Disease_ Eugene Braunwald (2019年11版) Ch 17, P311；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p168
questions.explanation: 答案 B。衰減假影（attenuation artifact）是核醫 SPECT 特有的問題——放射訊號穿越乳房、胸壁、橫膈下臟器等不同密度組織時強度衰減，產生偽性灌注缺損；CMR 灌注並不會產生這類衰減假影，因此「SPECT 和 CMR 均可能造成衰減假影」是錯誤敘述，為本題所選。其餘皆正確：(A) CMR 以釓劑動態灌注成像，無游離輻射；(C) CMR 空間解析度約為 SPECT 的三到四倍，利於偵測心內膜下缺血；(D) 對多血管冠心病的偵測準確度 CMR 高於 SPECT（CE-MARC 敏感度 86.5% vs 66.5%）；(E) SPECT（rest/redistribution 或搭配 FDG-PET）與 CMR（延遲對比強化 LGE）皆可評估心肌存活性。→ [[cmr-vs-spect-mpi]]
questions.author: 惲純和醫師

questions.questionText: Which of the following matches is INCORRECT about craniosynostosis?

options.text: Early fusion of sagittal suture - Scaphocephaly
Early fusion of metopic suture - Trigonocephaly
Early fusion of one coronal suture - Brachycephaly
Early fusion of one lambdoid suture - Plagiocephaly

questions.reference: Governale LS. Craniosynostosis. Pediatr Neurol. 2015;53(5):394-401. doi:10.1016/j.pediatrneurol.2015.07.006；10.1016/j.pediatrneurol.2015.07.006；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p169
questions.explanation: 答案 C。單側（one）冠狀縫早閉造成的是前部／額部斜頭（anterior／frontal plagiocephaly，伴同側 harlequin eye 徵象），而非短頭（brachycephaly）；brachycephaly 需雙側冠狀縫和／或雙側人字縫早閉才會形成，故 C 配對不正確。其餘配對正確：A 矢狀縫早閉→舟狀頭（scaphocephaly）；B 額縫早閉→三角頭（trigonocephaly）；D 單側人字縫早閉→後部斜頭（plagiocephaly）。題目問「不正確」者，故選 C。→ [[craniosynostosis-suture-fusion]]
questions.author: 黃俊肇

questions.questionText: Which of the following imaging appearance is NOT related to agenesis of corpus callosum?

options.text: Racing car sign
Moose head sign
Colpocephaly
Molar tooth sign

questions.reference: Cherian EV, Shenoy KV, Bukelo MJ, Thomas DA. Racing car brings tear drops in the moose. BMJ Case Rep. 2013;2013:bcr2012008165. Published 2013 Feb 21. doi:10.1136/bcr-2012-008165；10.1136/bcr-2012-008165；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p172
questions.explanation: 答案 D。臼齒徵象（molar tooth sign）為 Joubert 症候群及相關疾病之中腦徵象（上小腦腳拉長似臼齒），與胼胝體發育不全（ACC）無關；A 賽車徵象（racing car sign）、B 麋鹿頭徵象（moose head sign）與 C 枕角擴大（colpocephaly）皆源自 Probst bundles 造成側腦室平行外移／後角不成比例擴大，為 ACC 之典型影像表現。題目問「無關」者，故選 D。→ [[corpus-callosum-agenesis-signs]]
questions.author: 黃俊肇

questions.questionText: Which description about disease of neonatal chest is incorrect?

options.text: Infantile respiratory distress syndrome, previously known as hyaline membrane disease, usually occurs in premature infants
Cesarean section, prolonged labor and maternal aneshesis or diabetes are shown to be contributing factors of fetal lung fluid retention
Meconium aspiration syndrome is related to perinal stress and commonly ocurrs in pre-term infant
Pulmonary interstitial emphysema (PIE) and bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) are possible complications of ventilatory therapy for iinfantile respiratory distress syndrme

questions.reference: The requisites: Pediatric Radiology 3rd edition p.26~30；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p176
questions.explanation: 答案 C。胎便吸入症候群源於周產期窘迫／子宮內缺氧下吸入胎便，好發於足月或過期產兒，早產兒罕見，故 C 稱其「常發生於早產兒」為錯誤敘述。其餘正確：(A) 表面張力素缺乏病（即嬰兒呼吸窘迫症候群，舊稱透明膜病）因第二型肺泡細胞不成熟、surfactant 不足，好發早產兒；(B) 剖腹產、產程延長、母體麻醉或糖尿病會延遲胎兒肺液清除，是暫時性呼吸急促的促成因子；(D) 肺間質性肺氣腫（PIE）與支氣管肺發育不良（BPD）為表面張力素缺乏病接受呼吸器治療後的可能併發症。→ [[neonatal-chest-disease]]
questions.author: 馬偕醫院 放射線科 蔡佩珊

questions.questionText: Which description about child abuse is incorrect?

options.text: In children less than 2 years of age who are possible victims of abuse, a skeletal survey is mandatory. A “babygram” consisting of single or few images of the entire infant is unsatisfactory
Follow-up skeletal survey performed 2 weeks later is not necessary
Radiographic skeletal surveys should be performed in all cases of fatal suspected abuse and unexplained infant death, following the same protocol as used in living infants
Computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are used to evaluate suspected head trauma

questions.reference: Caffey's Pediatric Diagnostic Imaging 13ed Ch.143  p. 1454-1463；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p177
questions.explanation: 答案 B。約兩週後的追加骨骼調查是常規且必要的步驟，可顯現初查尚未成形的癒合中骨折與典型乾骺端損傷（CML）、提高敏感度與特異度，並協助推估受傷時間，故 B 稱「不必要」為錯誤敘述。其餘正確：(A) 2 歲以下疑似受虐兒須做完整分部位骨骼調查，單張全身合照（babygram）解析與擺位不足、不可取代；(C) 致命性疑似受虐與不明原因嬰兒死亡應依與存活嬰兒相同的協定進行骨骼調查；(D) CT 與 MRI 用於評估疑似頭部外傷。→ [[child-abuse-skeletal-survey]]
questions.author: 馬偕醫院 放射線科 蔡佩珊

questions.questionText: Which description about Biliary atresia is correct?

options.text: Biliary atresia is the most common cause of neonatal cholestasis and more common in Asian populations, in particular Chinese and Japanese infants

Biliary atresia usually presents in the first month of life with jaundice, light colored stools, and direct hyperbilirubinemia. 4 Untreated, it progresses to end-stage liver disease and death within the first 3 years of life
It is important to diagnose biliary atresia early because infants less than 2 months of age treated with the Kasai procedure tend to have a good long-term prognosis
All of above

questions.reference: Caffey's Pediatric Diagnostic Imaging 13ed Ch.87 p.810-815；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p178
questions.author: 馬偕醫院 放射線科 蔡佩珊

questions.questionText: 下列關於BI-RADS(The Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System)之相關敘述 ，何者為非?

options.text: BIRADS 0定義為negative (symmetrical and no masses, architectural distortion, or suspicious calcifications)
BIRADS 2定義為benign，0% probability of malignancy
BIRADS 3定義為probably benign，<2% probability of malignancy
BIRADS 5定義為highly suggestive of malignancy，>95% probability of malignancy and appropriate action should be taken

questions.reference: BIRADS (A)此定義應為BIRADS 1；BIRADS 0為incomplete study；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p182
questions.author: 陳若瑀醫師

questions.questionText: 以下關於breast hamartoma之相關敘述，何者為非?

options.text: Is also known as fibroadenolipoma
Are suspicious lesion, often requires further tissue proof for high probability of malignancy
“breast within breast appearance” are typical features
Lesions can be any size but are typically large at presentation

questions.reference: Radiopaedia (B) Breast hamartoma are benign breast lesion.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p183
questions.author: 陳若瑀醫師

questions.questionText: 根據低劑量胸部電腦斷層肺癌篩檢手冊醫療版的篩檢對象，下列描述何者 錯誤?

options.text: 具有肺癌家族史的民眾，建議接受低劑量電腦斷層作為肺癌篩檢。
年齡介於 50-80 歲，抽菸史超過 30 包年，目前仍在抽菸或戒菸時間尚 未超過 15 年的民眾，證據顯示可以接受低劑量電腦斷層以篩檢肺 癌。尤以 60-75 歲者，最具成本效應。
有肺病史、氡暴露及特定職業暴露(如石綿)的民眾，可以諮詢醫師考 慮進行肺癌篩檢。
非吸菸，也無上述風險因子的民眾，年齡大於30歲也可以進行低劑量 電腦斷層篩檢。

questions.reference: 低劑量胸部電腦斷層肺癌篩檢手冊醫療版；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p184
questions.explanation:
答案 D。低劑量 CT 肺癌篩檢以吸菸史為核心：主要對象為 50–80 歲、抽菸史超過 30 包年、目前仍吸菸或戒菸未滿 15 年者（其中 60–75 歲最具成本效益），(B) 正確。具肺癌家族史者亦建議接受篩檢，(A) 正確；有肺病史、氡暴露或石綿等特定職業暴露者可諮詢醫師考慮篩檢，(C) 正確。至於「非吸菸且無上述任何風險因子」的一般民眾，目前並無證據支持以年齡大於 30 歲作為篩檢門檻，(D) 的敘述與手冊不符，故為錯誤選項。
→ [[lung-cancer-screening-trials]]
questions.author: 柯維鈞

questions.questionText: 根據低劑量胸部電腦斷層肺癌篩檢手冊醫療版對於實心肺結節(Solid)的追 蹤與處置建議，下列描述何者錯誤?

options.text: 結節大小 ≤4 mm ：每年一次低劑量電腦斷層。
結節大小 4-6mm：6個月內安排低劑量電腦斷層。
結節大小 6-8mm：3個月內安排低劑量電腦斷層，若無變化則6個月內 安排低劑量電腦斷層，仍穩定則改一年。若於首次追蹤（三個月）有變化 則手術，於後續追蹤有變化則轉介給胸腔專科醫師進行評估。
結節大小 >8mm，若評估為高風險，則3個月內安排低劑量電腦斷層。

questions.reference: 低劑量胸部電腦斷層肺癌篩檢手冊醫療版；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p185
questions.explanation:
答案 D。台灣 LDCT 手冊對實心結節依大小分流追蹤：(A) ≤4 mm 每年一次 LDCT、(B) 4–6 mm 於 6 個月內 LDCT、(C) 6–8 mm 於 3 個月內 LDCT（穩定則延長為 6 個月、再穩定改一年；首次追蹤有變化即手術，後續有變化則轉介胸腔專科）皆正確。至於 >8 mm 的結節，手冊要求先安排 PET，再依風險分流：低風險才走「3 個月內 LDCT」路徑，高風險則直接安排開刀或切片。(D) 把「高風險」對應到「3 個月內 LDCT」屬於低風險的處置，方向錯置，故為錯誤選項。
→ [[lung-cancer-screening-trials]]
questions.author: 柯維鈞

questions.questionText: 下列何者「非」 lymphocytic interstitial pneumonitis 在電腦斷層掃描中較常 見的影像發現？

options.text: ground-glass changes
scattered thin-walled cysts
diffuse with upper lobe predominance
interstitial thickening along lymph channels
mediastinal lymphadenopathy

questions.reference: Johkoh T, Müller NL, Pickford HA et-al. Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia: thin-section CT findings in 22 patients. Radiology. 1999;212 (2): 567-72.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p186
questions.explanation:
答案 C。LIP 在 CT 上雖呈瀰漫分布，但以中下肺葉為主，並非上肺優勢，故 (C)「diffuse with upper lobe predominance」不符合其常見表現。(A) ground-glass changes、(B) scattered thin-walled cysts（薄壁囊腫多沿血管周圍分布、圓形邊界，是與肺淋巴瘤鑑別的重要線索）、(D) interstitial thickening along lymph channels（沿淋巴路徑的間隔與支氣管血管束增厚）、(E) mediastinal lymphadenopathy 皆為 LIP 常見的 CT 特徵，其中毛玻璃合併薄壁囊腫是招牌組合。故不符合者為 (C)。
→ [[lymphoid-interstitial-pneumonia]]
questions.author: 陳信銘

questions.questionText: 下列何者「不」符合對於 pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis 的描述？

options.text: Patients are most often non-smokers
It usually shows a progressive clinical course and ends in progressive massive fibrosis
It shows marked bilateral apical pleural thickening
Roughly half of cases occur as a sequela of lung transplantation or bone marrow transplantation
Patients have reduced lung function of a mixed (obstructive and restrictive) pattern

questions.reference: 1. von der Thüsen JH. Pleuroparenchymal Fibroelastosis: Its Pathological Characteristics. Curr Respir Med Rev. 2014;9 (4): 238-247. 2. Reddy TL, Tominaga M, Hansell DM et-al. Pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis: a spectrum of histopathological and imaging phenotypes. Eur. Respir. J. 2012;40 (2): 377-85.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p187
questions.explanation:
答案 B。PPFE 雖屬進行性、預後差的纖維化疾病，但其終點是慢性高碳酸血症呼吸衰竭，而非 progressive massive fibrosis（PMF）——PMF 是塵肺症／complicated pneumoconiosis 的融合纖維腫塊，與 PPFE 病理無關，故 (B) 的敘述錯誤。(A) 患者多為非吸菸者、(C) 以雙側肺尖胸膜及胸膜下實質明顯增厚為特徵、(D) 約半數為肺移植或骨髓移植後之續發表現、(E) 肺功能常呈混合（阻塞＋限制）型，皆符合 PPFE 的描述。
→ [[idiopathic-interstitial-pneumonia]]
questions.author: 陳信銘

questions.questionText: Screening low dose CT is appropriate for asymptomatic individuals at high risk for lung cancer. Which is not a risk factor for lung cancer listed by ACR–STR?

options.text: Emphysema and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
Interstitial lung disease, such as pulmonary fibrosis
Occupational and environmental exposures, such as asbestos, arsenic, beryllium, cadmium, chromium, coal
High levels of argon(氬) exposure

questions.reference: ACR–STR PRACTICE PARAMETER FOR THE PERFORMANCE AND REPORTING OF LUNG CANCER SCREENING THORACIC COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY (CT)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p188
questions.explanation:
答案 D。ACR–STR 所列的肺癌風險因子以吸菸史與年齡為主，額外包含 emphysema／COPD、間質性肺病（如肺纖維化）、職業與環境暴露（石綿、砷、鈹、鎘、鉻、煤等）、高濃度氡（radon）暴露、癌症史、肺癌家族史、大量二手菸與既往胸部放射治療。(A)、(B)、(C) 都在此清單內。(D) 所稱的「高濃度氬（argon）暴露」並非公認風險因子——正確者應為氡（radon，鈾衰變產生的惰性氣體，約佔肺癌 2–3% 並與吸菸協同）；氬與氡是不同氣體，故 (D) 為錯誤選項。
→ [[lung-cancer-screening-trials]]
questions.author: 黃昱森

questions.questionText: Volume CT lung-cancer screening of high-risk former and current smokers, with the introduction of growth-rate assessment as an imaging biomarker for indeterminate tests, resulted in low referral rates for additional assessments and substantially lower lung-cancer mortality. Which is the trial name?

options.text: JECS
NELSON
TALENT
NLST

questions.reference: N Engl J Med 2020; 382:503-513；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p189
questions.explanation:
答案 B。題幹描述的是以「volume CT＋結節生長速率（growth-rate／體積倍增時間）作為不確定結果之影像生物標記」，在高風險現行及曾吸菸者中達到低轉介率、且雙性別皆顯著降低肺癌死亡率——這正是荷蘭–比利時 NELSON 試驗的特徵，故正解為 (B)。(D) NLST 是美國試驗，採直徑判讀、為首個證實 LDCT 降低肺癌死亡率 20% 者，但並非以體積生長速率作為生物標記；(A) JECS、(C) TALENT 與此描述不符。
⚠️ 本題原含影像（官方詳解 PDF 第 189 頁）尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。
→ [[lung-cancer-screening-trials]]
questions.author: 黃昱森

questions.questionText: Currently, which is wrong about lung cancer screening?

options.text: Using low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) for lung cancer screening is recommended for heavy smokers in North America, Europe and some countries in Asia
Strategy to screen for lung cancer in the never-smoking population needs to be developed
Environmental risk factors, but not genetic factors are reported to play a role in lung cancer in the never-smoking population
The cost of LDCT screening and insurance coverage are important factors in lung cancer screening and mortality

questions.reference: Lung Cancer: Targets and Therapy 2019:10 107–124；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p190
questions.explanation:
答案 C。針對從不吸菸者的肺癌（LCINS），遺傳因子與環境因子同樣扮演重要角色，且其在遺傳與分子變化上與吸菸者的肺癌明顯不同（如 EGFR 突變、ALK 重排在非吸菸者及亞裔更常見）。(C) 稱「環境因子有影響、但基因因子不參與」與事實相反，故為錯誤選項。(A) LDCT 篩檢已用於北美、歐洲及部分亞洲的重度吸菸者、(B) 針對從不吸菸族群仍需另行發展篩檢策略、(D) LDCT 篩檢成本與保險給付會影響篩檢普及與死亡率，皆為正確敘述。
→ [[lung-cancer-screening-trials]]
questions.author: 黃昱森

questions.questionText: Screening low dose CT is appropriate for asymptomatic individuals at high risk for lung cancer. How much is the radiation dose of the technique should be set to yield a dose index volume (CTDIvol) for a standard-sized patient by ACR–STR?

options.text: 1 mGy or less
3 mGy or less
5 mGy or less
10 mGy or less

questions.reference: ACR–STR PRACTICE PARAMETER FOR THE PERFORMANCE AND REPORTING OF LUNG CANCER SCREENING THORACIC COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY (CT)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p191
questions.explanation:

questions.questionText: According the guidance of “Imaging Classification and CT features of COVID-19 Pneumonia” provided by the RSNA, which one is false?

options.text: Typical appearance : peripheral, bilateral, ground-grass opacities with/without consolidation or intralobular lines
Intermediate appearance: absence of typical features and the presence of isolated lobar or segmental consolidation without ground-grass opacities
Atypical appearance: absence of typical or indeterminate features and the presence of the discrete small nodules (centrilobular, “tree-in-bud” appearance) or lung cavitation
Negative for pneumonia: no CT features to suggest pneumonia

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2020; 40:1848-1865；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p192
questions.explanation:
答案 B。RSNA 將 COVID-19 肺炎的 CT 表現分為四類。(B) 把「孤立性大葉或節段性實變、且無毛玻璃影」歸為 Intermediate（不確定）是錯的——這種表現實際屬於 Atypical（非典型）；Indeterminate 應是缺乏典型徵象、呈多灶／瀰漫／肺門周圍或單側、且無特定分布（非圓形非周邊）的毛玻璃影。(A) Typical＝周邊、雙側毛玻璃影伴或不伴實變或小葉內線、(C) Atypical＝離散小結節（centrilobular、tree-in-bud）或肺空洞化、(D) Negative＝無肺炎徵象，皆正確，故錯誤者為 (B)。
⚠️ 本題原含影像（官方詳解 PDF 第 192 頁）尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 2: Imaging Classification and CT Features of COVID-19 Pneumonia**

| Imaging Classification | Rationale | CT Features |
|---|---|---|
| Typical appearance | Commonly reported imaging features of greater specificity for COVID-19 pneumonia | Peripheral, bilateral, ground-glass opacities with or without consolidation or visible intralobular lines ("crazy-paving" pattern); Multifocal ground-glass opacities of rounded morphology with or without consolidation or visible intralobular lines (crazy-paving pattern); Reverse halo sign or other findings of organizing pneumonia (seen later in the disease) |
| Indeterminate appearance | Nonspecific imaging features of COVID-19 pneumonia | Absence of typical features AND the presence of the following features: multifocal, diffuse, perihilar, or unilateral ground-glass opacity with or without consolidation lacking a specific distribution and that are nonrounded or nonperipheral; Few small ground-glass opacities, with a nonrounded and nonperipheral distribution |
| Atypical appearance | Uncommonly or not reported features of COVID-19 pneumonia | Absence of typical or indeterminate features AND the presence of the following features: isolated lobar or segmental consolidation without ground-glass opacities; discrete small nodules (centrilobular, "tree-in-bud" appearance); lung cavitation; smooth interlobular septal thickening with pleural effusion |
| Negative for pneumonia | No features of pneumonia | No CT features to suggest pneumonia. |

Source.—Adapted and reprinted under a CCBY 4.0 license from reference 51.

options.text: 此類疾病定義為在6到24個月內，病患的用力肺活量 (forced vital capacity，FVC) 下降超過 5% 或 10% 且合併臨床症狀之惡化」。
PF-ILD有很多原因，包含 idiopathic NSIP、connective tissue disease (CTD)-ILD、hypersensitivity pneumonitis (HP)等。
影像出現 honeycombing 的人存活表現都 顯著比無 honeycombing 者 差。

答案 A。AJCC／IASLC 第 8 版對半實性（part-solid）肺腺癌結節的 T 分期，臨床（影像）以「實質成分（solid component）」的最大徑決定，毛玻璃（GGO／lepidic）部分不計入；病理則以侵犯成分計算。本題 GGO 總徑雖達 25 mm，但實質成分僅 9 mm（≤10 mm），故為 cT1a。(B) T1b 對應實質成分 >10–20 mm、(C) T1c 對應 >20–30 mm、(D) T2 對應 >30 mm，皆與 9 mm 不符；若誤把整體 25 mm 當分期依據才會落到 T1b／T1c，這正是本題設下的陷阱。

questions.questionText: 下列關於UIP(usual interstitial pneumonia)的典型HRCT pattern之相關敘述， 何者為非?

options.text: Honeycombing+/- traction bronchiectasis
Reticular abnormalities
Subpleural with a basal predominance
Absence of features suggestive of an alternative diagnosis
Diffuse ground glass opacity

questions.reference: Diagnostic HRCT criteria for usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) pattern - ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT (2018)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p197
questions.explanation:
答案 E。UIP 型（IPF）的典型 HRCT 表現為以肺基底與胸膜下為主、分布呈時空異質，並以蜂窩狀變化（honeycombing，可伴牽引性支氣管擴張）與網狀影為核心，且缺乏指向其他診斷的特徵。(A) honeycombing±牽引性支氣管擴張、(B) 網狀影、(C) 胸膜下且基底為主的分布、(D) 無提示替代診斷的特徵，皆為 typical UIP 的組成。反之，(E) 瀰漫性毛玻璃並非 UIP 特徵——UIP 中 GGO 範圍應少於網狀影，若見廣泛毛玻璃反而要往 NSIP、過敏性肺炎等替代診斷想，故 (E) 為敘述錯誤者。
→ [[ipf]]

questions.questionText: 下列關於NSIP(Non-specific interstitial pneumonia)之相關敘述，何者為非?

options.text: Chest Xray在早期表現可能為正常。
成因多元，可為idiopathic，但在其他疾病如connective tissue disorders 、autoimmune disease、drug-induced lung disease、occupational exposure也可見到此表現。
常見表現包括ground glass opacity with immediate subpleural sparing。
Reticular opacities、traction bronchiectasis為fibrosis的表現，常見於UIP pattern，在NSIP中不會出現此表現。

questions.reference: Radiopaedia Mueller-Mang, C., Grosse, C., Schmid, K., Stiebellehner, L., & Bankier, A. A. (2007). What every radiologist should know about idiopathic interstitial pneumonias. Radiographics, 27(3), 595-615.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p198
questions.explanation:
答案 D。NSIP 的影像本質是相對均質、雙側下肺／胸膜下為主，且常見 subpleural sparing（緊貼胸膜的薄帶被豁免）。(A) 早期胸部 X 光可為正常、(B) 成因多元（可特發，亦可續發於結締組織病、自體免疫病、藥物、職業暴露）、(C) 常見毛玻璃合併 subpleural sparing，皆為正確描述。(D) 則錯誤：網狀影與牽引性支氣管擴張雖屬纖維化表現，但正是 fibrotic NSIP 的招牌特徵，NSIP 一樣會出現，並非「只見於 UIP、NSIP 不會有」。NSIP 與 UIP 的差別在於 honeycombing 少、對稱均質、可有 subpleural sparing，而非有無牽引性支氣管擴張。
→ [[nonspecific-interstitial-pneumonia]]

questions.questionText: 以下關於COP(cryptogenic organizing pneumonia)之相關敘述，何者為非?

options.text: ThehistologicpatternofCOPisorganizingpneumonia,formerlyreferred to as bronchiolitis obliterans (BO)
Typically,theappearanceofthelungopacitiesvariesfromgroundglassto consolidation
These opacities have a tendency to migrate, changing location and size
reverse halo sign and the atoll sign are possible presentations

questions.reference: Mueller-Mang, C., Grosse, C., Schmid, K., Stiebellehner, L., & Bankier, A. A. (2007). What every radiologist should know about idiopathic interstitial pneumonias. Radiographics, 27(3), 595-615. Kligerman, S. J., Franks, T. J., & Galvin, J. R. (2013). From the radiologic pathology archives: organization and fibrosis as a response to lung injury in diffuse alveolar damage, organizing pneumonia, and acute fibrinous and organizing pneumonia. Radiographics, 33(7), 1951-1975. (A)ThehistologicpatternofCOPisorganizingpneumonia,formerlyreferred to as bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia (BOOP).；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p199
questions.explanation:
答案 A。COP 的組織型態為 organizing pneumonia，其舊稱應為 BOOP（bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia），後為避免與真正的小氣道阻塞性疾病混淆而捨棄此名。(A) 把舊稱寫成單純的「bronchiolitis obliterans（BO）」是錯的——BO（閉塞性／收縮性細支氣管炎）是另一種阻塞性小氣道病，與 COP 不同，故 (A) 為敘述錯誤者。(B) 肺部陰影由毛玻璃到實質化不等、(C) 病灶可移行（改變位置與大小）、(D) 可出現 reverse halo（atoll）sign，皆為 COP 正確且典型的表現。
→ [[organizing-pneumonia]]
questions.author: 陳若瑀醫師

imageOcr.markdown:
**Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia**

COP is an IIP with characteristic clinical and radiologic features. The histologic pattern of COP is organizing pneumonia, formerly referred to as bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia (BOOP). The term *BOOP* has been omitted to avoid confusion with airway diseases such as constrictive bronchiolitis (3).

questions.questionText: Which statement about Lynch Syndrome is false?

options.text: Lynch syndrome is the most common hereditary cancer syndrome
Nearly all colonic malignancies in patients with Lynch syndrome exhibit microsatellite instability (MSI)
Left-side colon cancers, occur in 60%–80% of individuals with Lynch syndrome
The risks of individual cancers vary according to the particular MMR germline mutation and the sex of the individual

questions.reference: Vol. 38, No. 2 Lynch Syndrome: Genomics Update and Imaging Review；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p200

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**

- Lynch syndrome is the most common hereditary cancer syndrome, reportedly affecting one in 400 people and accounting for approximately 3% of new CRC diagnoses.
- Lynch syndrome is an autosomal dominant disorder of mismatch repair (MMR) proteins that results in poor repair of DNA replication errors. These errors preferentially accumulate in regions of the genome called microsatellites.
- Nearly all colonic malignancies in patients with Lynch syndrome exhibit MSI. However, not all microsatellite-unstable colonic malignancies are seen in patients with this condition. Up to 15% of sporadic CRCs have high MSI owing to somatic hypermethylation of the *MLH1* promoter and associated silencing of *MLH1*.
- There is an increased frequency of right-side (proximal to the splenic flexure) colon cancers, which occur in 60%–80% of individuals with Lynch syndrome compared with 30% of persons with sporadic cancers.
- The risks of individual cancers vary according to the particular MMR germline mutation and the sex of the individual.

imageOcr.markdown: **Mucinous Cystadenomas.**—Mucinous cystadenomas account for approximately 10% of pancreatic cystic neoplasms (11). These cystic lesions often have thickened walls that are lined by mucin-producing columnar epithelium (17). The distinguishing pathologic feature of the cysts is the presence of a surrounding ovarian-type stroma similar to that seen in biliary cystadenomas. Unlike IPMNs, mucinous cystadenomas do not communicate with the pancreatic ductal system. The vast majority (>95%) of mucinous cystadenomas have been found in women (mean age, 47 years), typically in the body or tail of the pancreas (17,22,23). Mucinous cystadenomas have malignant potential, and adequate sampling of the cyst lining must be performed for pathologic analysis to determine whether foci of dysplasia or carcinoma in situ are present.

Main duct IPMNs are more likely to be malignant, with approximately 60%–70% of cases demonstrating invasive carcinoma (28,29), whereas only 22% of branch duct IPMNs demonstrate foci of carcinoma (30). imageOcr.markdown: **Solid Pseudopapillary Tumors.**—Previously known as solid and cystic papillary epithelial neoplasms of the pancreas or as papillary cystic neoplasms, these uncommon lesions were named solid pseudopapillary tumors of the pancreas by the World Health Organization in 1996 (37). The tumors occur predominantly in women (mean age, 28 years) and have low-grade malignant potential (17). The cellular lineage of the tumors remains uncertain, with both epithelial and neuroendocrine differentiation having been suggested by various authors. The tumors occur exclusively in the pancreas and have no corollary in other organ systems.

**Teaching Point** — The classification of solid pseudopapillary tumors as cystic pancreatic lesions may lead to confusion at imaging because in many cases the tumors are completely solid. Cystic components are secondary to tumor degeneration, and they vary in both size and morphology. On T2-weighted MR images, pseudopapillary tumors are well circumscribed. Those that are predominantly solid have mildly increased T2 signal intensity, and those that are mostly cystic have T2 signal intensity closer to that of fluid (Figs 18–20). imageOcr.markdown: In the female pelvis, the peritoneum reflects over the dome of the bladder, the uterine corpus, and the rectouterine pouch (of Douglas). Posteriorly, the part of the peritoneum that divides the rectum into its intra- and extraperitoneal portions is also known as the anterior peritoneal reflection (Fig 3). At MRI, the anterior peritoneal reflection is recognized on midsagittal T2-weighted images as a thin hypointense line just posterior to the uterocervical junction (Fig 3). The anterior peritoneal reflection is most readily apparent in the presence of ascites, but may be a challenge to locate in a case of retroverted uterus, in patients with minimal body fat, or after surgery (3).

imageOcr.markdown:
Clues for diagnosis are as follows:

1. Peritoneal inclusion cyst appears as a uni- or multilocular cyst closely associated with the ovary and demonstrating low T1 SI and high T2 SI at MRI. Septa representing adhesions show mild enhancement. Solid enhancing nodules are absent (Fig 10).
2. The ovary is entrapped by the peritoneal adhesions and suspended centrally or eccentrically within the cyst, producing a characteristic "spider in a web" appearance (38). The ovary may be distorted but is otherwise normal and should not be confused with a solid enhancing nodule (Figs 6, 10).
3. Peritoneal inclusion cyst conforms to the contours of the pelvic cavity because the cyst lacks a true wall, with its margins formed by the adhesions and adjacent organs.

questions.questionText: What is the most common tumor to involve the perivesical space?

options.text: Direct extension of bladder tumor
Hemangioma
Solitary fibrous tumor
Liposarcoma

questions.reference: Radiographics. Jul-Aug 2019;39(4):1205-1229.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p207
questions.explanation: 答案 A。perivesical space 為 umbilicovesical fascia 包覆的小型潛在間隙（該筋膜後方與 rectovaginal fascia 融合），內含 urachus（臍尿管，median umbilical ligament）、閉鎖臍動脈與膀胱，後方與子宮下段相連；一如相鄰的 prevesical space，此間隙最常見的受累為膀胱或 urachus 腫瘤的直接延伸，而非原發於間隙的腫瘤，故答案為 A。B hemangioma、C solitary fibrous tumor、D liposarcoma 等原發間隙腫瘤皆極為罕見。→ [[pelvic-extraperitoneal-spaces]]

questions.questionText: Involvement of what anatomic structures may prevent successful resection of a pelvic tumor?

options.text: Ovaries
Uterus and cervix
Internal iliac vessels
Common and external iliac vessels

questions.reference: Radiographics. Jul-Aug 2019;39(4):1205-1229.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p208
questions.explanation: 答案 D。common 與 external iliac vessels 為下肢主要供血血管，被腫瘤包繞（encasement，環繞血管圓周 >50%）屬相對手術禁忌，切除時常需以移植血管重建，故其受累可能妨礙骨盆腫瘤的完整切除、為本題正解。C internal iliac vessels 因側枝循環豐富、受侵犯時可直接犧牲，並不構成切除阻礙；A ovaries 與 B uterus／cervix 受累亦非切除的絕對禁忌。判準：abutment 為環繞 <50%、encasement 為 >50%、luminal invasion 為腔內侵犯；MRI 上血管周圍完整不中斷的脂肪面可排除侵犯。→ [[pelvic-tumor-resectability-vessels]]

questions.questionText: What sign associated with retrorectal schwannoma and neurofibroma appears as multiple low-signal-intensity (SI) strands with peripheral high SI on T2-weighted images?

options.text: Bridging vessel sign
Claw sign
Fascicular sign
Fat split sign

questions.reference: Radiographics. Jul-Aug 2019;39(4):1205-1229.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p209
questions.explanation: 答案 C。題幹描述「T2WI 上多條低訊號束、各束周邊呈高訊號」對應的是 fascicular sign（束狀徵象），其病理基礎為神經束（fascicular bundles），屬神經源性腫瘤的內在徵象、於良性 PNST 較常見，故答案為 C。A bridging vessel sign 用於子宮漿膜下肌瘤與卵巢腫塊之鑑別，與神經鞘瘤內在訊號無關；B claw sign 為判斷病灶是否起源於器官或腔壁的通用徵象；D fat split sign 是病灶周圍一圈脂肪薄緣（T1 高訊號）而非束狀結構。另注意勿與 target sign（中央低訊號纖維、周邊高訊號 myxoid 的靶徵）混淆。→ [[peripheral-nerve-sheath-tumor-mri-signs]]
questions.author: 陳邦斌

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a described characteristic of villous adenomas?

options.text: They are the most common type of adenoma
They are usually smaller than other types of adenoma
Among the adenomatous polyps, they have the lowest potential for malignancy
They are considered one type of advanced adenoma

questions.reference: Radiographics Sep-Oct 2018;38(5):1370-1384；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p210
questions.explanation: 答案 D。腺瘤依絨毛成分分為 tubular、tubulovillous、villous 三型，其中 villous adenoma 屬於 advanced adenoma（癌前病變、惡性潛能最高），故 D 正確。A 錯：最常見者為 tubular（占腺瘤 >80%），villous 反而最少（約 5–15%）；B 錯：villous 通常體積較大，約 75% 大於 2 cm；C 錯：在腺瘤性息肉中 villous 的惡變潛能最高（約 40%）而非最低。→ [[gi-villous-lesions]]
questions.author: 陳邦斌

questions.questionText: Which feature is a described characteristic of advanced adenomas?

options.text: They are smaller than 10 mm
They do not exhibit dysplasia
They have a substantial villous component
They have a flat morphology

questions.reference: Radiographics Sep-Oct 2018;38(5):1370-1384；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p211
questions.explanation: 答案 C。Advanced adenoma（高惡變風險腺瘤）定義為 ≥10 mm（任何組織型）、或含明顯 villous 成分（>25%，含 tubulovillous 與 villous）、或具高度異型增生；C「有明顯 villous 成分」符合定義，故正確。A 錯：應為 ≥10 mm 而非 <10 mm；B 錯：advanced adenoma 可有異型增生，甚至以高度異型增生為定義要件之一；D 錯：並非以 flat 型態定義，flat（carpet）僅是其中一種形態。→ [[gi-villous-lesions]]
questions.author: 陳邦斌

questions.questionText: At barium examinations, villous lesions have which of the following characteristics?

options.text: A narrow base
Numerous polypoid protrusions into the bowel lumen
An annular configuration causing luminal narrowing and obstruction
Poor coating or covering with barium

questions.reference: Radiographics Sep-Oct 2018;38(5):1370-1384；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p212
questions.explanation: 答案 B。鋇劑攝影下 villous lesion 呈寬基（broad-based），表面有多個 polypoid 突起伸入腸腔，鋇劑滲入突起間隙形成 lace／frond／soap-bubble 花樣，故 B 正確。A 錯：為寬基而非窄基；C 錯：環狀狹窄阻塞屬晚期或惡變表現，非典型 villous lesion；D 錯：鋇劑會困陷於絨毛間隙，而非覆蓋不良。→ [[gi-villous-lesions]]
questions.author: 陳邦斌

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements describes the signal intensity characteristics of villous lesions at MRI?

options.text: Intermediate to high signal intensity on T2-weighted images
High signal intensity, due to hemorrhage, on T1-weighted images
Low surface signal intensity, due to mucin coating, on T2-weighted images
Intermediate to high signal intensity on T1-weighted images

questions.reference: Radiographics Sep-Oct 2018;38(5):1370-1384；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p213
questions.explanation: 答案 A。MRI 上 villous lesion 於 T2 呈異質性中至高訊號，表面常有一層厚 T2 高訊號層（高細胞或黏液膜覆蓋所致），故 A 正確。B 錯：T1 為低訊號、並非因出血呈高訊號；C 錯：表面黏液層在 T2 為高訊號而非低訊號；D 錯：T1 為低訊號，非中至高訊號。→ [[gi-villous-lesions]]
questions.author: 陳邦斌

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a described characteristic of sporadic duodenal villous lesions?

options.text: They occur most commonly in the fourth portion of the duodenum
They are commonly periampullary or ampullary when associated with FAP
They most commonly manifest with obstruction
They have imaging features that differ from those of colonic lesions

questions.reference: Radiographics Sep-Oct 2018;38(5):1370-1384；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p214
questions.explanation: 答案 B。與 FAP 相關之十二指腸 villous lesion 多位於壺腹或壺腹周圍，故 B 正確。A 錯：偶發性者最常見於第二段（D2），並非第四段；C 錯：多以非特異壁內結節填充缺損表現，阻塞並非最常見表現；D 錯：其影像特徵與大腸病灶相似（soap-bubble／cauliflower），並非不同。→ [[gi-villous-lesions]]

Crohn disease 與 Ulcerative colitis 的比較表：

| | Crohn' disease | Ulcerative colitis |
|---|---|---|
| Common site | Terminal ileum | Rectum |
| Distribution | Mouth to anus | Rectum |
| Spread | **Discontinuous** | Continuous |
| Gross feature | Focal aphthous ulcer with intervening normal mucosa, linear fissures, cobblestone appearance, thickened bowel wall, creeping fat | Extensive ulceration pseudopolyps |
| Microscopy | Non-caseating granulomas | Crypt abscesses |
| Inflammation | **Transmural** | Limited to mucosa and sub-mucosa |
| Complications | **Strictures**, string sign on barium studies, abscesses, **sinus tract**, obstruction, **fistulas** | Toxic megacolon |
| Extraintestinal manifestations | Uncommon | Arthritis, spondylitis, primary sclerosing cholangitis, erythema nodosum, pyoderma gangrenosum |
| Cancer risk | 1-3% | 5-25% |

questions.questionText: Which is wrong about long common channel of common bile duct and pancreatic duct?

options.text: An anatomic variant rather than acquired etiology
Increased incidence of pancreatitis
Association with type 1 choledochal cyst
Two ducts (common bile duct and main pancreatic duct) fusion exactly at but not prior to the sphincter of Oddi complex

questions.reference: 1 Prometheus Lionhart, MD. Crack the Core Exam - Volume 1: 8th (2021) Edition. p.209；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p219
questions.explanation: 答案 D。APBDU 的胰膽管匯合發生在十二指腸壁「外」、且位於 Oddi 括約肌「近端（之前）」，形成過長共同通道使括約肌無法調控交界；故 D「恰在括約肌處而非其近端匯合」的描述錯誤，即為本題要選的錯誤敘述。A 正確：屬先天解剖變異而非後天；B 正確：胰液反流使胰臟炎風險增加；C 正確：與第一型膽總管囊腫（choledochal cyst）高度相關。→ [[anomalous-pancreatobiliary-duct-union]]

Osseous involvement

Circumscribed, nonspecific mass on ultrasound
Presentation as a painless nodule

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements concerning soft tissue masses of the hand and wrist is false?

options.text: Lipomas are relatively uncommon in the hand. Typical locations are the thenar or hypothenar eminence
Sonography can differentiate between a cyst and a solid mass, as well as identifying internal blood flow of soft tissue masses
Epidermal inclusion cysts are the third most common soft tissue mass of the hand. Calcifications are extremely common found in epidermal inclusion cysts
Aneurysms may be mistaken for a solid mass on MRI. Color Doppler, duplex evaluation, CT angiography, and conventional angiography are useful diagnostic aids
MRI is the best imaging modality to characterize these masses

questions.reference: Soft Tissue Masses of the Hand and Wrist: Systematic Approach to Imaging Evaluation, Contemporary Diagnostic Radiology: February 15, 2020 - Volume 43 - Issue 4 - p 8 ; CME Quiz. No.5 (with modifications); doi: 10.1097/01.CDR.0000653556.54479.2a；10.1097/01.CDR.0000653556.54479.2a；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p224
questions.explanation:
答案 C。此題問「何者敘述錯誤」。C 的前半正確——表皮包涵囊腫（EIC）確為手部第三常見的軟組織腫塊；但後半「鈣化在 EIC 極為常見」為錯：EIC 的 MRI 訊號隨內含角質蛋白量而多變，鈣化其實並不常見，腫塊若明顯鈣化反而應想到 pilomatricoma（鈣化上皮瘤），這正是本題陷阱。其餘皆正確：A 脂肪瘤在手部相對少見，好發大魚際或小魚際；B 超音波可分辨囊性與實質，並以都卜勒評估內部血流；D 動脈瘤在 MRI 可被誤認為實質腫塊，需彩色都卜勒、雙功、CTA 或傳統血管攝影輔助鑑別；E MRI 為特徵化此類腫塊的最佳影像模態。
→ [[hand-wrist-soft-tissue-masses]]
questions.author: 王彧宸

questions.questionText: Which one of the following arthritis is more common in females?

options.text: Erosive osteoarthritis
Psoriatic arthritis
Reiter syndrome (currently known as reactive arthritis)
Gouty arthritis

questions.reference: Orthopedic Imaging – A Practical Approach 6th Edition, p.528；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p225
questions.explanation:
答案 A。侵蝕性（發炎性）骨關節炎有明顯女性偏好，F:M 約 12:1，典型見於停經後婦女，故最符合「較常見於女性」。其餘皆非女性為主：B 乾癬性關節炎無明顯性別偏好；C 反應性關節炎（舊稱 Reiter 症候群）好發男性，約 15–35 歲；D 痛風性關節炎明顯以男性為主（約 20:1），越年輕越偏男性，年老才漸趨男女平均。
→ [[erosive-osteoarthritis]]
questions.author: 游治維

questions.questionText: Which one of the following skeletal sites is LESS common seen in patients with an Ewing sarcoma?

options.text: Iliac bone
Scapula
Rib
Clavicle

questions.reference: Orthopedic Imaging – A Practical Approach 6th Edition, p.877；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p226
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題問 Ewing sarcoma「較少見」的骨骼部位。Ewing sarcoma 好發下肢（約 45%，股骨最常見）與骨盆（約 20%），扁骨中以髂骨（骨盆約 14%）、肩胛骨、肋骨（約 6%）相對常見。鎖骨並不在常見發生部位之列，屬少見，故 D 最不常見。相對地 A 髂骨、B 肩胛骨、C 肋骨皆較鎖骨常見。
→ [[ewing-sarcoma-family]]
questions.author: 游治維

questions.questionText: Which one of the following radiographic features on radiography is NOT usually seen in patients with Rickets?

options.text: Bowing deformity of the long bones
Decreased size of the epiphysis
Flaring of the metaphysis
Widening of the growth plate

questions.reference: Orthopedic Imaging – A Practical Approach 6th Edition, p.2120；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p227
questions.explanation:
答案 B。此題問佝僂病 X 光「非」典型表現。佝僂病的骨骺骨化中心因礦化不良而出現延遲、邊緣模糊，但體積並不會縮小，故「骨骺體積減小」非其表現。其餘皆為典型：A 合併骨軟化使骨質變弱而長骨彎曲；C 幹骺端因未礦化類骨質堆積而呈喇叭狀展開（flaring）並伴毛刷狀、杯口狀變化；D 生長板臨時鈣化區堆積未礦化 osteoid，故生長板增寬。
→ [[metabolic-bone-disease-imaging]]
questions.author: 游治維

questions.questionText: Which one of the following radiographic features on radiography is NOT usually seen in patients with a subtle fracture?

options.text: Periosteal reaction
Intraarticular fat-fluid level
Double cortical line
Irregular epiphyseal corners

questions.reference: Orthopedic Imaging – A Practical Approach 6th Edition, p.137-140；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p228
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題問「非」隱匿性骨折的間接徵象。不規則骨骺角並非骨折徵象，而是指向骨壞死/骨梗塞、感染或代謝性/發育性病變（如壞血病 corner sign、佝僂病幹骺端變化），故為正解。其餘皆為隱匿性骨折可用的間接徵象：A 骨膜反應成因雖廣，癒合期可提示先前未察覺的骨折或壓力性骨折；B 關節內脂肪-液平（lipohemarthrosis／FBI sign）代表骨髓脂肪與血滲入關節，只要看到即代表關節內骨折；C 雙皮質線反映皮質壓陷/嵌插，提示壓陷性骨折。
→ [[subtle-fracture-radiographic-signs]]
questions.author: 游治維

questions.questionText: Which ONE of the following image findings is NOT seen in Ollier disease on the radiograph?

options.text: Lesions may contain foci of calcification
Lesions may be intracortical and periosteal
Lesions may protrude from the shaft of the tubular bone
Lesions may extend from the growth plate to the epiphysis

questions.reference: Orthopedic Imaging – A Practical Approach 6th Edition, p.736；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p229
questions.explanation:
答案 D。⚠️ 此題問 Ollier 病 X 光「非」表現，各家文獻對此選項描述不一致，作答存疑。依概念判讀：Ollier 的內生軟骨瘤源自髓腔、主要位於幹骺端，隨生長可向骨幹遷移，但一般不會跨越生長板侵入骨骺（骨骺通常被保留），故「病灶由生長板延伸至骨骺」視為非典型表現。其餘皆屬 enchondromatosis 譜系可見：A 軟骨基質可有 rings-and-arcs／punctate 鈣化；B 病灶可呈皮質內或骨膜性軟骨瘤；C 病灶可自管狀骨骨幹膨出。
→ [[enchondromatosis]]
questions.author: 游治維

imageOcr.markdown:
**Radiographic features**（Radiopaedia，enchondromatosis / Ollier）

Radiographs show multiple enchondromas. Larger lesions can show cartilage calcification in a typical rings and arcs pattern.

Vertical streaks of lucency also **present in the metaphysis of long bones, extending to the epiphysis**, which represents columns of cartilage.

For further discussion of appearances, please refer to the article on enchondromas.

**Pathology/Histology**

The macroscopic features of Ollier syndrome include islands of **benign resting cartilage within metaphyses and diaphyses**, which subsequently proliferate. Microscopically, calcifications, ranging from punctate to "popcorn" in appearance may develop within the cartilaginous matrix.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option:

options.text: The test result of rheumatoid factor reliably differentiates rheumatoid arthritis from other inflammatory arthritis
In rheumatoid arthritis, inflammation begins at the enthesis and later spreads to adjacent synovium
In psoriatic arthritis, inflammation begins in bare areas of joints and most commonly involves the distal phalangeal joints
New bone formation happens in psoriatic arthritis and uncommonly happens in rheumatoid arthritis

questions.reference: Differentiating Rheumatoid and Psoriatic Arthritis of the Hand: Multimodality Imaging Characteristics. Radiographics, Jul 31 2020.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p230
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題選「正確」敘述。D 正確：關節旁新骨形成（periostitis／enthesophyte）是乾癬性關節炎的特徵，類風濕性關節炎則以純侵蝕加近關節骨質疏鬆為主，較少見新骨形成。A 錯：約 30% 類風濕性關節炎的類風濕因子為陰性，故 RF 無法可靠區分 RA 與其他發炎性關節炎；B 錯：RA 發炎的原發部位是滑膜，附著點（enthesis）才是 PsA 的起始處；C 錯：始於關節裸區（bare area）侵蝕、以近端關節為主的是 RA，而非以 DIP／附著點為主的 PsA。
→ [[psoriatic-arthritis]]
questions.author: 黃新傑

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option:

options.text: In psoriatic arthritis, since inflammation happens in enthesis and not in synovium, existence of effusion in MRI helps to exclude the diagnosis of psoriatic arthritis
Boutonniere deformity happens more commonly in rheumatoid arthritis, while Hitchhiker deformity more commonly seen in patients with psoriatic arthritis
Mouse ear sign represents erosion in bare areas of joint and suggests diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis
In late-stage psoriatic arthritis, bone destruction and erosions with new bone formation may result in pencil-in-cup deformity

questions.reference: Differentiating Rheumatoid and Psoriatic Arthritis of the Hand: Multimodality Imaging Characteristics. Radiographics, Jul 31 2020.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p231
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題選「正確」敘述。D 正確：晚期乾癬性關節炎的骨破壞與侵蝕合併新骨形成，可在 DIP 造成典型的鉛筆套杯（pencil-in-cup）變形。A 錯：關節或腱鞘積液在 RA 與 PsA 皆可見，不能用來排除 PsA；B 錯：鈕扣狀（Boutonnière）與天鵝頸變形是 RA 最常見且早期即可出現的變形，hitchhiker 等屬進展期，非 PsA 專屬；C 錯：老鼠耳（mouse-ear）徵象是 PsA 附著點骨侵蝕合併骨增生的表現、好發 DIP，並非 RA 的裸區侵蝕。
→ [[psoriatic-arthritis]]
questions.author: 黃新傑

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option:

options.text: At PDFS and T1WI , bone marrow edema has high signal intensity
Presence of bone marrow edema indicates the onset of irreversible bone changes in inflammatory arthritis
In rheumatoid arthritis, bone marrow edema begins at the bare areas of the joint and spread to the entire phalanx
In psoriatic arthritis, bone marrow edema begins at the corner of the phalanx at the enthesis of the capsule

questions.reference: Differentiating Rheumatoid and Psoriatic Arthritis of the Hand: Multimodality Imaging Characteristics. Radiographics, Jul 31 2020.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p232
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題選「正確」敘述。D 正確：乾癬性關節炎的骨髓水腫始於指骨角落、關節囊附著點（enthesis）處，並隨病程蔓延至整節指骨甚至骨幹。A 錯：骨髓水腫在 T1WI 為低訊號、僅在質子密度脂肪抑制（PDFS）序列呈高訊號；B 錯：與代表不可逆的放射線侵蝕相反，骨髓水腫被視為可逆現象，並非不可逆骨變化的起點；C 錯：RA 的骨髓水腫位於裸區鄰近，向整節指骨/骨幹蔓延的型態屬 PsA 而非 RA。
→ [[psoriatic-arthritis]]
questions.author: 黃新傑

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option:

options.text: The intrinsic high T2 signal of cartilaginous precursors most commonly seen in calcaneous and lateral malleoli in pediatric ankles
The preossification centers of ankles most commonly seen in calcaneal apophysis, navicular cartilaginous precursors and lateral malleolus
Existence of intense enhancement on post-contrast imaging of MR from preossification center
Preossification center may have fluid like content and mimics a cyst

questions.reference: Pitfalls in MRI of the Developing Pediatric Ankle. Radiographics. Nov 20 2020.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p233
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題選「正確」敘述。D 正確：骨化前中心（preossification center）在 MRI 可呈邊界清楚、圓形、類囊液的高訊號，酷似囊腫或膿瘍，關鍵鑑別在於周邊無骨髓/軟組織水腫。A 錯：軟骨前身的正常（有時相當強）T2/STIR 高訊號好發於內踝與跟骨，而非「跟骨加外踝」；B 錯：骨化前中心好發於內踝、跟骨骨突、navicular 軟骨前身，而非外踝；C 錯：軟骨前身/骨化前中心並非典型呈強烈對比增強（官方原標「????」，非正解）。
→ [[pediatric-ankle-ossification-mri]]
questions.author: 黃新傑

questions.questionText: Chose the correct option:

options.text: The talus ossification center ossifies after the calcaneous ossification center does, and is radiographically invisible after birth
The primary ossification centers have high signal intensity on T2WI and low signal intensity on T1WI due to high vascularity
The “starry sky apperance” of secondary ossification centers is commonly seen in hindfoot
The “starry sky appearance” in primary ossification centers may persist in young adults

questions.reference: Pitfalls in MRI of the Developing Pediatric Ankle. Radiographics. Nov 20 2020.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p234
questions.explanation:
答案 D。此題選「正確」敘述。D 正確：星空狀（starry sky）外觀為初級（primary）骨化中心內多發圓形 T2/STIR 高訊號的正常紅骨髓灶，屬正常變異，可延續至年輕成人。A 錯：距骨骨化中心雖晚於跟骨出現，但兩者皆於子宮內骨化，出生時 X 光即可見（並非看不到）；B 錯：初級骨化中心以 T1 高、STIR/脂抑 T2 低（黃骨髓）為主，並非「T1 低 T2 高」；C 錯：星空狀外觀屬初級骨化中心，並非次級中心、也非好發於後足。
→ [[pediatric-ankle-ossification-mri]]
questions.author: 黃新傑

questions.questionText: Which of the following description is false regarding pseudoprogression of tumor after radiation therapy?

options.text: It rarely occurs within 3 months
It shows increased size of enhancing lesion
It is related to local tissue inflammatory reaction
Imaging cannot reliably differentiate pseudoprogression from true progression

questions.reference: The diagnosis and treatment of pseudoprogression, radiation necrosis and brain tumor recurrence. Int J Mol Sci. 2014;15 (7): 11832-46.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p235
questions.explanation: 答案 A。假性進展（pseudoprogression）屬 early-delayed／subacute 期變化，多在放療後數週至約 3 個月內出現（膠質母細胞瘤同步放化療 Stupp protocol 後尤其常見），並非「罕見於 3 個月內」，故 A 敘述錯誤；B：表現為強化病灶增大，正確；C：與局部組織發炎反應（放射對寡突膠細胞髓鞘合成之暫時性損傷）相關，正確；D：常規影像無法可靠區分假性進展與真進展，需輔以灌注／MRS／PET 及時序追蹤，正確。題目問「錯誤」者，故選 A。→ [[radiation-induced-changes]]
questions.author: 陳雅芳

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the least likely radiation-induced CNS neoplasms?

options.text: Meningiomas
Lymphomas
Gliomas
Sarcomas

questions.reference: Radiation-induced brain tumours after central nervous system irradiation in childhood: a review. Child's Nervous System volume 24, pages793–805(2008)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p236
