questions.questionText: Which of the following description is false regarding the adult-onset neuronal intranuclear inclusion disease (NIID)

options.text: Can be diagnosed by skin biopsy
It is a slowly progressive neurodegenerative disease
MRI shows high DWI signal in deep periventricular white matter of brain
MRI shows remarkable leukoencephalopathy

questions.reference: Clinicopathological features of adult-onset neuronal intranuclear inclusion disease. BRAIN 2016: 139; 3170–3186；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p237
questions.explanation: 答案 C。神經元核內包涵體病（NIID）的招牌 DWI 高訊號沿皮質–髓質交界（corticomedullary junction）呈緞帶狀分布，且不擴及深部腦室旁白質，即使晚期亦然，故 C「深部腦室旁白質 DWI 高訊號」之敘述錯誤；A：可由皮膚切片見嗜酸性核內包涵體診斷，正確；B：為緩慢進展之神經退化病，正確；D：MRI 可見顯著白質腦病（leukoencephalopathy），正確。題目問「錯誤」者，故選 C。→ [[bilateral-subcortical-dwi-hyperintensity-ddx]]
questions.author: 陳雅芳

questions.questionText: Which of the following description is false regarding cerebral autosomal dominant arteriopathy with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy (CADASIL)?

options.text: It is the most common single-gene disorder of cerebral small blood vessels
It is related to NOTCH3 mutations
MRI commonly show brain atrophy and diffuse white matter change
MRI rarely show cerebral microbleeds

questions.reference: 中；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p238
questions.explanation: 答案 D。CADASIL 是 NOTCH3 基因（第 19 號染色體）突變造成的體染色體顯性小血管病，為最常見的單基因腦小血管病，故 A 正確；其致病基因確為 NOTCH3，B 正確；MRI 典型可見瀰漫白質高訊號與晚期腦萎縮，C 正確；D「MRI 少見腦微出血」與事實相反——在 GRE／SWI 上 CADASIL 的微出血相當常見（約 25–50%，隨年齡增加，最常群聚於視丘與深部灰質），故 D 為錯誤敘述。→ [[lacunar-infarction]]
questions.difficulty:
Cerebral Microbleeds, Hypertension, and Intracerebral Hemorrhage in Cerebral
Autosomal-Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts and
Leukoencephalopathy. Front. Neurol., 15 May 2017
questions.author: 陳雅芳

questions.questionText: Which of the following imaging findings is the least likely related to cerebral autosomal dominant arteriopathy with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy (CADASIL)?

options.text: Diffuse cerebral leukoencephalopathy
Intracranial major vessel stenosis
Microbleeds in the thalamus and subcortical regions
Multiple old lacunes in the cerebral white matter

questions.reference: CADASIL. Lancet Neurol 2009; 8: 643–53；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p239
questions.explanation: 答案 B。CADASIL 屬小血管病，侵犯腦與軟腦膜的穿通小動脈，傳統血管攝影（DSA）正常，不會出現顱內大血管狹窄，故 B（顱內主要血管狹窄）與 CADASIL 最不相關；A 瀰漫白質腦病、C 視丘與皮質下微出血、D 白質內多發陳舊性腔隙皆為 CADASIL 典型影像表現。→ [[lacunar-infarction]]
questions.author: 陳雅芳

questions.questionText: 下列關於經靜脈注射血栓溶血劑(rt-PA)及血管內血栓移除術 (endovascular thrombectomy, EVT)相關敘述，何者為非?

options.text: rt-PA藉由分解血栓的方式打通阻塞的血管，如果遇到較大的血栓，如阻塞的 位置在中大腦動脈近端、內頸動脈或基底動脈等，或者是非急性形成的血栓 ，如動脈硬化的斑塊造成的血管栓塞，rt-PA的治療效果欠佳，大約只有二至 三成的血管再通率，遠低於其他阻塞位置或者中風類型的治療效果。
台灣健保於2016年開始給付EVT，限於NIHSS 8至30分、前循環發病8小時或 後循環發病24小時內的急性缺血中風病人。
EVT對於年齡小於18歲的中風病人的效果卓越。
後循環急性缺血性中風使用動脈內血栓溶解或是血栓移除的效果目前證據力 較有限。

questions.reference: 2019台灣腦中風學會急性缺血中風動脈內血栓移除治療指引；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p240
questions.explanation: 答案 C。EVT 的臨床試驗僅納入 18 歲以上成人，對未滿 18 歲兒童的療效尚無實證、並非「效果卓越」，故 C 為錯誤敘述；A 正確，rt-PA 對 ICA、MCA 近端或基底動脈等大血栓及動脈硬化斑塊造成的栓塞，再通率僅約二至三成、效果欠佳；B 正確，台灣健保自 2016 年起給付 EVT；D 正確，後循環急性缺血中風之動脈內溶栓或取栓證據力仍較有限。→ [[intra-arterial-thrombectomy]]
questions.author: 李崇維醫師

questions.questionText: 下列關於經靜脈注射血栓溶血劑(rt-PA)及血管內血栓移除術 (endovascular thrombectomy, EVT)相關敘述，何者為非?

options.text: rt-PA的效用不因血管大小而有所影響，即使在較大的血栓，如阻塞的位置在中大腦動脈近 端、內頸動脈或基底動脈等，其治療效果也相當好。
急性缺血中風病人若符合以下條件，應積極評估EVT治療的可能性: 年齡 ≥ 18歲；中風前的 mRS ≤ 1；NIHSS ≥ 6；開始進行介入性治療時間離中風症狀發生時間在6小時以內；和病人中 風症狀相符的ICA或MCA M1阻塞，以及腦部斷層影像ASPECTS分數 ≥ 6。
急性缺血中風病人若符合選項(B)之臨床條件，但是與中風臨床症狀相符的血管阻塞位置在 MCA M2/M3血管，仍可評估EVT的可能性。
若病患其符合EVT的治療標準，且並沒有腎功能損傷的病史，則在獲得血清肌酸酐(creatinine) 檢查結果之前，可考慮直接進行CTA檢查。

questions.reference: 2019台灣腦中風學會急性缺血中風動脈內血栓移除治療指引；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p241
questions.explanation: 答案 A。rt-PA 的溶栓效果會隨血栓大小而不同，遇到 ICA、MCA 近端或基底動脈等大血栓時再通率僅約二至三成、效果欠佳，正是發展機械取栓的理由，故「效用不因血管大小而異、大血栓也很好」的 A 為錯誤敘述；B 正確，符合 EVT 之 Class I 準則（年齡 ≥18、mRS ≤1、NIHSS ≥6、ICA 或 M1 阻塞、ASPECTS ≥6、6 小時內開始介入）；C 正確，M2／M3 阻塞仍可評估取栓；D 正確，無腎功能損傷病史者可在血清肌酸酐結果出來前先行 CTA。→ [[acute-stroke-management]]
questions.author: 李崇維醫師

questions.questionText: 以下關於缺血性腦中風急性期的血壓控制建議，何者為非?

options.text: 未接受再灌流治療者，除了須緊急降壓的情況之外(例如嚴重的心衰竭、主動脈剝 離、高血壓腦症等)，在發生缺血性腦中風24小時內，建議收縮壓超過160 mmHg或 舒張壓超過60 mmH時開始使用降壓藥物。
符合接受靜脈血栓溶解治療者，在注射血栓溶解劑時，建議血壓控制在185/110 mmHg以下。
符合接受動脈內血栓移除治療者，若未接受靜脈血栓溶解治療，術前把血壓控制在 185/110 mmHg以下是合理的。
接受動脈內血栓移除治療者，術後24小時內將血壓維持在<180/105 mmHg是合理 的。若術後有達到成功再灌流(mTICI2b-3)，於術後24小時內將血壓維持在較低的範 圍(如<140/90 mmHg)是可以考慮的。

questions.reference: 2020台灣腦中風學會缺血性腦中風相關之血壓 控制指引；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p242
questions.explanation: 答案 A。未接受再灌流治療者採允許性高血壓，除嚴重心衰竭、主動脈剝離、高血壓腦症等須緊急降壓的情況外，發病 24 小時內須收縮壓超過 220 mmHg 或舒張壓超過 120 mmHg 才開始降壓，A 誤植為 160／60 之過低門檻，故為錯誤敘述；B 正確，接受靜脈溶栓者注射時血壓控制在 185／110 mmHg 以下；C 正確，EVT 術前未接受靜脈溶栓者控制在 185／110 以下屬合理；D 正確，EVT 術後 24 小時維持 <180／105，若成功再灌流（mTICI 2b–3）可考慮更低的 <140／90。→ [[acute-stroke-management]]
questions.author: 李崇維醫師

questions.questionText: 下列關於缺血性中風之相關敘述，何者為非?

options.text: 台灣健保於2016年開始給付EVT，限於NIHSS 8至20分、前循環發病6小 時或後循環發病24小時內的急性缺血中風病人。
EVT術後24至48小時，建議安排電腦斷層或核磁共振影像檢查。
符合IV rt-PA治療標準的急性缺血中風病人，必須先接受IV rt-PA，並且 儘量縮短DTN時間。
腦部小血管疾病(cerebral small vessel disease)是造成急性腦中風的重要 病因。

questions.reference: 2019台灣腦中風學會急性缺血中風動脈內血栓移除治療指引 2020台灣腦中風學會缺血性腦中風相關之血壓 控制指引；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p243
questions.explanation: 答案 A。台灣健保自 2016 年起給付 EVT，標準為 NIHSS 8 至 30 分、前循環發病 8 小時內或後循環發病 24 小時內，A 誤寫為「NIHSS 8 至 20 分、前循環 6 小時」，故為錯誤敘述；B 正確，EVT 術後 24 至 48 小時建議安排 CT 或 MRI 追蹤；C 正確，符合 IV rt-PA 標準者須先給予並儘量縮短 DTN 時間；D 正確，腦部小血管疾病是急性腦中風的重要病因。→ [[ia-thrombectomy-stroke-window]]
questions.author: 李崇維醫師

questions.questionText: Modified Boston Criteria for definite CAA, which of the following is wrong

options.text: It is established based on full post-mortem examination
Features lobar, cortical, or cortical-subcortical hemorrhage
Pathological evidence of severe cerebral amyloid angiopathy and absence of other diagnostic lesion
Often with numerous deep microbleeds

questions.reference: Greenberg, S. M., & Charidimou, A. (2018). Diagnosis of cerebral amyloid angiopathy: evolution of the Boston criteria. Stroke, 49(2), 491-497. Pasi, M., Charidimou, A., Boulouis, G., Auriel, E., Ayres, A., Schwab, K. M., ... & Gurol, M. E. (2018). Mixed-location cerebral hemorrhage/microbleeds: underlying microangiopathy and recurrence risk. Neurology, 90(2), e119-e126.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p244
questions.explanation: 答案 D。Definite CAA 是病理層級的診斷，需經全面屍檢證實有腦葉／皮質／皮質-皮質下出血、嚴重的腦類澱粉血管病變且無其他可診斷病灶，故 A、B、C 皆為其正確要件；D「常伴多發深部微出血」與 CAA 特性相反——CAA 的出血與微出血侷限於皮質-皮質下（lobar）並保留基底核與腦幹，深部微出血反而是高血壓性微血管病的表現，且 definite CAA 不以微出血為診斷要件，故 D 為錯誤。→ [[cerebral-amyloid-angiopathy]]
questions.author: 李崇維醫師

imageOcr.markdown:
**Definite CAA**（Boston criteria）

Full postmortem examination demonstrating:
- Lobar, cortical, or cortical–subcortical hemorrhage
- Severe CAA with vasculopathy
- Absence of other diagnostic lesion

**Table 1. Modified Boston Criteria for CAA**

**Definite CAA** — Full postmortem examination demonstrating:
- Lobar, cortical, or cortical–subcortical hemorrhage
- Severe CAA with vasculopathy
- Absence of other diagnostic lesion

**Probable CAA with supporting pathology** — Clinical data and pathological tissue (evacuated hematoma or cortical biopsy) demonstrating:
- Lobar, cortical, or cortical–subcortical hemorrhage (including ICH, CMB, or cSS)
- Some degree of CAA in specimen
- Absence of other diagnostic lesion

**Probable CAA** — Clinical data and MRI or CT demonstrating:
- Multiple hemorrhages (ICH, CMB) restricted to lobar, cortical, or cortical–subcortical regions (cerebellar hemorrhage allowed), or single lobar, cortical, or cortical–subcortical hemorrhage and cSS (focal or disseminated)
- Age ≥55 y
- Absence of other cause of hemorrhage*

**Possible CAA** — Clinical data and MRI or CT demonstrating:
- Single lobar, cortical, or cortical–subcortical ICH, CMB, or cSS (focal or disseminated)
- Age ≥55 y
- Absence of other cause of hemorrhage*

CAA indicates cerebral amyloid angiopathy; CMB, cerebral microbleed; cSS, cortical superficial siderosis; CT, computed tomography; ICH, intracerebral hemorrhage; and MRI, magnetic resonance imaging.

*Other causes of hemorrhage (differential diagnosis of lobar hemorrhages): antecedent head trauma, hemorrhagic transformation of an ischemic stroke, arteriovenous malformation, hemorrhagic tumor, warfarin therapy with international normalization ratio >3, and vasculitis.

questions.questionText: For external acoustic canal (EAC) atresia, which one is less likely?

options.text: Dysmorphic malleus and incus
Normal morphology of stapes
Aberrant course of tympanic and mastoid portions of facial nerve
Inner ear and internal acoustic canal are usually stenotic

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging: Head and neck, I-2-6；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p246
questions.explanation: 答案 D。先天性外中耳畸形的病變侷限於聲音傳導路徑（外耳道、鼓膜、中耳腔、聽小骨），而內耳與內聽道源自胚胎期較早形成的 otocyst、通常正常（僅 <30% 有內耳異常且多提示症候群），故「內耳與內聽道通常狹窄」的 D 最不可能；A 正確，malleus 與 incus 常見畸形；B 正確，stapes 型態可正常；C 正確，顏面神經鼓室段與乳突段走行常異常（乳突段較正常更向前外側移位），為手術重建的關鍵風險。→ [[congenital-aural-atresia]]
questions.author: 王郁棻

questions.questionText: For external auditory canal (EAC) exostosis, which one is less likely

options.text: Most common solid tumor in EAC
Usually bilateral
Usually a narrow-based lesion
Also called Surfer’s ear

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging: Head and neck. I-2-25；10.4103/0971-3026.90687；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p247
questions.explanation: 答案 C。外耳道 exostoses 是冷水反覆刺激造成的反應性骨增生，典型為寬基底（broad-based）、環繞骨性外耳道的增生，故「窄基底」的 C 最不可能——窄基底／有蒂是 osteoma 的特徵；A 正確，exostoses 為外耳道最常見的實質（骨性）腫瘤；B 正確，通常為兩側；D 正確，俗稱 surfer's ear（衝浪者耳），與冷水暴露相關。→ [[eac-exostoses]]
questions.author: 王郁棻

questions.questionText: For cholesterol granuloma of middle ear, which one is less likely?

options.text: Smooth, expansile mass of middle ear
High T1 signal due to cholesterol component and methemoglobin
Hyperintense on b=1000 non-echo planar DWI series
The most common cystic lesion of the petrous apex

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging: Head and neck, I-2 70；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p248
questions.explanation: 答案 C。膽固醇肉芽腫典型不會擴散受限，non-EPI DWI 上呈高訊號／擴散受限者應想 cholesteatoma 或 epidermoid，故「b=1000 non-EPI DWI 高訊號」對膽固醇肉芽腫最不可能，C 為答案；A 正確，為中耳平滑膨脹性腫塊；B 正確，因膽固醇成分與 methemoglobin 而呈 T1 高訊號；D 正確，膽固醇肉芽腫是岩尖最常見的囊性病灶。→ [[cholesterol-granuloma-petrous-apex]]
questions.author: 王郁棻

questions.questionText: Regarding to acute transverse myelitis, which of the following statements are wrong?

options.text: It is the most common cause of acute myelitis
It is a diagnosis of exclusion
CSF inflammation with unsual pleocytosis and occasionally elevated IgG is common
Long extensive transverse myelitis (LETM) pattern on T2W MRI is pathogomonic acute transverse myelitis

questions.reference: An Approach to the Diagnosis of Acute Transverse Myelitis. SEMINARS IN NEUROLOGY 2008; 28(1); 105-120；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p249
questions.explanation: 答案 D。長節段橫貫性脊髓炎（LETM ≥3 椎節）並非特發性急性橫貫性脊髓炎的特徵性（pathognomonic）表現，反而高度提示 NMOSD（抗 AQP4 星狀細胞病），故 D 為錯誤敘述；A 大致正確，發炎性（特發性）橫貫性脊髓炎是急性脊髓炎最常見的成因；B 正確，特發性 ATM 屬排除性診斷；C 正確，常見 CSF 發炎、可有 pleocytosis 及偶爾 IgG 上升。→ [[neuromyelitis-optica]]
questions.author: 林彥亨

questions.questionText: 關於顱內大血管之血管壁影像(vessel wall imaging)在臨床上的應用，以下 何者有錯？

options.text: 對於造成慢性動脈狹窄病因的鑑別診斷有幫助。
對於急性大血管阻塞的病因，及血管內治療策略的擬定有幫助。
對於動脈斑塊是否容易破裂造成併發病可能有幫助。
偵測非狹窄的血管病灶有幫助。

questions.reference: Intracranial Vessel Wall MRI: Principles and Expert Consensus Recommendations of the American Society of Neuroradiology. AJNR Am J Neuroradiol; 2017;38:218–29；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p250
questions.explanation: 答案 B。血管壁影像（VW-MRI）的臨床價值在於「慢性」血管病變的鑑別與評估，而非急性大血管阻塞（LVO）的病因判定或血管內取栓策略擬定，故 B 有錯。（A）對慢性動脈狹窄成因的鑑別有幫助：動脈粥狀硬化呈偏心性管壁增厚、不均勻強化，血管炎呈同心圓管壁增厚、均勻強化，剝離見 T1 壁內血腫／T2 內膜瓣，RCVS 則管壁幾乎不強化，可依強化型態區分，正確。（C）可評估斑塊活性與是否易破裂（如強化代表活性斑塊、T1 高訊號代表斑塊內出血），對併發症風險判讀有幫助，正確。（D）能偵測管腔造影正常但管壁確有病灶的非狹窄性病變（如症狀性非狹窄斑塊），正確。→ [[mri-vessel-wall-imaging]]
questions.author: 林彥亨

imageOcr.markdown:
**RECOMMENDATIONS FOR CLINICAL PRACTICE**

**Intracranial VW-MR Imaging Is Likely a Useful Adjunct to Conventional Imaging**
1) To differentiate among causes of intracranial arterial narrowing such as intracranial atherosclerotic plaque, vasculitis, reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome, and arterial dissection.
2) To identify symptomatic, nonstenotic disease of the intracranial arteries.

**Intracranial VW-MR Imaging Is Possibly a Useful Adjunct to Conventional Imaging**
1) To determine the location of atherosclerotic plaque relative to branch artery ostia.
2) To assess atherosclerotic plaque activity.
3) To assess vasculitis activity.
4) To select an intracranial target for biopsy in suspected CNS vasculitis.
5) To determine which aneurysm has ruptured in patients with acute subarachnoid hemorrhage and multiple aneurysms.

**Intracranial VW-MR Imaging Is Currently in the Domain of Research**
1) To predict future behavior of unruptured intracranial saccular aneurysms.

options.text: “Floating palate” refers to LeFort II fracture
It must involve pterygoid plate
Combination of multiple types of LeFort fractures are possible
Different types of fractures on bilateral sites are possible

questions.questionText: Which of the following description regarding chondroblastoma is FALSE?

options.text: Eccentric medullary, subarticular location with open growth plate; nearly all begin within epiphysis
Two-thirds occur in lower extremity, 50% around knee
Male : Female = 2 : 1
Peak in the 1st decade

questions.reference: Dahner Radiology Review Manual 7th ed., p. 58；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p253
questions.explanation:
⚠️ 疑似與 2021-048 為同一題（相似度 0.849），請醫師確認是否合併。
⚠️ 本題含影像（官方詳解 PDF 第 253 頁），影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。
questions.author: J-W Ku (SHH)

imageOcr.markdown:
**CHONDROBLASTOMA**（= Codman tumor = benign chondroblastoma = cartilage-containing giant cell tumor）

- **Incidence:** 1% of primary bone neoplasms (700 cases in world literature)
- **Age:** peak in 2nd decade (range 8–59 years); 10–26 years (90%); M:F = 2:1; occurs before cessation of enchondral bone growth
- **Path:** derived from primitive cartilage cells
- **Histo:** polyhedral chondroblasts + multinucleated giant cells + nodules of pink amorphous material (= chondroid) = epiphyseal chondromatous giant cell tumor (resembles chondromyxoid fibroma); "chicken wire" calcification = pericellular deposition of calcification is virtually PATHOGNOMONIC
- symptomatic for months to years prior to treatment
- mild joint pain, tenderness, swelling (joint effusion)
- limitation of motion
- **Location:**
  - (a) long bones (80%): proximal femur + greater trochanter (23%), distal femur (20%), proximal tibia (17%), proximal humerus (17%); 2/3 in lower extremity, 50% about knee; may occur in apophyses (minor + greater trochanter, patella, greater tuberosity of humerus)
  - (b) flat bones: near triradiate cartilage of innominate bone, rib (3%)
  - (c) short tubular bones of hand + feet
- **Site:** eccentric medullary, subarticular location with open growth plate (98% begin within epiphysis); tumor growth may continue to involve metaphysis (50%) + rarely diaphysis

questions.questionText: Which of the following description regarding Milwaukee Shoulder is FALSE?

options.text: Complete rotator cuff tear
Rapidly progressive osteoarthritic changes
Typically involve older men
Frequent history of trauma

questions.reference: Dahnert Radiology Review Manual 7th ed., pp. 32-33  = =” p.137才對…….；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p255
questions.explanation:
答案 C。此題問「何者敘述錯誤」。C 錯誤：Milwaukee shoulder（鹼性磷酸鈣結晶破壞性關節病變）最常見於老年女性（約 50–90 歲），並非老年男性。其餘皆正確：A 常見完全性旋轉肌袖撕裂；B 呈快速進行的破壞性骨關節炎變化；D 患側常有創傷病史。
→ [[milwaukee-shoulder]]
questions.author: J-W Ku (SHH)

imageOcr.markdown:
**Milwaukee Shoulder** = association of
1. complete rotator cuff tear
2. osteoarthritic changes
3. noninflammatory joint effusion containing calcium hydroxyapatite and calcium pyrophosphate dihydrate (CPPD) crystals
4. hyperplasia of synovium
5. destruction of cartilage + subchondral bone
6. multiple osteochondral loose bodies

- **Age:** older woman
- frequent history of trauma

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a common cause of spontaneous intraparenchymal hemorrhage in older adult?

options.text: Hypertension
Cerebral amyloid angiopathy
Neoplasm
Cerebral aneurysm

questions.reference: Osborn's Brain: Imaging, Pathology, and Anatomy, 2nd ed., p. 115；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p257
questions.explanation: 答案 D。老年人自發性腦實質內出血（IPH）的常見病因為高血壓（好發深部：基底核／視丘／橋腦／小腦）、腦類澱粉血管病變（cerebral amyloid angiopathy，好發腦葉／皮質－皮質下）與腫瘤（原發或轉移性出血），故（A）（B）（C）皆為常見病因。（D）腦動脈瘤破裂主要造成的是蛛網膜下腔出血（SAH），並非典型的腦實質內出血，因此不屬常見病因，為本題答案。（其他較少見者尚有硬膜靜脈竇／皮質靜脈栓塞、凝血病變，罕見但重要者如硬腦膜動靜脈廔管等血管畸形。）→ [[hypertensive-hemorrhage]]
questions.author: DYT Chen (SHH)

questions.questionText: Which of the following description regarding hemangioblastoma of CNS is FALSE?

options.text: More common in the childhood than in adulthood
May be associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease
Typically appears as a hypervascular tumor in cerebral angiography
None of the above

questions.reference: Dahnert Radiology Review Manual 7th ed., pp. 295-296；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p258
questions.explanation: 答案 A。血管母細胞瘤（hemangioblastoma）超過 80% 發生於成人，好發第 3–5 個十年（約 20–50 歲、中位約 33 歲，男略多於女），兒童發生率不到 20%，因此（A）「兒童比成人常見」為錯誤敘述，即本題答案。（B）約四分之一與 von Hippel-Lindau（VHL）疾病相關，兒童病例更常見於 VHL，正確。（C）為富血管腫瘤，血管攝影典型呈明顯腫瘤染色、可見供養血管與 flow void，正確。因（A）為假，故（D）「以上皆非」不成立。→ [[hemangioblastoma]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a common cause of pulmonary hypertension?

options.text: COPD
Thromboembolism disease
Bronchopneumonia
Left-to-right shunt

questions.reference: Thoracic Imaging, 2005 ed. W. Richard Webb, Charles B. Higgins Chapter 28, Table 28-1；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p264
questions.explanation:
答案 C。肺高壓依 WHO 分為五大群：第 1 群肺動脈高壓、第 2 群左心病變、第 3 群肺病／缺氧、第 4 群慢性血栓栓塞（CTEPH）、第 5 群多因子。(A) COPD 屬第 3 群、(B) 血栓栓塞性疾病屬第 4 群、(D) 左向右分流造成肺血流增多屬第 1 群相關的常見病因，三者皆為肺高壓公認的常見成因。(C) 支氣管肺炎（bronchopneumonia）為急性肺部感染，並非造成慢性肺高壓的常見病因，故為本題要挑出的「非」常見病因者。
→ [[pulmonary-hypertension-classification]]
questions.author: Yen-Lin Huang (SHH)

imageOcr.markdown:
**Pulmonary Hypertension 分類（WHO/Nice 5群）**

**1. Pulmonary arterial hypertension**
- Idiopathic
- Heritable：BMPR2；ALK1, Endoglin；Unknown
- Drug and toxin-induced
- Associated with PAH：Connective tissue diseases；HIV infection；Portal hypertension；Congenital heart disease；Schistosomiasis；Chronic hemolytic anemia
- 1'. Pulmonary Veno-occlusive disease and/or capillary hemangiomatosis
- 1''. Persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN)

**2. Pulmonary hypertension due to left heart disease**
- Left ventricular systolic dysfunction
- Left ventricular diastolic dysfunction
- Valvular disease
- Congenital/acquired left heart inflow/outflow tract obstruction and congenital cardiomyopathy

**3. Pulmonary hypertension due to lung diseases and/or hypoxia**
- Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
- Interstitial lung disease
- Pulmonary diseases with restrictive and obstructive pattern
- Sleep-disordered breathing
- Alveolar hypoventilation disorders
- Chronic exposure to high altitude
- Developmental lung diseases

**4. Chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH)**
- Complication of pulmonary embolism
- Large or proximal vessel disorders
- High blood pressure, blood clots
- Reduced compliance and luminal narrowing

**5. Pulmonary hypertension with unclear and/or multi-factorial mechanisms**
- Hematologic disorders (myeloproliferative disorders, splenectomy)
- Systemic disorders (Vasculitis sarcoidosis, pulmonary Langerhans cell, histiocytosis LAM, neurofibromatosis)
- Metabolic disorders (Glycogen storage disease, thyroid disorders)
- Congenital heart disease
- Cancer-related, renal failure on dialysis

questions.questionText: 請問transient ischemic attack 主要風險因子有哪些?

options.text: alcohol
prior myocardial infarction
PM 2.5
all of the above

questions.reference: 8th edition radiology review manual. P.772；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p273
questions.explanation: 答案 B。依 Dähnert《Radiology Review Manual》，TIA／缺血性中風的危險因子為高血壓、心臟疾病（含先前心肌梗塞、心絞痛、瓣膜病、心律不整、心衰竭）、糖尿病與抽菸（弱相關）。選項中的 prior myocardial infarction（先前心肌梗塞）屬心臟疾病類危險因子，明確列於此清單，故為所選；alcohol 與 PM2.5 均不在 Dähnert 所列的傳統危險因子中，因此 D（all of the above）不成立。⚠️ 須注意：若採更廣的臨床流行病學觀點，酒精與空氣污染（PM2.5）亦被視為血管危險因子，該框架下答案會傾向 D；本題依清單與院內醫師裁決維持 B（以 Dähnert 為據），未更動 correctAnswer，醫師覆核時可留意此分歧。→ [[tia-stroke-risk-factors]]
questions.author: 林哲銘

imageOcr.markdown:
**TRANSIENT ISCHEMIC ATTACK**
= brief episode of transient focal neurological deficit owing to ischemia of <24 hr duration with return to pre-attack status

*Incidence:* 31 per 100,000 population per year; increasing with age up to 300; 105,000 new cases per year in United States; M > F

*Cause:*
(1) embolic：usually from ulcerative plaque at carotid bifurcation
(2) hemodynamic：fall in perfusion pressure distal to a high-grade stenosis / occlusion

*Risk factors:*
(1) Hypertension (linear increase in probability of stroke with increase in diastolic blood pressure)
(2) Cardiac disorders (prior myocardial infarction, angina pectoris, valvular heart disease, dysrhythmia, congestive heart failure)
(3) Diabetes mellitus
(4) Cigarette smoking (weak)

*Prognosis:* 5.3% stroke rate per year for 5 years after first TIA; per year 12% increase of stroke / myocardial infarction / death; complete stroke in 33% within 5 years; complete stroke in 5% in 1 month

imageOcr.markdown:
**LI-RADS® CT/MRI 時相**

**動脈期 (AP)**：在 LI-RADS 中，除非有特殊說明，動脈期指的是肝動脈期。動脈期是注射對比劑後的一段時間，有以下特點：
- 肝動脈和分支完全強化
- 肝靜脈還沒順應性的強化

**兩種亞型**：
- 動脈早期：動脈期的一種亞型，此型門靜脈還沒有強化
- 動脈晚期：動脈期的一種亞型，此型門靜脈已經強化

強烈推薦動脈晚期用於對 HCC 的診斷和分期，因為動脈晚期 HCC 強化的程度通常比動脈早期高。有一些 HCC 可表現為只在動脈晚期高頁強化。

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the incorrect classification for renal cystic lesion based on Bosniak classification?

options.text: Class 1: Benign cysts
Class 2: Minimally complicated cysts; benign
Class 3: Requires CT/MR imaging follow-up
Class 4: Malignant lesions; require surgery

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging Genitourinary (Third Edition). Pg 164；10.1148/radiol.2019182646；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p278
questions.explanation: 答案 C。需要影像追蹤（surveillance）者是 Bosniak IIF，而非 Class III；Class III 為不確定／中度惡性風險病灶（建議泌尿科會診、常需手術評估），故 C「Class 3 需 CT/MR 影像追蹤」的敘述錯誤，即為本題要選的錯誤分類。A（I 為良性單純囊腫）、B（II 為輕微複雜、良性）、D（IV 多為惡性、需手術）皆正確。→ [[bosniak-classification]]
questions.author: 姜振華

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 4: Suggested Terms and Phrases to Use When Reporting Cystic Renal Masses Using the Bosniak Classification, Version 2019**

| Classification | Suggested Terms and Phrases |
|---|---|
| Bosniak I | "Benign simple renal cyst requiring no follow-up." |
| Bosniak II | (Option 1) "Benign Bosniak II renal cyst requiring no follow-up."* (Option 2) "Likely benign Bosniak II renal mass requiring no follow-up."† |
| Bosniak IIF | "Bosniak IIF cystic renal mass. The large majority of Bosniak IIF masses are benign. When malignant, nearly all are indolent. Generally, Bosniak IIF masses are followed by imaging at 6 months and 12 months, then annually for a total of 5 years to assess for morphologic change." |
| Bosniak III | "Bosniak III cystic renal mass. Bosniak III masses have an intermediate probability of being malignant. If not already obtained, consider urology consultation." |
| Bosniak IV | "Bosniak IV cystic renal mass. The large majority of Bosniak IV masses are malignant. If not already obtained, consider urology consultation." |

Note.—This content is intended for patients in the general population and not those with a renal cell carcinoma syndrome.
*This option is best used for Bosniak II masses that have been confirmed to be cysts (eg, cysts with few thin septa).
†The Bosniak II category includes some masses that, although they are reliably considered benign, have not been definitively characterized as cysts (eg, low-attenuation lesions that are too small to characterize).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is false regarding the adrenal dynamic CT exam?

options.text: The most common protocol incorporate pre-contrast scan, initial enhanced phase (~70 second scan delay) and 30-minute delay
10-minute delay is utilized by some centers, but shorter delay may decrease sensitivity
Reason for doing dynamic phase is to calculate washout percentage to evaluate for adrenal adenoma
Adrenal washout calculators are readily available on multiple websites

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging Genitourinary (Third Edition). Pg 75；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p279
questions.explanation: 答案 A。標準腎上腺 dynamic CT washout protocol 為非顯影期＋強化期（約 60–90 秒）＋15 分鐘延遲，而非「30 分鐘延遲」，故 A 敘述錯誤、即為本題要選者。B 正確：部分中心採 10 分鐘延遲，但較短延遲可能降低敏感度；C 正確：dynamic 期用於計算 washout 百分比以評估腎上腺腺瘤（absolute washout ≥60%／relative washout ≥40%）；D 正確：多個網站提供 washout 計算器。→ [[adrenal-incidentaloma-washout]]

questions.questionText: (C) + (D) ?? Which of the following statements is CORRECT?

options.text: Pulmonary artery sling is a rare congenital anomaly in which the right pulmonary artery originates from the left pulmonary artery and encircles the left mainstem bronchus and distal trachea, causing compression
Congenital tracheal stenosis consists of a simple local narrowing of the trachea, usually in the lower third
Length of stenosis does not appear to be as critical as degree of stenosis in producing symptoms. Whereas resistance increases fourfolds relative to luminal radius decrease
Magnetic resonance (MR) imaging is valuable for demonstrating the relationship of the airway to adjacent blood vessels

questions.reference: Berrocal, T et al. Congenital Anomalies of the Tracheobronchial Tree, Lung, and Mediastinum: Embryology, Radiology, and Pathology. Radiographics, 2004;24(1).；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p280
questions.explanation: 答案 B。局灶型（focal）先天性氣管狹窄即為氣管的單純局部狹窄，通常位於下三分之一，故 B 為正確敘述。(A) 錯誤：肺動脈吊索是「左」肺動脈異常起自「右」肺動脈（非右起自左），繞行於氣管與食道之間造成壓迫，A 把左右對調。(C) 描述有瑕疵：狹窄長度確實不如狹窄程度關鍵，惟氣道阻力與狹窄「長度」僅呈線性正比、卻隨管腔半徑縮小呈四次方增加，C 略去了「與長度呈線性」的前提。(D) 本身為正確概念：MR 可不打血管內對比劑即顯示氣道與鄰近血管的關係，CT 與 MR 皆能三維重建；本題設定選單一最正確者，故為 B。⚠️ 本卡標示疑與另題高度相似（相似度 0.831），選項判讀與是否合併請一併覆核。→ [[ring-sling-syndrome]]

questions.questionText: Which of the following does not indicate malignancy in incidental pulmonary nodules depicted in chest CT?

options.text: Multiplicity of 10 or more total nodule count
Marginal speculation has odds ratio in the range of 2.2 ~ 2.5 in screen detected nodules
Solid and subsolid nodules
Solid nodules with a volume doubling time 100 ~ 400 days, subsolid nodules with a volume doubling time 3 ~ 5 years

questions.reference: Radiology: Volume 284: Number 1—July 2017；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p283
questions.explanation:
答案 A。偶見肺結節的惡性風險因子中，結節數量與惡性風險並非單調正相關：分析顯示結節數由 1 增至約 4 顆時原發癌風險上升，但達 5 顆以上反而風險下降（多源自過去肉芽腫感染）。故 (A)「總結節數達 10 顆以上」不指向惡性，為本題要選出者。其餘皆為惡性指標：(B) 邊緣毛刺（spiculation）在篩檢發現結節的勝算比約 2.2–2.5、(C) 實質與次實質（subsolid）結節本身即需警覺、(D) 實質結節倍增時間 100–400 天／次實質結節倍增時間 3–5 年，皆屬典型惡性生長速率範圍。
→ [[fleischner-pulmonary-nodule]]

options.text: Chronic subdural hematoma may appear identical

questions.reference: 書名：Osborn A. Diagnostic Imaging, Brain. Amirsys 2004 頁次：p. I:8 30-31；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p286
questions.explanation: 答案 A。硬膜下積膿（subdural empyema）在影像上呈新月形硬膜下積液，其外形與慢性硬膜下血腫可完全相同，需靠邊緣強化、DWI 與臨床病史區分，故（A）正確、為本題答案。（B）錯——積膿的膿液典型呈擴散受限（DWI 高訊號、ADC 低），且比硬膜外積膿更常見到受限，並非罕見。（C）錯——硬膜下積膿其實比硬膜外積膿／膿瘍更常見。（D）錯——成人與較大兒童多續發自副鼻竇疾病（以額竇炎為主，超過三分之二），與細菌性腦膜炎相關者主要是嬰幼兒。→ [[subdural-empyema]]

questions.questionText: Which has better clinical outcome after mechanical thrombectomy of basilar artery occlusion ?

options.text: Embolism without vertebral artery steno-occlusion
Embolism from tandem vertebral artery steno-occlusion
In situ atherosclerotic thrombosis
All of above

questions.reference: Baik SH, Park HJ, Kim JH, Jang CK, Kim BM, Kim DJ. Mechanical Thrombectomy in Subtypes of Basilar Artery Occlusion: Relationship to Recanalization Rate and Clinical Outcome. Radiology. 2019;291(3):730‐737；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p289
questions.explanation: 答案 A。依 Baik 等（Radiology 2019）依中風機轉將急性基底動脈阻塞取栓分三組，其中「栓塞且無椎動脈狹窄阻塞（embolism without VA steno-occlusion）」組的成功再通率與臨床預後最佳（成功再通約 85%、90 天 mRS 0–2 良好結局約 53%），故（A）為本題答案。（B）合併 tandem 椎動脈狹窄阻塞之栓塞、（C）原位動脈粥樣硬化血栓（再通率較低約 55%、良好結局約 20%，且常需血管成形／支架處理殘餘狹窄）預後均較差。既然三組預後有別，（D）「以上皆是」不成立。（良好結局定義 mRS 0–2、不良 3–6。）→ [[basilar-artery-occlusion]]

Low or slow-rising β-hCG levels

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2017; 37:1569–1586；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p290

questions.questionText: A 52-year-old male with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease presents with 12 hours of anuria and abdominal pain postoperative day 1 status post renal transplantation. Which of the following is the most likely explanation for the spectral waveform?

options.text: Renal artery stenosis
Renal arteriovenous fistula
Renal vein thrombosis
Normal superimposed waveforms

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging: Genitourinary；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p296
questions.explanation: 答案 B。⚠️ 存疑：本題標記正解與影像徵象疑有矛盾。移植腎動脈頻譜出現舒張期逆向血流（reversed diastolic flow）是腎靜脈血栓（renal vein thrombosis，選項 C）的典型徵象——靜脈流出受阻使下游阻力極高、致舒張期血流逆轉，亦可見於移植腎扭轉、嚴重排斥或重度 ATN；腎動脈狹窄（A）呈 tardus-parvus 低阻型態、腎動靜脈瘻管（B）多呈高速低阻的動脈化血流、正常疊加波形（D）不會出現逆向血流。就此頻譜最符合者應為 C（腎靜脈血栓），與卡片標記之 B（arteriovenous fistula）不一致，建議醫師覆核正解。→ [[renal-venous-thrombosis]]

questions.questionText: All of the following locations are relative T2 hyperintensity in health term neonates, EXCEPT? (題目應該改為T2 hypointensity)

options.text: Far lateral putamen
Posterior limb of the internal capsule
Ventrolateral thalamus
Medial globus pallidus

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2014; 34:1047–1061  (1048-1049 頁)；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p299
questions.explanation: 答案 D。（題幹應更正為 T2 hypointensity。）健康足月新生兒因早期髓鞘化，T2WI 上有幾處深部結構「總是或幾乎總是」呈相對低訊號，這是判讀 HIE 時的正常基準：內囊後肢（PLIC）與腹外側視丘總是呈低訊號、far lateral（後外側）putamen 幾乎總是呈曲線狀低訊號，故（A）（B）（C）皆為正常 T2 低訊號部位。（D）內側蒼白球（medial globus pallidus）於足月時尚未髓鞘化、訊號相對較高，並非 T2 低訊號，為本題答案（EXCEPT）；反之 medial globus pallidus 屬 T1 相對高訊號的區域。
questions.author: 王柏欽

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 1: Normal Findings on T1- and T2-weighted Images in Term Neonates**

| Imaging Finding | Anatomic Location |
|---|---|
| Relative T1 hyperintensity | Medial globus pallidus, posterior limb of the internal capsule, ventrolateral thalamus, perirolandic cortex |
| Relative T2 hypointensity | Far lateral putamen, posterior limb of the internal capsule, ventrolateral thalamus, perirolandic cortex |

questions.questionText: Renal artery stenosis is suggested after the peak systolic velocity exceeds:

options.text: 90 cm/s
135 cm/s
180 cm/s
230 cm/s

questions.reference: Sonography Exam Review: Physics, Abdomen, Obstetrics and Gynecology： Edition 2 p166；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p305
questions.explanation:
答案 C。腎動脈狹窄的都卜勒直接徵象，是狹窄處收縮期峰值流速（PSV）超過約 180 cm/s（部分文獻取 >200 cm/s 對 ≥60% 狹窄更具特異性），故 (C) 180 cm/s 為常用的起始閾值。
(A) 90 與 (B) 135 cm/s 均低於此閾值、不足以提示狹窄；(D) 230 cm/s 雖確實超過，但已高於常用的判定起點，非本題所問的「起始」閾值。
判讀時可再輔以 renal-aortic ratio >3.5、狹窄後亂流與下游葉間動脈的 tardus-parvus 波形（acceleration time >0.07 s）綜合研判。
→ [[renal-artery-stenosis]]
questions.author: 林益輝

questions.questionText: When using contrast agents, the reflectivity of small particles is dependent on the:

options.text: frequency
frame rate
imaging depth
contrast resolution

questions.reference: Sonography Exam Review: Physics, Abdomen, Obstetrics and Gynecology： Edition 2 p85；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p306
questions.explanation:
答案 A。超音波對比劑微泡的直徑約 1–8 μm，遠小於超音波波長，屬次波長（Rayleigh）散射體，其反射率／後向散射強度主要取決於「頻率（frequency）」——理想 Rayleigh 散射強度隨頻率急遽增加（約與 f⁴ 成正比），微泡又具共振頻率使此頻率相依性更明顯。
(B) frame rate、(C) imaging depth 與 (D) contrast resolution 屬成像顯示或設定參數，與小粒子本身的反射率無直接關係，故非正解。
→ [[ceus-microbubble-agents]]
questions.author: 林益輝

questions.questionText: A lipoma located in the anterior abdominal wall most commonly appears on ultrasound as a:

options.text: anechoic mass
complex mass
hyperechoic mass
hypoechoic mass

questions.reference: Sonography Exam Review: Physics, Abdomen, Obstetrics and Gynecology： Edition 2 p241；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p307
questions.explanation:
答案 D。軟組織脂肪瘤的回音表現多變，從 hypoechoic 到 hyperechoic 皆可能——相對於肌肉多呈 isoechoic 或 hyperechoic，但相對於周邊的皮下脂肪則常呈相對低回音，故腹前壁脂肪瘤在臨床上多以 hypoechoic mass 呈現，本題取 (D)。
判讀上，脂肪瘤典型為橢圓形、長軸與皮膚平行、內含與皮膚平行的線狀高回音、可壓縮且乏血流。
(A) anechoic 屬純囊性病灶表現、(B) complex mass 指囊實混合、(C) hyperechoic 雖可見但非本題腹壁脂肪瘤最常見的表現，故皆非正解。
→ [[soft-tissue-lipoma-ultrasound]]
questions.author: 林益輝

questions.questionText: Which one is not the finding of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis on US?

options.text: single wall thickness of pylorus > 3 mm
pyloric channel length > 16 mm
pyloric diameter > 15 mm
decreased blood flow

questions.reference: Diagnostic Imaging Pediatrics second edition p4-55；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p308
questions.explanation:
答案 D。本題要選「非」肥厚性幽門狹窄（HPS）超音波徵象者。
HPS 以形態學量測診斷：(A) 單層肌壁厚度 >3 mm（最準確的單一指標）、(B) 幽門管長度 >16 mm（正常上限約 15 mm）、(C) 幽門橫徑增大（約 >14 mm），皆為公認切點。
(D)「血流減少」並非診斷條件——肥厚肌層的血流可正常甚至增加，故此項不是 HPS 的判讀徵象。
臨床背景為 2–8 週男嬰、非膽汁性噴射狀嘔吐，動態掃描可見胃內容物無法通過固定不開的幽門管。
→ [[pyloric-stenosis]]
questions.author: 鄧惠中

questions.questionText: Which one is not the typical finding of uterine adenomyosis on US?

options.text: tiny cysts and cystic striations
increased vascularity
distinct border
heterogenous echotexture with nodules and striations

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2018; 38:p1586；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p309
questions.explanation:
答案 C。本題要選「非」子宮腺肌症（adenomyosis）典型超音波徵象者。
腺肌症本質是異位子宮內膜浸潤肌層的病變，邊界不清（ill-defined），故 (C)「邊界清楚（distinct border）」並非其典型表現——邊界清楚的圓形腫塊反而應想 leiomyoma。
其餘皆為典型腺肌症 US 表現：(A) 肌層內微小囊泡與囊狀條紋；(B) 血流增加（迂曲血管穿入肌層）；(D) 異質回音伴結節與條紋，呈 Venetian blind（百葉窗）/rain-shower 樣平行聲影。
→ [[adenomyosis-mri]]
questions.author: 鄧惠中

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about tuberculous peritonitis is incorrect?

options.text: Risk factors for abdominal TB include cirrhosis, HIV infection, diabetes mellitus, malignancy, and use of peritoneal dialysis
The most common forms include involvement of the peritoneum, intestine, and/or liver
Intestinal TB most commonly demonstrates concentric mural thickening in the ileoceal region
Lymphadenopathy usually demonstrates homogeneous solid centers over the mesentery and retroperitoneum

questions.reference: UpToDate. Abdominal tuberculosis. Oct 25, 2019；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p323
questions.explanation: 答案 D。結核性淋巴結腫的典型表現為低衰減、中央乾酪化壞死（可逐漸囊變），淋巴結彼此糾結而周圍發炎變化輕微，並非如選項 D 所述之「均質實心中心（homogeneous solid centers）」，故 D 為錯誤敘述（正解）。其餘皆正確：腹腔結核的危險因子確含肝硬化、HIV 感染、糖尿病、惡性腫瘤與腹膜透析（A）；最常見的侵犯型態為腹膜、腸道與/或肝臟（B）；腸道結核以迴盲部環周壁增厚最為常見（C）。→ [[gi-infection-location-pattern]]
questions.author: 江佳陵

questions.questionText: 有關Intraductal papillary neoplasm of the bile ducts, 以下敘述, 何者不正確 ?

options.text: 又稱為 Biliary papillomatosis
可以分泌多量mucinous, 造成膽到阻塞
很少有惡性化的機會, 也很少復發, 預後很好
MRCP, CT可以提供好的診斷
通常是多發性的

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2008; 28:2059–2063；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p324
questions.explanation: 答案 C。IPNB 為膽管的侵襲前（preinvasive）乳頭狀腫瘤、具高度惡性潛能（可進展為侵襲性乳頭狀膽管癌），復發率高（依是否含侵襲成分約 20–60%），並非如選項 C 所述「很少惡性化、也很少復發、預後很好」，故 C 為錯誤敘述（正解）。其餘皆正確：diffuse 型又稱 biliary papillomatosis（A）；可分泌大量黏液造成膽道阻塞（B）；MRCP、CT 可提供良好診斷（D）；通常為多發性（E）。→ [[cholangiocarcinoma-precursors]]
questions.author: 黃哲勳

questions.questionText: What is the HRCT features of CTD-ILD?

options.text: Straight-edge sign
Multi-layers honeycombing
Posterior upper lobe sign
All are correct

questions.reference: Chung JH et al. AJR Am J Roentgenol 2018;210:307-313；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p325
questions.explanation:
答案 A。straight-edge sign（纖維化侷限於肺基底、在冠狀面上下界銳利、不沿肺外側緣往上延伸）是 CTD 相關 UIP 相對於 IPF 較常出現的三大反常徵象之一，故 (A) 為 CTD-ILD 的 HRCT 特徵。(B)「multi-layers honeycombing」用詞有誤——CTD 的特徵是 exuberant honeycombing（蜂窩佔纖維化區 >70%），並非「多層蜂窩」；(C)「posterior upper lobe sign」方向相反，正確者為 anterior upper lobe sign（纖維化集中於上葉前段並合併下肺侵犯）。因 B、C 敘述皆不正確，故 (D)「以上皆對」不成立，正解為 (A)。
→ [[ctd-ild]]
questions.author: 吳銘庭

questions.questionText: What is NOT in the 2018 HRCT category of UIP?

options.text: Possible UIP
Indeterminate for UIP
Alternative diagnosis
All are correct and included

questions.reference: AJRCCM 2018 (Sept); 198 (5): e44-68；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p327
questions.explanation:
答案 A。2018 年 ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT 指引將 UIP 的 HRCT 分為四類：UIP（definite）、probable UIP、indeterminate for UIP、alternative diagnosis。相較 2011 年版本，最大改變是取消「possible UIP」、以「probable UIP」取代（因研究顯示這群病人縱使影像無蜂窩，多數病理仍為 UIP）。因此 (A) possible UIP 已不在 2018 分類中，為本題要選出者。(B) indeterminate for UIP 與 (C) alternative diagnosis 皆為 2018 四分類的正式項目，故 (D)「全部都對且包含」不成立。
→ [[ipf]]
questions.author: 吳銘庭

options.text: IVC
SVC
Right atrium
Aorta

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements comparing CMR with other noninvasive imaging technologies is correct?

options.text: Clinical CMR can image the coronary arteries with superior spatial resolution compared with 64-detector MDCT
Clinical CMR cine functional imaging has higher temporal resolution than M-mode echocardiography
CMR is better than transthoracic echocardiography in assessing valvular structure
Flow measurements by CMR are more reliable than those from transthoracic echocardiography in assessing calcific aortic valvular stenosis
Flow measurements by CMR are more reliable than those from transthoracic echocardiography in assessing aortic valvular insufficiency

questions.reference: Peter G. Danias. Cardiovascular MRI: 150 multiple-Choice Questions and Answers © Humana Press 2008；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p331
questions.explanation: 答案 E。相位對比（phase-contrast）CMR 可直接量測主動脈瓣的逆流量與逆流分率，對主動脈瓣「逆流」的定量比經胸超音波（TTE）更可靠，故 E 正確。A 錯：臨床 CMR 對冠狀動脈的空間解析度不及 64 切 MDCT，冠狀動脈評估整體遜於心臟 CT。B 錯：時間解析度以 M-mode 超音波最高，CMR cine 功能造影並未超過。C 錯：評估瓣膜「結構」上 TTE 仍相當好，非 CMR 強項。D 錯：主動脈瓣「狹窄」的高速噴流易 aliasing，CMR 流量量測於狹窄反而較不可靠，逆流才是其強項。→ [[coronary-mra-technique]]

questions.questionText: For which of the following applications CMR is not the gold standard?

options.text: Evaluation of anomalous coronary arteries
Assessment of infracted myocardium
Measurement of left ventricular ejection fraction
Measurement of right ventricular end-diastolic volume
Assessment of coronary atherosclerosis

questions.reference: Peter G. Danias. Cardiovascular MRI: 150 multiple-Choice Questions and Answers © Humana Press 2008；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p332

questions.questionText: A solitary coronary calcification spot was found over LAD on LDCT of lung cancer screen of a 50 y/o woman

options.text: It is quite common
Should control the risk factors of CAD, if any
The CAC burden is low for the age and sex
All are correct

questions.reference: JACC Cardiovasc Imaging. Mouaz H. Al-Mallah M. Coronary Artery Calcium Scoring. 2018.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p334
questions.explanation: 答案 B。冠狀動脈只要出現任何鈣化（CAC>0），即代表已存在動脈粥狀硬化，故應積極矯正可控制的 CAD 危險因子，B 正確。A（很常見）與 C（以此年齡性別而言鈣化負擔偏低）都必須有實際 Agatston 分數與 MESA 百分位才能判定，單憑「一顆鈣化點」資訊不足，均無法成立；D 因 A、C 不成立而錯。（⚠️ 本題含影像，官方詳解 PDF 第 334 頁，影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。）→ [[calcium-score]]
questions.author: 吳銘庭

imageOcr.markdown: Wu MT, Yang P, Huang YL, Chen JS, et al. Coronary Arterial Calcification on Low-Dose Ungated MDCT for Lung Cancer Screening: Concordance Study with Dedicated Cardiac CT. AJR Am J Roentgenol. April 2008;190(4)（Cardiac Imaging – Original Research）.

questions.questionText: For a 43 y/o man, progressive dyspnea on exertion and jaw pain

options.text: If CAC = 0, power of zero, low risk of MACE
If CAC = 0, should consider coronary CTA
Must check ASCVD 10-year risk and decide coronary CTA or not
All correct

questions.reference: Ahmadi A. et al JCCT 2020; 14: 394；10.1161/CIRCULATIONAHA.108.767665；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p336
questions.explanation: 答案 B。此 43 歲男性有運動性呼吸困難加下巴痛（心絞痛等價症狀），屬「症狀性、驗前機率中至高」族群；依條件機率，「power of zero」只適用於無症狀低風險者。A 錯：此族群即使 CAC=0 仍約 16% 於誘發性檢查出現心肌缺血、近期冠狀事件風險約為無症狀族群的 9 倍，不能視為低風險。C 錯：症狀本身即為進一步冠狀動脈評估的理由，不應僅以 ASCVD 10 年風險決定是否影像檢查。D 因含 A、C 而錯。正解 B：即使 CAC=0 也應考慮 coronary CTA。（⚠️ 本題含影像，官方詳解 PDF 第 336 頁，影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。）→ [[calcium-score]]

questions.questionText: An MRI appearance of homogeneous low T1-and T2-weighted signal with enhancement is MOST typical of which foot and ankle mass?

options.text: Morton's neuroma
Lipoma
Ganglion cyst
Plantar fibromatosis
Hemangioma

questions.reference: American Journal of Roentgenology. 2008;190: S18-S22. 10.2214/AJR.07.7023；10.2214/AJR.07.7023；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p338
questions.explanation:
答案 D。均勻低 T1 且低 T2、並會強化的訊號組合，最典型為足底纖維瘤病（plantar fibromatosis）等纖維性腫塊，因含成熟膠原之故。其餘訊號組合皆不符：A Morton 神經瘤 T1 與肌肉等訊號、T2 低訊號、強化程度不一；B 脂肪瘤 T1/T2 皆高訊號、脂肪抑制序列變低；C 腱鞘囊腫 T1 低、T2 高，通常僅薄邊環狀強化；E 血管瘤含血管/脂肪/纖維而呈混雜訊號。
→ [[foot-ankle-soft-tissue-masses]]
questions.author: 蔡孟原

questions.questionText: Regarding red bone marrow, which of the following is TRUE?

options.text: Red marrow can be focal and mass-like
Red marrow reconversion always progresses in a consistent, predictable pattern
Red marrow in adults typically persists in the hands and feet
Red marrow does not contain fat cells
Red marrow is easily differentiated from neoplasm on MRI

questions.reference: American Journal of Roentgenology. 2009;193: S5-S9. 10.2214/AJR.07.7088；10.2214/AJR.07.7088；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p341
questions.explanation:
答案 A。此題問「何者為真」。A 正確：正常紅骨髓有多種正常型態，包含平滑瀰漫、局灶腫塊樣以及細點狀分布，故可呈局灶且似腫塊。B 錯：紅骨髓 reconversion（黃轉紅）不一定循固定可預測的型態；C 錯：成人手腳末端為成熟黃骨髓，紅骨髓通常不存留於此；D 錯：紅骨髓含造血細胞、水與脂肪細胞（約 40% 脂肪），並非不含脂肪；E 錯：因位置不定且可呈腫塊樣，紅骨髓與腫瘤常不易區分。
→ [[bone-marrow]]
questions.author: 蔡孟原

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about axillary web syndrome of the breast is incorrect?

options.text: Common after axillary surgery, frequently affecting breast cancer patients
Patients usually present with one or more palpable or visible firm linear bands
Ultrasound usually demonstrates a non-compressible thrombosed superficial vein
MRI shows the cords were visible as low signal subcutaneous linear bands or dots

questions.reference: Breast J. 2021 Jan;27(1):44-47.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p347
questions.explanation: 答案 無正解。本題官方詳解記為「以上皆對」，故無單一正確之錯誤選項。（A）對：AWS 常見於腋部手術後、好發乳癌病患（ALND > SLNB）。（B）對：典型表現即為腋下至上臂出現一條或多條可觸/可見的緊繃線狀索帶（cords），伴疼痛與肩臂活動受限，此為本病經典描述。（D）對：MRI 呈低訊號的皮下線狀帶或點狀。（C）措辭可議：AWS 病生理以「淋巴管索化」為主、常合併淺靜脈受累，將 US 所見一律描述為「非可壓縮之血栓化淺靜脈」過度簡化（有高頻超音波研究無法辨識出特定索狀結構，顯示 AWS 並非單純血栓化淺靜脈）。⚠️ 存疑：官方標準答案原標為 B（視為錯誤），但其詳解卻自寫「以上皆對」自相矛盾，且所引 Mullen & Harvey（Eur J Radiol 2019）明載 B 之敘述為正確；若須挑一最可議者應為 C 而非 B。建議對照原卷，維持「無正解」不更動。
questions.author: 周春平

questions.questionText: 關於Mammography audit, 以下何者為非？

options.text: 在Screening mammography, category 3亦屬於陽性判讀結果
在diagnostic mammography, category 3屬於陰性判讀結果
Screening mammography的"recall" rate為(category,0,4,5之和)/(總檢 查數)
PPV2為(真陽性之數目)/(建議切片之數目)。

questions.reference: ACR BI-RADS® atlas (2013). Follow-up and Outcome monitoring page13-20.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p349

答案 E。胸部放療的晚期併發症之一是放射線誘發的續發惡性腫瘤，已報告者包括 (A) 肉瘤、(B) 乳癌、(C) 肺癌；而 (D) 間皮瘤的致病因子除石綿外，放射線暴露亦為公認因素之一（官方另提食道癌亦有報告）。由於四個具體選項皆屬已報告的放射線誘發胸部惡性腫瘤，沒有任何一項可被排除，故「何者不是」的答案為 (E) 以上皆非。判讀上，續發惡性多潛伏數年至數十年、出現於或鄰近舊照射野並隨追蹤逐漸增大，可藉此與治療野內短期的預期放射性變化區分。

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 2: Post–Radiation Therapy Complications**

| Anatomic Site | Early Complication(s) | Late Complication(s)* |
|---|---|---|
| Lungs | Infection, organizing pneumonia | Tumor recurrence |
| Pleura | Pleural effusion | … |
| Heart | Pericardial effusion | CAD, valvular disease, chronic pericarditis, cardiomyopathy |
| Great vessels | Vascular stenosis | Vascular wall calcifications, vascular occlusion and pseudoaneurysms |
| Thymus | Simple cysts | … |
| Lymph nodes | … | Calcified lymph nodes, fibrotic mass |
| Esophagus | Ulceration, esophageal dismotility related to acute radiation-induced esophagitis, perforation, fistula (rare) | Stricture, ulceration, perforation, or fistula formation |
| Liver | Focal hepatitis | Atrophic liver changes |
| Breast | Diffuse skin thickening | Fat necrosis and dystrophic calcifications, skin retraction, radiation-induced breast cancer |
| Bones | Bone edema and osteopenia | Pathologic bone fractures, osteochondromas, osteoradionecrosis, and radiation-induced bone malignancy |

*Late complications can also include radiation-induced thoracic malignancies, including sarcoma and breast and lung cancers. CAD = coronary artery disease.

**TEACHING POINTS**
- When the intent in treating the primary malignancy is curative, the goal in performing radiation therapy is to deliver a therapeutic radiation dose to the target tissue in a precise and accurate manner while minimizing the radiation delivered to surrounding normal structures.
- Pulmonary opacities due to radiation damage are usually confined to the radiation portal, as radiation pneumonitis outside the radiation field is extremely rare.
- During the first few months after radiation therapy, there is diffuse FDG uptake in the area of radiation pneumonitis. Owing to this uptake, the sensitivity of FDG PET for the detection of any residual FDG-avid tumor in the radiation field, while the inflammation is still active, is decreased. Therefore, it is best to perform FDG PET at least 6 months after the completion of radiation therapy.
- To correctly interpret chest imaging findings after thoracic irradiation, the radiologist must be familiar with the newer radiation delivery techniques, the date of the last radiation therapy delivery, the treatment dose, and the treatment field. This information helps in distinguishing radiation-induced changes from infection or malignancy progression.
- Direct radiation damage to the heart may affect the coronary arteries, valves, pericardium, and/or myocardium. These cardiac effects are associated with increased mortality and may take their toll years after the radiation therapy; thus, they are usually seen in long-term survivors whose mediastinum was irradiated when they were younger.

questions.questionText: Which one is wrong about tracheobronchial injuries?

options.text: Penetrating injuries such as stabbings are more commonly found in the anterior cervical trachea
Iatrogenic injuries such as those related to bronchoscopic procedures most commonly affect the cervical and proximal intrathoracic trachea, especially the less protected posterior membrane
Endotracheal intubation usually causes direct lacerations rather than cuff-related injuries
Surgery is usually performed in lacerations greater than 2–4 cm, especially when there is involvement of the cartilage

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2020; 40:515–528 Imaging Evaluation of Tracheobronchial Injuries；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p356
questions.explanation: 答案 C（此題問「錯誤」敘述）。C 為錯誤：氣管內插管造成的損傷「主要是氣囊（cuff）相關」而非直接撕裂——cuff 過度充氣時，CT 或胸片可見氣囊直徑相對鄰近氣管異常增寬，選項把因果反述故錯。其餘皆正確：A，穿刺傷（如刺傷）因位置較外露，好發於前段頸部氣管；B，支氣管鏡等醫源性損傷好發於頸部與近端胸內氣管，尤其防護較差的後膜部；D，撕裂 >2–4 cm、特別是累及軟骨時通常需手術修補。（⚠️ 本題含影像，官方詳解 PDF 第 356 頁，影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。）→ [[chest-trauma-imaging]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**
- The precise site of injury is frequently subtle or occult at imaging, even in the presence of other suggestive imaging features such as pneumomediastinum, pneumothorax, or deep cervical subcutaneous emphysema.
- Penetrating injuries such as stabbings are more commonly found in the anterior cervical trachea because of its relatively exposed position. Iatrogenic injuries such as those related to bronchoscopic procedures most commonly affect the cervical and proximal intrathoracic trachea, especially the less protected posterior membrane. High-impact blunt force injuries tend to involve the intrathoracic distal trachea near the carina, with a slight preponderance of right-sided involvement.
- Endotracheal intubation usually causes cuff-related injuries rather than direct lacerations. Cuff overinflation can be depicted at CT or radiography by a discrepancy in cuff diameter relative to the adjacent trachea.

- Surgery is usually performed in lacerations greater than 2–4 cm, especially when there is involvement of the cartilage. Surgery may also be performed in patients with worsening pneumomediastinum, subcutaneous emphysema, or pneumothorax or with a lung that fails to re-expand despite drain placement. Mediastinal sepsis and proximity of the injury to the carina have also been proposed as indications for surgery. Emergency surgery is required where there is failure to ventilate or if there is esophageal herniation through the tracheal defect, which may be visualized at CT.
- In more borderline cases with lacerations measuring 1.5–2 cm or less, there is increasing momentum behind nonsurgical management options. These include rigid and flexible bronchoscopic application of synthetic adhesives (fibrin- or cyanoacrylate-based), which may be considered in injuries smaller than 5 mm, and covered metallic or silicone stent placement, both of which have shown promising results in specialist units.

questions.explanation: 答案 D。含碘對比劑與甲狀腺攝碘會互相干擾，故接受甲狀腺放射碘影像／治療者，含碘對比劑之投予須與其間隔一段時間（注射對比劑後兩個月內應避免甲狀腺核醫同位素掃瞄；放射碘-131 治療前兩個月內最好未曾使用對比劑，若必要則使用後約 4 週再治療），D 正確。A 錯：並非對所有甲亢者常規限制含碘對比劑，須留意者主要為未治療的 Graves' disease 或甲狀腺自主性結節等高風險族群，且多數反應可自行緩解。B 錯：類固醇前處置是為預防過敏型不良反應，非針對甲狀腺功能。⚠️ 存疑：C（急性甲狀腺風暴時應避免含碘對比劑）臨床上亦屬合理，本題以 D 為官方最明確之單一正解。（⚠️ 本題含影像，官方詳解 PDF 第 361 頁，影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。）→ [[iodinated-contrast-media]]

imageOcr.markdown:
**A4.4 晚期全身性不良反應 [20]**
- 含碘對比劑之晚期全身性不良反應為甲狀腺機能亢進 [20, 21]。
- 有甲狀腺機能亢進之受檢者應盡量避免使用含碘對比劑 [20]。
- 晚期全身性不良反應可發生於任何種類之含碘對比劑注射，通常可自行緩解 [21]。
- 部分有風險因子之受檢者，可能於靜脈注射含碘對比劑後 6 至 8 周發生甲狀腺機能亢進 [21]。

風險因子分類：

| 風險因子 ᵃ | 非風險因子 |
|---|---|
| 未治療之 Graves' disease；甲狀腺多結節腺腫或甲狀腺 autonomy，特別是年長或居住區之食用碘缺乏 | 甲狀腺功能正常 [20] |

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about transcatheter mitral valve replacement?

options.text: The size of mitral orifice area of < 1 cm2 is a favorable anatomic character
Rheumatic mitral disease is a contraindication of the procedure
The mobile leaflet length of > 1 cm in a contraindication of the procedure
Left ventricle outflow tract (LVOT) obstruction is a minor complication of the procedure and is defined as a LVOT gradient increase of 50 mmHg or more

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2020; 40:1528–1553；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p362
questions.explanation: 答案 B。依 RadioGraphics 的 MitraClip Table 1，風濕性二尖瓣疾病與瓣葉鈣化屬禁忌，故 B 正確。A 錯：有利解剖為二尖瓣口面積 >4 cm²（非 <1 cm²）。C 錯：可動瓣葉長 >1 cm 是「有利」解剖，非禁忌。D 錯：LVOT 阻塞是 TMVR 最嚴重的「重大」併發症（非次要），定義為術後 LVOT 壓差上升 ≥10 mmHg（非 50 mmHg）。（⚠️ 本題含影像，官方詳解 PDF 第 362 頁，影像尚未匯入，判讀請對照原檔。）→ [[transcatheter-mitral-valve-replacement]]
questions.author: 陳俊谷

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**
- CT can help provide information on the morphology and function of the mitral valve that is complementary to findings at echocardiography. CT adds excellent incremental value to performing echocardiography alone in guiding device sizing and procedural planning.
- Owing to the difficulty in reconstructing the true complex shape of the mitral annulus, a simplified D-shaped annulus is more reproducible for device sizing.
- CT is used to estimate the size of the anticipated neo-LVOT, thus allowing prediction of potential obstruction. CT can simulate a virtual prosthesis, a 3D model that matches the shape and dimensions of a specific TMVR prosthesis.
- The risk of neo-LVOT obstruction is higher with greater flaring, protrusion, and skirt size of the device.
- LVOT obstruction is the most dreaded complication of TMVR, defined as a postprocedural LVOT gradient increase of 10 mm Hg or more.

**Table 1: Favorable Anatomy and Contraindications for Transcatheter Mitral Valve Repair with MitraClip**

Favorable anatomy:
- Pathologic condition at A2–P2 cusps
- Coaptation depth, <1 mm
- Coaptation length, >2 mm
- Flail gap, <10 mm
- Flail width, <15 mm
- Mitral orifice area, >4 cm²
- Mobile leaflet length, >1 cm

Contraindications:
- Rheumatic mitral disease
- Mitral leaflet calcifications

Source.—Reference 4.

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**
- Radiologists encounter two main types of CA in clinical settings: immunoglobulin light-chain amyloidosis (AL) and transthyretin amyloidosis (ATTR). ATTR can be subdivided into two types according to genetic mutation status: hereditary or mutant type (ATTRm) and wild type (ATTRwt).
- Radiologists should be familiar with the following key clinical points regarding CA: (a) Many patients with heart failure, particularly those with HFpEF, also have "hidden" CA. (b) Most patients with CA remain undiagnosed and do not receive appropriate treatment. (c) CA generally is associated with a poor prognosis, especially for patients with advanced heart failure. (d) Early diagnosis and an intervention based on effective therapies are important factors in prognostic improvement. (e) Advanced diagnostic imaging can facilitate the early diagnosis of CA.

- The important cardiac manifestations of CA include increased left ventricular (LV) thickening, HFpEF, atrial fibrillation, bundle branch block, and complete heart block. Extracardiac symptoms that should also increase suspicion regarding CA include bilateral carpal tunnel syndrome, spinal canal stenosis, rotator cuff tear, peripheral and autonomic neuropathy, proteinuria, chronic diarrhea, weight loss, macroglossia, periorbital purpura, and jaw claudication.
- In CA, the typical LGE pattern involves global subendocardial LGE distributed in a non–coronary artery territory with a dark blood pool.
- When differentiating patients with ATTR (including ATTRm and ATTRwt) from those with AL or nonamyloid heart failure, the cardiac uptake of radiotracers such as technetium 99m (99mTc) pyrophosphate (99mTc-PYP), 99mTc–3,3-diphosphono-1,2-propanodicarboxylic acid (99mTc-DPD), and 99mTc–hydroxymethylene diphosphonate at bone scintigraphy has high diagnostic performance.
