questions.explanation: 答案 B。腹股溝疝（inguinal hernia）為最常見的腹壁疝，股疝（femoral hernia）遠比腹股溝疝少見（且股疝好發於女性、嵌頓絞扼風險較高），故選項 B「股疝比腹股溝疝常見」為錯誤敘述（正解）。其餘皆正確：腹股溝疝為最常見型別（A）；臍疝特別好發於女性（C）；造口旁疝（parastomal hernia）屬切口疝（incisional hernia）的一種亞型（D）。→ [[groin-hernia]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總邱乃祈醫師

questions.questionText: What is “double contrast” GI images?

options.text: Air
Barium
Water
Air + Barium

questions.reference: Double contrast Gastrointestinal Radiology. 1999；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p370
questions.author: 臺北榮總邱乃祈醫師

questions.questionText: 肝臟的淋巴迴流，可分為superficial pathway與deep pathway，請問 以下lymph node station 何者不屬於主要的deep pathway?

options.text: Celiac nodes
Hepatic hilar nodes
Juxtaphrenic nodes
lateral diaphragmatic nodes

questions.reference: Meyers' Dynamic Radiology of the Abdomen, p.230-231；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p371
questions.explanation: 答案 D。肝臟深層淋巴引流沿門脈三合體上行至肝門（hepatic hilar）淋巴結、再沿肝動脈到達 celiac 淋巴結，另一支沿肝靜脈繞下腔靜脈穿橫膈至 juxtaphrenic（腔靜脈旁）／後縱膈，故 celiac（A）、hepatic hilar（B）、juxtaphrenic（C）皆屬深層引流主幹的節站；lateral diaphragmatic（橫膈外側，D）淋巴結引流橫膈本身、屬橫膈表面／淺層系統，並非深層主幹的主要節站，故為正解。→ [[hepatic-lymphatic-drainage]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總邱乃祈醫師

questions.questionText: Which of the following about hemorrhagic ovarian cysts is WRONG?

options.text: A hemorrhagic ovarian cyst often involves a corpus luteum cyst rather than a follicular cyst
Rupture may be associated with sexual intercourse, trauma, and pregnancy
CT Hounsfield units (HU) is not applicable to differentiate hemorrhagic ovarian cyst rupture with hemoperitoneum

The MR imaging can be variable, depending on the age of the hemorrhage, with hyperintensity on both T1- and T2-weighted images or hyperintensity on T1-weighted images and hypointensity on T2-weighted images

questions.reference: Iraha Y, et al. CT and MR Imaging of Gynecologic Emergencies. Radiographics 2017; 37:1569–1586.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p373
questions.explanation: 答案 C。CT 的 Hounsfield unit 確實可用於偵測與鑑別出血性卵巢囊腫破裂與腹腔積血——囊內出血呈高衰減（未凝血約 30–45 HU、凝血塊 45–70 HU、水樣液體 0–15 HU），破裂後 hemoperitoneum 呈高衰減腹水並可見 hematocrit level／sentinel clot，故選項 C「CT HU 不適用於鑑別」為錯誤敘述（正解）。其餘皆正確：出血性囊腫多源自黃體（corpus luteum）而非濾泡囊腫（A）；破裂可與性交、外傷、懷孕相關（B）；MR 表現隨出血時期而異，可 T1、T2 皆呈高訊號，或 T1 高、T2 低訊號（D）。→ [[ovarian-mass-benign-vs-malignant]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總陳蓉宣醫師

questions.questionText: Which of the following about gynecologic emergencies is WRONG?

options.text: Ectopic pregnancies occur when the blastocyst implants outside the endometrium of the uterus
Ninety-five percent of ectopic pregnancies are tubal, and most commonly occur in the ampulla of the fallopian tube
Torsion of a normal ovary is a rare entity that predominantly occurs in perimenarchal girls or during pregnancy
Contralateral uterine deviation due to a shortened adnexal ligament is a direct finding of ovarian torsion

questions.reference: Iraha Y, et al. CT and MR Imaging of Gynecologic Emergencies. Radiographics 2017; 37:1569–1586.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p374
questions.explanation: 答案 D。卵巢扭轉時因附件血管蒂縮短，子宮會偏向「同側（ipsilateral）」扭轉側，而非選項 D 所述之對側（contralateral），故 D 為錯誤敘述（正解）。其餘皆正確：子宮外孕為胚囊著床於子宮內膜腔以外（A）；約 95% 為輸卵管妊娠且最常見於壺腹部（ampulla，B）；正常卵巢的扭轉罕見，好發於初經前女孩或孕期（C）。→ [[adnexal-torsion]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總陳蓉宣醫師

questions.questionText: Which of the following about ovarian neoplasms is WRONG?

options.text: Four categories by histopathologic features into germ cell tumors, sex cord–stromal tumors, epithelial surface cell tumors, and metastases
Germ cell tumors are the most common category of ovarian neoplasms
Serous ovarian neoplasms are often unilocular and bilateral. Mucinous ovarian neoplasms are often larger, unilateral, and multilocular
Endometrioid and clear cell carcinomas can arise within endometriomas and are both associated with Lynch syndrome

questions.reference: Taylor E, et al. Multimodality Imaging Approach to Ovarian Neoplasms with Pathologic Correlation. Radiographics 2021; 41:289-315.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p375
questions.explanation: 答案 B。卵巢腫瘤中最常見的大類為上皮性腫瘤（epithelial surface cell tumors，約占 60–70%），其次才是生殖細胞腫瘤（germ cell，約 20%），故選項 B「germ cell 為最常見大類」為錯誤敘述（正解）。其餘皆正確：依組織病理可分為生殖細胞、性索間質、上皮性與轉移四大類（A）；漿液性腫瘤常為單房且雙側、黏液性腫瘤常較大、單側且多房（C）；子宮內膜樣癌與透明細胞癌皆可源自子宮內膜異位瘤，並與 Lynch 症候群相關（D）。→ [[ovarian-tumors-imaging]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總陳蓉宣醫師

imageOcr.markdown:
- Both endometrioid and clear cell carcinomas are associated with Lynch syndrome, which is often accompanied by synchronous endometrial carcinoma. Both subtypes are also highly associated with endometriosis.
- There are characteristic imaging findings of mature teratomas owing to the presence of sebaceous material or fat, hair, teeth (calcification), bone, or cartilage. At MRI, the fatty component of the mass demonstrates high T1 and T2 signal intensity with loss of signal intensity at fat-suppressed MR imaging. The T1-weighted fat-saturated sequence is crucial in distinguishing fat signal intensity from hemorrhage (which remains T1 hyperintense).

**TEACHING POINTS**
- Imaging features that suggest a borderline or malignant tumor include mural nodules, papillary projections, enhancing solid (nonfatty, nonfibrous) components, and thickened walls and septa (greater than 3 mm), particularly when vascularized.
- At imaging, serous cystadenomas most often manifest as a simple unilocular cyst with an absence of solid components, thickened septa, or mural nodularity, although some may have a few locules separated by thin septa.
- Mucinous tumors manifest as a predominantly cystic, multilocular unilateral mass, often with varying signal intensity, attenuation, and echogenicity of the mucin-containing cysts at MRI, CT, and US, respectively.

questions.questionText: Which of the following about tumor thrombus is WRONG?

options.text: Bland thrombus is more expansive than tumor thrombus and may demonstrate enhancement
Tumor types most commonly associated with invasion of the inferior vena cava (IVC) are renal cell carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and primary leiomyosarcoma of the IVC
Urothelial carcinoma–associated tumor thrombus is rarely reported, being helpful in differentiating with renal cell carcinoma
Venous invasion tend to occurs in renal cell carcinoma and more likely in larger tumors

questions.reference: LeGout J, et al. Multimodality Imaging of Abdominopelvic Tumors with Venous Invasion. Radiographics 2020; 40:2098-2116.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p376
questions.explanation: 答案 A。實際上是腫瘤栓（tumor thrombus）較單純血栓（bland thrombus）更為膨脹、會強化（栓內強化為最具特異性之徵象），且可與原發腫塊訊號相似並與之相連（contiguity）；選項 A 將方向顛倒，稱「bland thrombus 較膨脹且會強化」，故為錯誤敘述（正解）。其餘皆正確：最常侵犯下腔靜脈的腫瘤為腎細胞癌、肝細胞癌、腎上腺皮質癌與原發性 IVC 平滑肌肉瘤（B）；泌尿上皮癌相關腫瘤栓罕見，有助與腎細胞癌鑑別（C）；靜脈侵犯好發於腎細胞癌且腫瘤越大越易發生（D）。→ [[renal-cell-carcinoma]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總陳蓉宣醫師

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**

- At imaging, tumor thrombus is more expansive than bland thrombus, demonstrates enhancement, and may have imaging features similar to those of the primary malignancy. Another helpful indicator of tumor thrombus is contiguity with the primary mass.
- Tumor types most commonly associated with invasion of the IVC are RCC, HCC, adrenocortical carcinoma, and primary leiomyosarcoma of the IVC.
- The growth pattern of ICC with respect to the veins is typically more encasement with narrowing or occlusion rather than venous invasion with tumor thrombus. Some studies have reported the presence of macrovascular portal tumor thrombus in up to 15%–20% of cases of ICC, suggesting that tumor in vein may be an overlooked feature.

- PNETs most commonly invade the splenic vein but can also extend into or separately involve the superior mesenteric or main portal vein or uncommonly smaller branch veins, depending on the location of the primary tumor. Tumor thrombus can be extensive, resulting in significant venous hypertension and venous collateral formation, including formation of gastric varices.
- At US of the iliac or femoral veins, an overly expansive thrombus or a thrombus that deforms or extends beyond the vessel wall should raise suspicion for venous leiomyosarcoma and prompt careful Doppler interrogation for internal flow or further characterization with multiphase CT or MRI.

questions.questionText: Which of the following about renal tumor is WRONG?

options.text: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) represents more than 90% of all renal malignancies and has a well-known propensity for tumor thrombus formation
Papillary subtype is the most common subtype of RCC
In TNM staging for RCC in AJCC, T3a when confined to the renal vein
Angiomyolipoma is the most common benign solid renal tumor

questions.reference: LeGout J, et al. Multimodality Imaging of Abdominopelvic Tumors with Venous Invasion. Radiographics 2020; 40:2098-2116.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p378
questions.explanation: 答案 B。最常見的 RCC 亞型為 clear cell（透明細胞型，約占 70%），也是最常伴隨腫瘤栓者；papillary（乳頭狀）約 10–20% 居次，故選項 B「papillary 為最常見亞型」為錯誤敘述（正解）。其餘皆正確：RCC 占腎臟惡性腫瘤逾 90% 且好發形成腫瘤栓（A）；AJCC 分期中腫瘤局限於腎靜脈時為 T3a（C）；血管肌脂瘤（angiomyolipoma）為最常見的良性實質腎腫瘤（D）。→ [[renal-cell-carcinoma]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總陳蓉宣醫師

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements about giant cell tumor (GCT) of bone is incorrect?

options.text: The prevalence of GCT peaks in the middle-aged adult, less commonly in elderly and rarely in children
Most lesions develop in long bones, with the majority of cases occurring about the knee
The typical appearance of GCT on conventional radiographs shows a lytic lesion that has a well-defined but nonsclerotic margin, eccentric in location, and extends to the subchondral bone
Secondary aneurysmal bone cyst (ABC) formation occurs in up to 50% of cases of GCT of bone, telangiectatic osteosarcoma should be included in the differential diagnosis
The drug denosumab targets the RANK pathway and stops the osteoclastic activity of cells in GCT, thus can be used to treat GCT

questions.reference: Chakarun CJ, Forrester DM, Gottsegen CJ, Patel DB, White EA, Matcuk GR Jr. Giant cell tumor of bone: review, mimics, and new developments in treatment. Radiographics. 2013 Jan-Feb;33(1):197-211.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p379
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問「何者錯誤」，D 敘述次發性動脈瘤樣骨囊腫（ABC）發生率「高達 50%」為錯——GCT 內確實可因次發 ABC 而出現 fluid-fluid levels，惟文獻報告發生率僅約 10–14%，並非 50%；其提及需與 telangiectatic osteosarcoma 鑑別則屬正確概念。A 正確：GCT 好發於骨骼成熟後的中壯年（約 20–55 歲為高峰），老年較少、兒童罕見。B 正確：多發生於長骨末端，且以膝關節周圍（遠端股骨、近端脛骨）最多。C 正確：典型平片為偏心性溶骨、界線清楚但「非硬化緣」、延伸至軟骨下。E 正確：denosumab 作用於 RANK/RANKL 途徑，抑制蝕骨細胞活性，可用於治療 GCT。→ [[giant-cell-tumor]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總吳宏達主任

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements about ankle imaging is FALSE?

options.text: Normal ankle ligaments are readily identified as thin, linear, and low signal-intensity structures in MRI
Deltoid ligament injury is commonly caused by eversion sprain
Fatty striation of the posterior tibiofibular ligament (PTFL) indicates partial tear or chronic inflammatory process
Sinus tarsi is a lateral space located between the talus and the calcaneus
Anterolateral impingement syndrome typically shows a “meniscoid” mass within the lateral gutter of the ankle in MRI

questions.reference: Rosenberg ZS, Beltran J, Bencardino JT. From the RSNA Refresher Courses. Radiological Society of North America. MR imaging of the ankle and foot. Radiographics. 2000;20 Spec No:S153-79.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p380
questions.explanation: 答案 C。本題問「何者為錯」，C 稱後距腓韌帶（PTFL）出現脂肪條紋（fatty striation）代表部分撕裂或慢性發炎，實為錯誤——PTFL 因纖維束之間夾帶脂肪，MRI 上本就常呈條紋狀、看似不連續的「正常」外觀，不可誤判為病理。A 正確：正常踝韌帶在 MRI 上為薄、線狀、均勻低訊號結構。B 正確：三角（deltoid）韌帶屬內側韌帶，多因外翻（eversion）扭傷受損。D 正確：跗骨竇（sinus tarsi）為距骨與跟骨之間的外側間隙。E 正確：前外側夾擠症候群典型於踝外側溝出現「meniscoid」軟組織腫塊。→ [[lateral-ankle-ligaments]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總吳宏達主任

questions.questionText: Which of the following descriptions about rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is correct?

options.text: For most cases of RA, the diagnosis can be made clinically and image study has no role in the early detection of RA
The carpometacarpal (CMC) joints are among the most common and earliest eroded joints
For the diagnosis of synovitis, the sensitivity of ultrasound is inferior to contrast enhanced MR imaging
In RA, the presence of bone marrow edema can predict the development of erosion

Tuberculous arthritis and RA can have overlapping imaging findings and presence of uniform synovial thickening, large size of bone erosion with rim enhancement, and extra-articular cystic masses favors a diagnosis of RA

questions.reference: Reference: Chang EY, Chen KC, Huang BK, Kavanaugh A. Adult Inflammatory Arthritides: What the Radiologist Should Know. Radiographics. 2016 Oct;36(6):1849-1870.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p381
questions.explanation: 答案 D。本題問「何者正確」，D 正確——骨髓水腫（BME）是 RA 活動性發炎的表現，可先於軟骨下囊腫與侵蝕出現，並且是後續 erosion 最重要的預測因子，只能以水敏感 MRI 序列偵測。A 錯：RA 早期變化為非骨性（滑膜炎、積液、BME），診斷不確定時 US 或 MRI 反而有助早期偵測與提升診斷信心，影像並非「無角色」。B 錯：最早、最常受侵蝕的是蹠趾（MTP）關節而非腕掌（CMC）關節，第 5 蹠趾關節蹠側為良好評估起點。C 錯：偵測滑膜炎時，超音波（含 power Doppler）與對比增強 MRI 的敏感度相當，並非 US 明顯較差。E 錯：均勻滑膜增厚、大型且緣強化的骨侵蝕、關節外囊性腫塊反而偏向結核性關節炎，而非 RA。→ [[rheumatoid-arthritis-imaging]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總吳宏達主任

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements regarding axial spondyloarthritis (AxSpA) is incorrect?

options.text: The sensitivity of X ray to detect sacroiliitis is low and is easily missed
If imaging finding of X ray is negative and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-AxSpA) is suspected, MRI is strongly recommended. If MRI is not available, CT scan may be used instead
Dunn view is a modified AP pelvic X-ray to produce a clearer accessed view of the sacroiliac joint
Ultrasound is recommended for peripheral SpA evaluation, but is not recommended for axSpA
Bone marrow edema is an important hallmark of acute inflammatory lesion or osteitis whereas fat deposition and erosions represent chronic structural change

questions.reference: Reference: 1. Wei JCC et al. Int J Rheum Dis. 2020 Jan;23(1):24-36 2. Rudwaleit M et al. Arthritis Rheum. 2006 ;54(2):569-78. doi: 10.1002/art.21619. 3. Rudwaleit M et al. Ann Rheum Dis. 2009 ;68(6):777-83.；10.1002/art.21619.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p382
questions.explanation: 答案 C。本題問「何者錯誤」，C 稱 Dunn view 是為了更清楚顯示薦腸關節而改良的 AP 骨盆攝影，此敘述張冠李戴——正確者應為 Ferguson view（向頭側傾斜的 AP，使射束對齊薦腸關節斜面）；Dunn view 其實是評估股骨頭頸 offset／股髖夾擊（FAI）的髖部投照，與薦腸關節無關。A 正確：X 光偵測 sacroiliitis 敏感度低、早期易漏。B 正確：X 光陰性而懷疑 nr-axSpA 時強烈建議 MRI，無 MRI 時可改用 CT。D 正確：超音波用於周邊型 SpA 評估，不建議用於中軸（axSpA）。E 正確：骨髓水腫是急性發炎／骨炎的重要標誌，脂肪沉積與侵蝕則代表慢性結構變化。→ [[sacroiliitis-spondyloarthropathy]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總吳宏達主任

questions.questionText: 請問下列那一條肌腱或韌帶 (Tendon/Ligament)最不容易因為鄰近半月 軟骨在影像上誤判為半月軟骨斷裂 (meniscal tear)?

options.text: Anterior transverse meniscal ligament
Ligament of Wrisberg
Medial collateral ligament
Meniscofemoral ligament
Popliteus tendon

questions.reference: Reference: Saad SS et al. RadioGraphics 2015; 35:1138–1139；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p383
questions.author: 臺北榮總吳宏達主任

questions.questionText: The following description about skull base osteomyelitis, which one is wrong?

options.text: It could be caused by improperly treated odontogenic or sinonasal infection
Pseudomonas aeruginosa is the most prevalent bacteria, followed by Staphylococcus aureus
Soft-tissue enhancement, high signal intensity at T1-weighted MRI (edema), and abscess formation can lead to suspicion for skull base osteomyelitis
Differential diagnosis should include nasopharyngeal carcinoma and chordoma

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2021; 41:156–174；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p384
questions.explanation: 答案 C。顱底骨髓炎的發炎／水腫在 MRI 上應為 T2WI（或 STIR）高訊號，在 T1WI 上因正常脂肪骨髓被發炎組織取代反而呈低訊號；選項 C 誤把水腫寫成「T1WI 高訊號」，故 C 錯誤、為本題答案。（A）可續發自未妥善治療的牙源性或鼻竇感染（經 Haversian 系統擴散），正確。（B）致病菌以 Pseudomonas aeruginosa 最常見、其次為 Staphylococcus aureus，正確。（D）因影像與惡性腫瘤高度重疊，鑑別診斷須納入鼻咽癌（NPC）與脊索瘤（chordoma），常需反覆切片排除惡性，正確。→ [[skull-base-osteomyelitis]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總游鎧蔚醫師

imageOcr.markdown:
**TEACHING POINTS**

- Skull base osteomyelitis (SBO) is an infection of the temporal, sphenoid, or occipital bones that is typically caused by a complication of improperly treated otogenic or sinonasal infection in elderly patients with diabetes or immunocompromised patients.
- SBO frequently has an otogenic origin, typically in patients with diabetes and recurrent otitis externa. Other causes of SBO include suppurative otitis media or mastoiditis. In these patients, the infection usually extends inferiorly from the osseous-cartilaginous junction of the external auditory canal, through the vertical fissures of Santorini to the Haversian system of the compact bone of the infratemporal fossa, affecting the lower cranial nerve foramina.
- *Pseudomonas aeruginosa* is the most prevalent bacteria, followed by *Staphylococcus aureus*. Other bacteria that are seen less frequently include *Staphylococcus epidermidis*, *Salmonella* species, *Proteus mirabilis*, nontuberculous *Mycobacterium* species, *Streptococcus pneumoniae*, *Treponema pallidum*, and *Klebsiella* species. There is general agreement that the most frequently seen fungus is *Aspergillus* species, although it depends on the study.

- The diagnosis of SBO is usually delayed. In our study, the mean time from the onset of symptoms to diagnosis was 6 months, owing to the nonspecific symptoms of SBO, its long clinical course, and the fact that it mimics malignancies on radiologic images. The diagnosis of SBO should be based on four points: a high index of clinical suspicion, radiologic evidence of infection, repeated biopsy results that are negative for malignancy, and positive microbiologic isolation.
- NPC is the main diagnosis to consider in the differential diagnosis of SBO. Given that imaging does not allow differentiation of SBO from NPC, a biopsy is necessary. The imaging findings for these two entities are similar, with contrast-enhanced CT showing an enhancing mass with aggressive behavior, bone erosion, and opacification of mastoid cells. MRI also reveals an enhancing mass with bone infiltration. Diffusion tends to be restricted, with low ADCs. According to Goh et al, there are several characteristics of MRI examinations that can help in differentiation of these two diseases. Findings such as the involvement of lateral structures, soft-tissue enhancement, high signal intensity at T2-weighted MRI (edema), and abscess formation can lead to suspicion for SBO.

questions.questionText: The following description about brachial plexus, which one is wrong?

options.text: It is composed of roots, trunks, divisions, cords and branches
Traditionally, the brachial plexus is from the ventral rami of the C5-T1 spinal nerves, yet variations do exist
CT myelography or MRI should be performed within 48 hours after trauma to evaluate the possible development of pseudomeninigocele
Radiation therapy for breast or apical lung cancer may be counted as one of the causes of postirradiation brachial plexopathy

questions.reference: Radiographics. 2020 Oct;40(6):1686-1714.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p385
questions.explanation: 答案 C。評估創傷性臂神經叢損傷之根撕脫／假性腦膜膨出（pseudomeningocele）的 CT myelography 或 MRI，建議延至受傷後 3–4 週執行，而非傷後 48 小時內，故 C 錯誤、為本題答案；理由是假性腦膜膨出常需 3–4 週才形成，且須待損傷處出血物質消退（以免位移對比劑）與鄰近軟組織水腫改善。（A）臂神經叢由 roots、trunks、divisions、cords、branches 五個層次組成，正確。（B）傳統上源自 C5–T1 腹支，但確有變異（如 prefixed 多 C4、postfixed 多 T2 參與），正確。（D）乳癌或肺尖癌之放射治療可為放射後臂神經叢病變（postirradiation brachial plexopathy）的原因之一，正確。→ [[brachial-plexus-anatomy]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總吳嘉紘醫師

questions.questionText: Which of the following descriptions of spontaneous intracranial hypotension is INCORRECT?

options.text: Diffuse pachymeningeal enhancement is common in patients with SIH
In patients with SIH, the angle between midbrain, pons increases
Narrowing of midbrain-pons angle predicts poor response to blood patch treatment
According to ICHD-3, SIH diagnosis requires measurement of low CSF pressure and/or evidence of CSF leak on neuroimaging (CT myelography or MR myelography)

questions.reference: Osborn’s Brain 2nd edition, p1149-1151 Brain 2017: 140; 344-352；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p387
questions.explanation: 答案 B。自發性顱內低壓（SIH）因腦幹下沉（sagging brain），中腦－橋腦夾角（pontomesencephalic angle）會「縮小」（<50° 提示顱內低壓）而非增大，故 B 敘述「夾角增大」為錯誤、為本題答案。（A）瀰漫性硬腦膜（pachymeningeal）平滑均勻強化為 SIH 常見表現，正確。（C）夾角縮小被認為可預測硬膜外血液貼片（blood patch）治療反應不佳；⚠️ 存疑：選項 C 的預後宣稱僅溯及 Brain 2017、Tier-1（AJR2013/AJNR2020）無法證實此因果，宜視為待覆核之較弱論述。（D）依 ICHD-3，SIH 診斷需有低 CSF 壓力測量值及／或影像上（CT／MR myelography）CSF 滲漏證據，正確。→ [[spontaneous-intracranial-hypotension]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總陳書庭醫師

questions.questionText: Which of the following descriptions of NMOSD (Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder) is INCORRECT?

options.text: Neuromyelitis optica (NMO) is an autoimmune demyelinating disorder for which the aquaporin-4 (AQP4) water channels are the major target antigens
In pediatric-onset NMOSD, children usually have a better outcome in terms of disability than adults
MOG-IgG–positive NMOSD patients usually have younger age of onset than AQP4-IgG–positive patients and tend to have relapsing course with a favorable outcome
In MOG-IgG-postive NMOSD, optic neuritis is usually bilateral and anterior involvement

questions.reference: RadioGraphics 2018; 38:169–193；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p388
questions.explanation: 答案 C。本題採官方判定：官方詳解認為 MOG-IgG 陽性 NMOSD 的病程應為「單相（monophasic）」而非「復發（relapsing）」，故將選項 C 判為錯誤、為本題答案。（A）NMO 為以 aquaporin-4（AQP4）水通道為主要標的抗原之自體免疫脫髓鞘疾病，正確。（B）兒童發病之 NMOSD 在失能預後上通常較成人為佳，正確。（D）MOG-IgG 陽性者之視神經炎常為雙側且偏前段（視神經頭／眶內段）侵犯，正確；MOG 相較 AQP4 確實發病較年輕、整體預後較良好亦屬實。⚠️ 存疑：此鑑別點偏軟且文獻分歧——MOGAD 相當比例會復發（兒童約 1/3、成人系列可達 40–50%），「typically monophasic」並非定論，官方把「relapsing」定為唯一錯點宜保留質疑，判讀時對照原檔。
questions.author: 臺北榮總陳書庭醫師

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 3: Clinical and Radiologic Features of NMOSD Patients with AQP4-IgG–positive Status versus MOG-IgG–positive Status**

| Features | AQP4-IgG–positive Status | MOG-IgG–positive Status |
|---|---|---|
| Main target | Astrocytes | Myelin |
| Evolution | Relapsing | Usually monophasic |
| Prognosis | Poor | Favorable |
| Gender | Female predominance | Lower female-to-male ratio or male predominance |
| Approximate age of onset | More common in adults than in children | Younger age |
| Phenotypes | Multiple phenotypes, but the most common are the core clinical syndromes of NMOSD | Various phenotypes, but the most common is optic neuritis |
| Most common MR imaging patterns | Optic nerve: bilateral, long-length, and posterior involvement, usually with chiasmatic extension. Spinal cord: LETM; central/gray matter lesions; bright spotty lesions on T2-weighted images; dark lesions on T1-weighted images. Brain lesions: periependymal lesions and corticospinal tract involvement. Gadolinium enhancement: cloud-like enhancement; thin periventricular enhancement | Optic nerve: bilateral, long-length, and anterior involvement; severe optic disk swelling; perineural enhancement; optic chiasm less involved. Spinal cord: involvement of conus or thoracolumbar cord. Brain lesions: deep gray matter lesions; ADEM-like lesions (large cerebral lesions); fluffy lesions in the pons and cerebellar peduncles and adjacent to the fourth ventricle; periependymal areas rarely involved. Gadolinium enhancement: optic perineural enhancement |
| Associated disorders | NMOSD, ADEM in children, autoimmune disorders | AQP4-IgG–negative NMOSD status, multiple sclerosis, ADEM, recurrent optic neuritis, LETM |

Note.—ADEM = acute disseminated encephalomyelitis.

questions.questionText: Which of the statements about pediatric hepatic imaging is wrong?

options.text: The most useful US findings for diagnosis of biliary atresia are the triangular cord sign, abnormal gallbladder morphology, and hypertrophy of the hepatic artery

Congenital hepatic hemangiomas (CHHs) differ from infantile hepatic hemangiomas (IHHs) in that CHHs appear after birth, proliferate during the first few months of life, whereas IHHs tend to be fully formed at the time of birth
Hepatoblastoma is the most common congenital hepatic malignancy
Umbilical vein catheterization is an important underlying factor in several acquired abnormalities, including hepatic hematoma, hepatic abscess, portal vein thrombosis, and portal venous air

questions.reference: Radiology: Volume 285: Number 3—December 2017 Hepatic Imaging in Neonates and Young Infants: State of the Art；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p390
questions.explanation: 答案 B。B 把嬰兒型（IHH）與先天型（CHH）肝血管瘤的特徵對調，故為錯誤敘述：實際上是 IHH 出生後才出現、生後數月增生、對 propranolol 有效、其後數年緩慢退化，可單發（少）、多發（常見）或瀰漫；CHH 則出生時已完全形成、對 propranolol 無反應、多為單發大腫塊，分為快速退化（RICH）、不退化（NICH）與部分退化（PICH）三型。其餘正確：(A) 膽道閉鎖最有用的超音波徵象為三角索徵（triangular cord sign）、膽囊形態異常與肝動脈肥厚；(C) 肝母細胞瘤為最常見的先天性肝惡性腫瘤；(D) 臍靜脈導管置放是多種後天併發症（肝血腫、肝膿瘍、門靜脈栓塞、門靜脈積氣）的重要成因。→ [[pediatric-liver-tumors]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總余思賢醫師

questions.questionText: Which of the statements about the PRETEXT (PRE-Treatment EXTent of tumor) system is wrong?

options.text: The PRETEXT groups are a powerful predictor of overall survival in children with hepatoblastoma and hepatocellular carcinoma
The PRETEXT group (I, II, III or IV) is based on determining the number of contiguous tumor-free liver sections
Tumor in caudate lobe only is classified as PRETEXT I
The lungs are the most common site of distant metastases in children with hepatoblastoma and hepatocellular carcinoma

questions.reference: Pediatric Radiology (2018) 48:536–554；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p391
questions.explanation: 答案 C。依 PRETEXT 慣例，腫瘤僅侵犯尾葉（caudate lobe，segment 1）時應歸為 PRETEXT II 而非 I，故 C 為錯誤敘述。PRETEXT 把肝臟分為四個 section（左外 2/3、左內 4a/4b、右前 5/8、右後 6/7），以未受腫瘤侵犯之相鄰 section 數決定分組。其餘正確：(A) PRETEXT 分組是兒童肝母細胞瘤與肝細胞癌總存活的有力預測因子；(B) 分組（I–IV）依據未被腫瘤侵犯之相鄰肝 section 數判定；(D) 肺為兒童肝母細胞瘤與肝細胞癌最常見的遠端轉移部位。→ [[hepatoblastoma-imaging]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總余思賢醫師

questions.questionText: The following description about molecular subgroups of the medulloblastoma, which one is wrong?

options.text: Group 4 is more common than WNT
WNT is with better prognosis compared to group 3
Group 4 usually demonstrates vivid enhancement after Gd
WNT is very rare in infants

questions.reference: Front Oncol. 2014 Jul 22;4:176. AJNR Am J Neuroradiol. 2019 Jan;40(1):154-161 Acta Neuropathol. 2012 Apr; 123(4): 473–484.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p393
questions.explanation: D. mild or no enhancement Medulloblastoma: WNT =>(least common, children and adults), cerebellar peduncle, best prognosis SHH =>(infants and adult) cerebellar hemisphere, intermediate prognosis, Group3 =>(infants and children) midline, ill-defined margins but prominent enhancement, worst prognosis Group4=> (most common,typically children) well-defined margins but mild or no enhancement
questions.author: 臺北榮總吳嘉紘醫師

imageOcr.markdown:
**Table 3: Molecular Subgroups of Medulloblastoma**

| Feature | Wnt | SHH | Group 3 | Group 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Frequency | ~10% | ~30% | ~20% | ~40% |
| Age | Older children | Infants, older children, adolescents | Young children | All age groups to adulthood |
| Male-to-female ratio | 1:1 | 1:1 | 2:1 | 3:1 |
| Oncogenic drivers | CTNNB1 mutation, monosomy 6 | PTCHD1, smoothened, and SUFU mutations; GLI 1, GLI 2, and MYC amplifications | MYC and OTX2 amplifications, i17q | i17q, MYCN and OTX2 amplifications, SNCAIP duplication |
| Survival | Very good (p53 status independent) | Intermediate (p53 status dependent) | Poor | Intermediate |
| Location | CP angle | Cerebellar hemisphere | Midline or fourth ventricle (tumor may be small) | Midline or fourth ventricle |
| Metastasis | Rare | Rare | Frequent | Frequent |
| Enhancement | Variable | Yes, often intense | Yes | Variable, may be poor to none |

Note.—CP = cerebellopontine, CTNNB1 = catenin beta 1 gene, GLI = zinc finger protein gene, OTX2 = orthodenticle homeobox 2 gene, PTCHD1 = patched-1 gene, SNCAIP = synuclein alpha interacting protein gene, SUFU = suppressor of fused gene.

questions.questionText: Concerning Wyburn-Masson syndrome, which one is incorrect?

options.text: Simultaneous involvement of both intracranial and maxillofacial regions is rare
Regarded as a cerebrofacial arteriovenous metameric syndrome (CAMS)
Orbital involvement is not unusual
May be with Unilateral or bilateral craniofacial AVMs

questions.reference: 1. Bhattacharya JJ, Luo CB, Suh DC, Alvarez H, Rodesch G, Lasjaunias P. Wyburn-Mason or Bonnet-Dechaume-Blanc as Cerebrofacial Arteriovenous Metameric Syndromes (CAMS). A New Concept and aNewClassification.Interv Neuroradiol. 2001 Mar 30;7(1):5-17. doi: 10.1177/159101990100700101. Epub 2001 May 15. PMID: 20663326; PMCID: PMC3621461. 2. Luo CB, Lasjaunias P, Bhattacharya J. Craniofacial vascular malformations in Wyburn-Mason syndrome. J Chin Med Assoc. 2006 Dec;69(12):575-80. doi: 10.1016/S1726-4901(09)70332-6. PMID: 17182351.；10.1177/159101990100700101.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p395
questions.explanation: 答案 A。A「顱內與上頜顏面區同時受侵『罕見』」為錯誤——Wyburn-Mason（＝Bonnet-Dechaume-Blanc）即腦顏面動靜脈節段性症候群（CAMS），本質為沿同一節段（metamere）分布之多發 AVM；「腦實質＋顏面（眼眶／視路／上頜／下頜）同時受侵」正是其**特徵性診斷線索**，並非罕見。 B（本病即 CAMS）、C（眼眶／視路受侵不罕見，視路 racemose angioma 為典型）、D（典型單側，惟亦有雙側顱顏 AVM 病例，故「may be unilateral or bilateral」成立）皆正確。 影像重點：腦內 AVM 好發**中腦**、nidus 多為 diffuse／proliferative 型（夾雜正常腦、慢速分流），與典型腦 AVM 之 compact glomerular nidus 不同；疑似時建議加打外頸動脈（ECA）評估顏面畸形。 （軸位 T2：右側眼眶／顏面區與中腦可見蛇行狀流空血管纏繞團塊，符合 CAMS 之「腦＋顏面同節段受侵」。） → [[wyburn-mason-syndrome]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總吳嘉紘醫師

questions.questionText: 在執行小兒 Fluoroscopy 時，必須特別注意輻射劑量的控制。下列哪項措 施無法減少暴露於病人的輻射劑量？

options.text: 使用 anti-scatter grids
降低 pulsed fluoroscopy frame rate
使檢查台盡可能遠離 radiation source
不使用 electronic magnification

questions.reference: The Essential Physics of Medical Imaging, 3rd edition. Page 310.；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p398
questions.explanation: 答案 A（此題問「無法」減少病人劑量者）。A 為正解：anti-scatter grid（鉛柵）置於病人與偵測器之間以攔阻散射、提升影像對比，但為維持 SNR 必須提高入射劑量（即 Bucky factor 所代表的劑量增加），因此反而「增加」病人劑量，無法減劑量（小兒透視移除鉛柵甚至可使劑量降半以上）。B 能降劑量：降低脈衝透視 frame rate＝少照少劑量。C 能降劑量：檢查台盡量遠離射源＝拉長 source-skin distance，降低入射皮膚劑量。D 能降劑量：不使用電子放大，因放大模式會增加劑量。→ [[fluoroscopy-radiation-safety]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總郭昱醫師

questions.questionText: According to ACR Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System (ACR TI-RADS), please rank the risk of cancer in the thyroid nodule with following ultrasound features: 1. Macrocalcification 2. Peripheral (rim) calcification 3. Punctate echogenic foci
questions.reference: ACR Thyroid Imaging, Reporting and Data System (TI-RADS): White Paper of the ACT TI-RADS Committee. J Am Coll Radiol 2017;14:587-595；2021 交換考官方詳解 PDF p403
questions.explanation:
答案 D。（此為答案卷標記；依 ACR TI-RADS 點數邏輯與官方詳解，正解實為 C＝3>2>1，本題屬答案存疑題。）
ACR TI-RADS 對 echogenic foci 的給分為：punctate echogenic foci（微鈣化）3 分 ＞ peripheral/rim calcification（周邊/環狀鈣化）2 分 ＞ macrocalcification（巨鈣化）1 分，分數越高代表惡性風險越高。
故三者惡性風險由高到低應為 3（punctate）>2（rim）>1（macro），對應選項 C；選項 D（3>1>2）將 macrocalcification 與 rim calcification 的順序顛倒，與點數不符。
→ [[ti-rads]]
questions.author: 臺北榮總王信凱醫師
